this recipe comes from an issue of cooking light.  a co-worker came in several times and heated up this wonderful scented soup.  he finally brought the recipe in and it is just so tasty.  the lime juice gives it a little tang, the coconut milk and cilantro give it a light and fresh taste, and the shrimp and squash make it filling.  chicken or firm water-packed tofu can be used in place of the shrimp.

1. combine chicken broth , brown sugar , salt , tomato paste , crushed red pepper , black pepper and coconut milk in a large saucepan and stir with a whisk
2. stir in squash and bell peppers
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until squash is tender
5. stir in shrimp
6. bring to a boil and cook for about 1-2 minutes or until shrimp are done
7. stirring occasionally
8. stir in rice , lime juice , and cilantro
9. heat for 2 minutes
10. serve !
demonstrations.review: Dang - this is a great dish! I used regular coconut milk and a 10 Oz pkg of frozen medium shrimp but otherwise I stuck to the recipe. I didn't measure the lime juice at the end but I used the juice of 1 lime and that tasted perfect. The flavors in this dish go together so well. It will go into regular rotation here. Thanks for sharing it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy enchiladas  beef or chicken

these easy enchiladas are my husband's favorite recipe of mine. because of the many different options, it is very versatile.

1. if using chicken , boil chicken in water
2. then rinse and shred with fork
3. add onion and garlic
4. if using ground beef , brown with onion and garlic , drain
5. add next 7 ingredients
6. in another skillet , heat oil
7. add tortillas , one at a time , for 10 seconds on each side
8. drain on paper towel
9. in 10x13 baking pan , pour just enough enchilada sauce in the bottom to coat the bottom of the pan
10. fill each tortilla with a spoonful of meat mixture
11. cheese , onions , and / or olives can be put inside each enchilada at this time , if desired
12. roll tortilla and place seam side down in pan
13. continue with remaining tortillas
14. pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and top with cheese
15. at this time , pan may be refrigerated for several hours or overnight
16. bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes
17. top with sour cream
18. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Very good dish!  I stuck to the recipe, except I skipped frying the tortillas.  It still came out great.  Even my pickiest kid came back for seconds.  I will definitely be adding this one to my cookbook and making it again.

target.recipe_text:
yummy pecan blueberry coffee cake

i made this for my mom's birthday and everyone loved it! have it with a big glass of cold milk for an extra-special treat.  this cake is nice and sweet but not too much with a yummy crunchy pecan topping! it will rise up very pretty in the oven and has a great flavor and texture.

1. preheat oven to 375f spray an 8 or 9-inch round pan with cooking spray and shake a little bit of flour all around in the pan to lightly coat the inside of pan with the flour
2. sift together the 2 cups flour , baking powder , and salt
3. set aside
4. in a large bowl , cream together the margarine and sugar until light and fluffy
5. beat in the egg
6. beat in the flour mixture alternately with the milk , mixing just until combined
7. fold in blueberries
8. pour batter into prepared pan
9. in a small bowl combine all topping ingredients except margarine , then cut in margarine until crumbly
10. sprinkle evenly over batter
11. bake in pre-heated oven for around 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. cool slightly before serving
13. serve for a happy birthday breakfast or just when you're feeling decadent ! :)
target.review: This was wonderful had lots of yummy Blueberries.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s famous meatloaf

yeah, i know...there's tons of meatloaf recipes out there, but i bet this is one of the easiest ones with lots of taste out there!  i got this from a kraft recipe booklet i got in the mail that i've tweaked a bit and it's pretty simple yet yummy.

1. heat oven to 375 degrees
2. in bowl , mix all ingredients except for 1 / 4 cup of the bbq sauce
3. i use sweet baby ray's
4. line glass cake pan with tin foil
5. put meat mixture into pan and shape into a loaf
6. cover loaf with rest of bbq sauce
7. bake for 1
8. 5 hours or until there's an internal temperature of 160 degrees
9. i usually make this and freeze it for members of my church who are sick and need help with cooking , so if it is frozen , it will need to be put in the oven for around 30-40 minute
demonstrations.review: I too was a little concerned about the shortage of ingredients but thought it sounds so simple and I had everything on hand the only thing I added was a chopped red onion because they are my DB favorite thing in the world. Well let me tell you the taste of this meatloaf is so wonderful the stuffing mix has all just the right seasonings and this was my DB first time having meatloaf with BBQ sauce he just couldn't get over how good this was and ate this for dinner the night I made it, breakfast and lunch the next day, and lunch again today and is begging me to make another.  Well I guess i'm throwing out every other recipe I have for meatloaf. Thanks for a great recipe Marla.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy linguine  and clam sauce

this is an easy and quick recipe for rushed nights. it has a nice flavor to it and served with a salad it makes a perfect weeknight meal.

1. 20oz canned clams is equal to 2-10oz cans of chopped clams with juice
2. cook linguine as instructed
3. drain
4. meanwhile melt butter in skillet
5. add garlic , shallot and red pepper flakes
6. sautee for 4 minutes until vegetables are cooked
7. add flour , oregano and parsley to mixture and stir until incorporated
8. keep stirring for at least 1 minute
9. add clams with juice and wine
10. stir constantly for 8minutes or until thickened
11. remove from heat
12. stir in cream and cook over low heat until well heated about 2 minutes
13. pour sauce over pasta and toss
14. sprinkle with cheese
demonstrations.review: This was just the best ever. It was the perfect blend of flavors and lots of clams.  The test to anything  I make is wether my husband asks me to make it again and after his second bite he told me I could put this on his make again list real soon.  Thanks for a make again meal for my oh so picky husband.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rice verde for one or two

very good rice, serve with mexican dishes. recipe can be cut in half to make for one.

1. place half of the rice in two buttered ramekins
2. combine sour cream , chilies and half the cheese in a mixing bowl
3. mix and spread over rice and cover with remaining rice
4. top with the other half of the cheese
5. bake in a 350f oven for 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: I made this rice with the green chiles and followed the recipe as written. This was a wonderful, flavorful rice dish, one I will make often.  Thank you

target.recipe_text:
apple chicken salad

this salad makes a very nice packed lunch for work or a picnic.

1. in a medium bowl , gently stir together , chicken , apple , celery and raisins
2. in a small bowl , whisk together , dressing and brown sugar , pour over chicken mixture
3. toss gently to coat
4. serve on lettuce leaves , sprinkle nuts of your choice over
target.review: Thank you Derf for a nice healthy twist to one of my fav foods, chicken salad!  It's versitile, healthy, tasty, and uses ingredients that I typically have on-hand.  I used dried cranberries instead of raisins, yogurt, and will use either walnuts or pecans next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
barb s gumbo

this is my recipe for gumbo. i have made it with shrimp or chicken. we like it either way. you can make it as spicy as you like . we do not care for it to spicy or hot.

1. add oil to skillet , heat over medium heat add the flour , to make a roux
2. this may take about 15 minutes
3. stir in onion , celery , bell pepper , garlic , and black pepper
4. cook over medium heat about 3 minutes or till vegetables are crisp tender
5. gradually stir in chicken broth , tomatoes , salt , worcestershire sauce , pepper sauce , corn , okra , basil , thyme , cumin and bay leaf
6. bring to boiling point
7. reduce heat
8. cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes
9. add shrimp during the last 5 minutes
10. serve over rice
11. this can also be made with chicken , if using chicken
12. use chicken breast cut in chunks add during the last 20 to 30 minute cooking time
13. smoked sausage is also good added with the chicken
14. i have added a can of crabmeat to the shrimp version
demonstrations.review: Very good gumbo for a shortened recipe.  Five stars for ease of preparation, flavor, versatile ingredients, kids and husband both liked it.  It is very bland (for gumbo) but it is easy to make it to taste.  Could also go into a crockpot, which is always nice on a hectic day!  Thank you for sharing Barb.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crunchy peanut butter wraps

we made these last night for a quick snack and they were great.  loved the tartness of the apple with the crunch of the granola cereal.  the amounts of all the ingredients can be adjusted for personal preference.

1. spread peanut butter over each tortilla
2. warm in the microwave for 10-15 seconds
3. sprinkle with chopped apple and granola
4. roll up tortillas and cut in half
5. enjoy
demonstrations.review: I give this 5 stars for healthy ingredients, versitility, and flavor.  The kids had one with apples, and one with bananas, and I crumbled up Nature Valley bars for the granola.  They both loved it!  Thank you so much for another yummy healthy snack!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
minnesota cream of chicken   wild rice soup

this is a very hearty soup.


this is a very hearty soup.  i really like this one! i love soup and good bread.

1. mix broth , carrots , celery , uncooked rice , onions , thyme , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
2. bring to a boil
3. reduce heat , cover and simmer 1 hour , until the rice is tender
4. melt butter , stir in the flour , then the half-half
5. cook and stir 1 minute
6. slowly add half-half mixture to the rice mixture , stirring constantly
7. stir in the chicken and heat through
demonstrations.review: Very good, easy, made with ingredients I already had, kids husband and mother-in-law all liked it, half and half was a little rich so it would be good with regular milk, all of which results in a 5 stars rating for my kitchen!

target.recipe_text:
tangy pan fried tilapia

i don't remember where i got this recipe from but is is lower cal that most.  you can also bake but the crust is much better when you pan-fry.

1. coat tilapia fillets in dijon mustard
2. then dip in panko to coat
3. heat oil in skillet on med / high - i try to use as little as i can get away with
4. pan fry fillets until golden brown on both sides
5. try to turn fillets only once since tilapia is delicate and can fall apart
6. season with salt and pepper while still hot
target.review: This was AWESOME!!  I will be making this again and again!  I used italian style breadcrumbs and vegetable oil and they still turned out delicious!  >^..^<

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot french dip roast

nan

1. place onion in slow cooker
2. add roast
3. combine wine and gravy mix
4. pour over roast
5. add enough broth to cover roast
6. cover
7. cook on high 5-6 hours or low 10-12 hours remove meat from liquid
8. let stand 5 minutes before slicing thinly across grain
9. but it ended up being shredded beef on our french dip sammiches !
10. we put it on hoagie rolls which i had buttered and toasted in the oven-- and a slice of swiss cheese--
demonstrations.review: OH MY GRAVY!!!  this i SO good.  I could hardly wait to make a sandwich.  Will be making this again and again.  The husband loved it too.  Thanks to Chaya Madre. xoxo

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bang bang shrimp

this bang bang shrimp is bonefish grill's most popular dish.

1. make sauce two to three hours before shrimp so all of the flavors can blend
2. mix mayonnaise with thai sweet chili sauce
3. add hot sauce to taste
4. dredge the shrimp in cornstarch
5. deep fat fry the shrimp until lightly brown
6. drain on paper towel , put in a bowl and coat with the sauce
7. serve in a lettuce , cabbage , and spinach lined bowl , top with chopped scallions
demonstrations.review: Not bad! Suggest using way less mayo (like maybe even portions of mayo & sweet chili sauce) and more of the hot sauce... will make again. Thanks haley101! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey ginger grilled salmon

super easy, sweet and spicy!

1. in a large self-closing plastic bag , combine first six ingredients
2. mix well
3. place salmon in bag and seal tightly
4. turn bag gently to distribute marinade
5. refrigerate 15 minutes or up to 30 minutes for stronger flavor
6. turn bag occasionally
7. lightly grease grill rack
8. preheat grill to medium heat
9. remove salmon from marinade
10. reserve the marinade
11. grill 12-15 minutes per inch of thickness or until fish flakes easily with a fork
12. brush with reserved marinade up until the last 5 minutes of cooking time
13. discard leftover marinade
demonstrations.review: This was a wonderful recipe that really complemented the salmon.  I only marinated 15 minutes and used my grill pan on the stove top and it turned out delicious!  This is a keeper.  Thank you Mirj.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s 5 minute cinnamon flop brunch cake

except for the the milk and small amount in the egg, the cake itself has very little fat and using low-fat milk will keep the fat to a minimum, i have stated the egg as optional, i strongly suggest to add it in for a more cake-like texture --  if you are looking for a fancy cake to serve then this is not it however for the ease of this cake it is darn good and makes a great weekend brunch cake, it's like a combination of a cake and cinnamon bun all in one,  ridiculously simple to make as it's all mixed by hand and takes like 5 minutes to throw together, try adding in some chopped strawberries, apples or blueberries, raisins or dried cranberries, this recipe is a blank canvas, so go ahead and add in fruit, nuts chocolate chips whatever you wish, and to kick this up a notch drizzle recipe#120835 on top :) --- servings are only estimated

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. prepare a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish , or two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans
3. in a bowl mix the 2 cups flour , 1-1 / 4 cups white sugar , milk , vanilla or almond extract , baking powder , pinch of salt and egg until just combined careful not to overmix
4. pour into prepared baking pan / s
5. generously spread brown sugar and cinnamon on top
6. if desired sprinkle chopped walnuts or pecans over top
7. drizzle melted butter over top
8. bake for about 20-25 minutes for 8 or 9-inch round cake pan , and about 30 minutes for a 13 x 9-inch pan
target.review: Just good, not super. This was easy...yes, but seemed to need some doctoring for adult taste. Next time (and there will be!) I will add chopped walnuts.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
10 minute creamed spinach

this is a quick short-cut recipe that i thought tasted great. i loved creamed spinach and am ridiculed by my kids because they think it is gross. i think it is totally yummy so the joke is on them.

1. add the soup mix and milk to a large saucepan
2. bring mixture to a boil , stirring frequently
3. add in the spinach , nutmeg , and pepper
4. bring to a boil again , stirring frequently
5. take saucepan from burner and serve spinach immediately
demonstrations.review: This dish was the big hit at dinner last night!  only trouble was that I didn't double the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked italian meatballs

these are really tasty and i love that they are baked in the oven rather than pan-fried. i found this recipe in cooking light originally and have made them several times with great success. they freeze well after cooking - i just thaw them and add them to simmering sauce for a great spaghetti dinner on busy nights.

1. preheat oven to 400 f
2. spray a broiler pan with broiling rack well with nonstick spray
3. combine all ingredients well
4. form into 30 meatballs using a 1 1 / 2" diameter scoop
5. set on sprayed broiler rack in prepared pan and bake for 15-20 minutes , or until meatballs are cooked through
6. add these meatballs to your favorite sauce and serve over pasta or in a hoagie roll with sauce& cheese to make a great sandwich
demonstrations.review: Easy and good. I baked the meatballs in a muffin pan, I think I saw that on the Food Network and it worked out GREAT!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the very best salisbury steak

this is our favorite salisbury steak recipe. i always make enough extra sauce to serve over potatoes. tastes like it took all day to cook.

1. in a large bowl , mix together 1 / 3 cup condensed french onion soup with ground beef , bread crumbs , egg , salt and black pepper
2. shape into 6 oval patties
3. in a large skillet over medium-high heat , brown both sides of patties
4. pour off excess fat
5. in a small bowl , blend flour and remaining soup until smooth
6. mix in ketchup , water , worcestershire sauce and mustard powder
7. pour over meat in skillet
8. cover , and cook for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
demonstrations.review: This was wonderful!!!  I used everything and prepared everything as listed.  I did double the gravy and sautéed a sliced large sweet onion in olive oil and the remaining onion soup until soft and added to the gravy and meat to cook.

target.recipe_text:
leftover pork chop stir fry

a quick and healthy fix when you just don't know what to do with left-over pork chops!

1. cut the left-over pork chops into thin strips at a slight bias
2. heat 1 tablespoons seame oil over medium heat
3. add garlic and onion and sautee until tender
4. in the meanwhile , mix ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl or measuring cup
5. add pork to the garlic and onion and cook until warmed through
6. add stir fry veggies and cook for about 2 minutes more , adding the sauce at the last minute
7. serve over your favorite rice or noodles
target.review: Wonderful way to reuse the leftover pork we had  We used snow peas, carrots, water chestnuts and broccoli and mixed in cooked spaghetti.  We loved the taste and  that you can add any veggie you like.  It is easily spiced up with chili paste or cilantro if you prefer.  Looking forward to lunch tomorrow!  Thanks Team Rocco!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and goat cheese stuffed chicken breast

the flavors in this dish are amazing, evrything melds so well.  this is a super simple meal that will definitley impress!

1. preheat oven to 300
2. in a bowl , mix spinach , goat cheese , lemon zest , 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and pepper until well combined
3. lay pounded chicken breast out and place 1 / 4 of cheese mixture on top
4. roll chicken breast and secure with toothpicks
5. dredge chicken in flour and brown on all sides in heated skillet
6. remove chicken and place in oven while completing dish
7. add 2 tbs
8. oil in skillet and add garlic , onion , thyme , 1 / 8 teaspoons salt and red pepper flakes
9. cook 3-4 minute then add 1 tbs
10. flour
11. cook 1 minute more
12. whisk in stock and cook 4-5 minute until thickened
13. add lemon juice , parsley and roasted peppers
14. when plating , slice each breast about 1 / 2 inches thick and spoon sauce on top
demonstrations.review: The flavor was amazing, regardless of any previous post, lol.  Simply because my DH said to put this on the recommended list!  We had some goat cheese left over from New Year's Eve and thought we would try this.  My DH approved and he is NOT of fan of spinach(I used fresh) and only had the goat cheese once before in a salad.  No roasted peppers were in house, so they were omitted.  Suggestion: The order of ingredients is not as actually used. Also, a specified time in the oven would be helpful(I baked them @ 350 for 30 minutes).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tomato and basil bruschetta

my first culinary 

1. whisk together chopped garlic , vinegar , salt , pepper , and basil
2. when combined slowly drizzle in oil
3. add tomatoes and let sit for 20 minutes at room temp
4. meanwhile back at the bat cave , toast the bread
5. this can be done either in the toaster or under the broiler
6. when the bread is toasted rub each piece , on one side , with the whole garlic pieces
7. place the bread on a cookie sheet and top with tomato mixture
8. sprinkle on a little cheese and broil till the cheese melts
9. serve immediately
10. the tomato mixture also makes a wonderful vinegrette for an an
11. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I made this for two holiday gatherings and it was a hit, so I will making it yet again tonight.  Fresh is always better, but I did use canned petite diced tomatoes, since the fresh were less than desirable at the store.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
betty white s chicken wings

from my celebrity recipe collection; they sound perfect for a football party!  the smell while these sticky wings bake in the oven is amazing.

1. arrange wings in shallow baking pan
2. heat butter , soy sauce , sugar , water mustard and garlic powder if using , until butter and sugar melt
3. cool
4. pour over wings and marinate at least 2 hours , turning once or twice
5. bake in same pan at 375f for 1-1 / 4 to 1-1 / 2 hours , turning occasionally
6. drain on paper towels and serve
demonstrations.review: These are very tasty wings.  Great when you have guests who do not take to the "buffalo" style. Easy to make as well.

target.recipe_text:
dry rub pork ribs

a simple, no hassle, no mess and delicious method for 

1. preheat oven to 325f
2. cut pork ribs into sections of 3 or 4 bones
3. mix remaining ingredients well , sprinkle on both sides of ribs and rub into the meat
4. seal rib sections in foil with a tablespoon of water in each package , and bake for 2 hours on a cookie sheet in the center of the oven
5. open foil carefully as steam escapes
6. can be crisped on a hot bbq if desired but will be great just the way it is
target.review: very good ribs, I can say these are the best ribs I've ever made

demonstrations.recipe_text:
smoked sausage casserole

this is a great recipe for when you don't have much time to cook. my kids and husband love it!

1. slice smoked sausage in bite size pieces
2. put smoked sausage in frying pan
3. add chopped onion and saute until onion is tender
4. add green beans , mushrooms , and potatoes
5. heat through and serve
demonstrations.review: Great meal!!  Tried it today, being a single guy, I was looking for something quick, easy, and for a better word cheap!!  Something that was in my cabinets, all I had to buy was sausage, me being a country boy I used down-home sausage, added some bellpeppers and garlic, WOW!! It's something I'll serve to my friends, like I said, quick, easy, filling, and goes with beer!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot whole chicken

tender, fall-off-the-bone chicken! skip the overnight refrigeration if you are in a hurry. for variety, eliminate the onion and substitute a quartered lemon or two, stuffed into the chicken cavity.  chef shapeweaver had a good suggestion:  use fajita seasoning mix #28011 as another variation.  thanks!  the standard size slow cookers are a bit too small and a whole chicken won't fit.  you'll need a 6-quart slow cooker for this recipe.

1. in a small bowl , combine the spices
2. remove any giblets from chicken and clean chicken
3. rub spice mixture onto the chicken
4. place in resealable plastic bag and refrigerate overnight
5. when ready to cook , put chopped onion in bottom of crock pot
6. add chicken
7. no liquid is needed , the chicken will make its own juices
8. cook on low 4-8 hours
demonstrations.review: It was so good, so easy to make, think I'll do my chicken like this for now own.  I made Mom's Cornbread Dressing (recipe #13047) it went so well with the chicken and it was my first attempt at cooking both!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
skillet taco macaroni

a quick skillet meal.  only 1 skillet to wash...woohoo!  a kid-pleaser at my house.

1. in a large skillet , brown and crumble the ground sirloin with the chopped onion until no longer pink
2. drain excess fat , if desired
3. return cooked beef / onions to skillet
4. add the tomato sauce , water , diced tomatoes , dry macaroni and seasonings
5. stir well and bring to a boil
6. reduce heat to medium-low
7. cover tightly and simmer for 12-15 minutes or until macaroni is tender
8. add milk and cheese and stir well , until cheese is smooth and melted
9. serve
demonstrations.review: nice meal, I had to use a bigger pot when I put in the pasta and I used 2 cups mild cheddar and 2 cups sharp cheddar, outstanding!!

target.recipe_text:
oriental pasta salad

with a wonderful combination of colors and flavors, this pasta salad goes great with barbecued chicken or pork.  i found this recipe in a magazine, i think toh, but not sure.  not yet tried by me but here for safe keeping because it sounds good and a little different.  time does not include chilling time.

1. cook macaroni according to package directions
2. drain and rinse in cold water
3. place in a large bowl
4. add the carrots , peas , onions and red pepper
5. in a small bowl , whisk dressing ingredients until smooth
6. pour over salad and toss to coat
7. cover and refrigerate for 1-2 hours
target.review: This was an excellent Asian style pasta salad! If you like a saucier macaroni salad, I would double the dressing. Instead of using the ground ginger, I used 1/2 to 1 cup of small diced fresh ginger which made the salad! Next time I'll also use a garlic clove, finely minced.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grand prize chili

this is an actual grand prize chili recipe and it comes from the "texas bragging rights" recipe book.

1. in large pot , sear meat in a small amount of oil
2. add onion& garlic , cook until tender
3. add tomato sauce , paprika , cayenne pepper , bouillon cubes and enough water to cover
4. simmer 1 1 / 2 hours
5. add cumin , garlic powder , oregano , pepper and chili powder
6. add salt to taste
7. cook another 30 minutes or until meat is tender
demonstrations.review: This was truly the best chili I have ever had!  I substituted beer for the water, included 2 cans of red beans, and cooked it in a crock pot for 5 hours. I served the chili w/ Homemade Biscuits (#17867) by Darlene Summers w/ cheddar cheese added, diced onion, grated cheese & sour cream. Delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked beans with an asian flair

i needed to put together something for dinner, so combined several things, working off one of my already published recipes, and came up with this.  the flavors worked well together.  however, i actually used recipe #204223 for the terikyaki sauce, and it was great!

1. preheat oven to 425f
2. in an ovenproof skillet , brown the ground turkey with the onions , garlic and green pepper until meat is no longer pink and veggies are soft
3. drain any grease
4. add remaining ingredients , except for topping , and simmer gently , stirring occasionally for 10-15 minutes
5. combine the topping ingredients and spread over the meat and bean mixture in the skillet
6. bake for 20 minutes or until topping is golden brown
demonstrations.review: I made this dish as just a baked bean side dish. Omitted the meat & biscuit topping. I used 1/2 the tomato sauce called for. I added 1/2 cup of small diced fresh ginger. It sounds like a lot but I made the beans!! Small dice added texture and lots of fresh ginger flavor. You must try it with fresh ginger! Next time I may drain some of the liquid that the beans come in, as it was saucier than I prefer.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
three corn and cheddar spoon bread

a delicious and easy side dish i like to serve with tacos or anything mexican!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. beat eggs in medium bowl
3. add 1 cup cheese , cream style corn , whole kernel corn , muffin mix , sour cream and melted butter
4. mix until thoroughly combined
5. pour mixture into greased 2-quart baking dish
6. bake in oven 45 minutes to 1 hour or until center is set
7. top with remaining cheese
8. bake 2 minutes more or until cheese is melted
9. for another option: add 1 small can drained , diced green chilies or chopped pimiento to batter before baking)
demonstrations.review: This was an excellent side dish to my Puerco Pibil and Mexican Rice. Moist, sweet and delicious! I added fresh minced jalapeno peppers. Thank you for this great recipe. We will surely have this again!

target.recipe_text:
jiffy corn muffin mix copycat

makes 8.5 ounces (equal to 1-box of jiffy corn muffin mix), 1-1/2 cups of mix, or 6 corn muffins.
recipe source: www

1. combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl , mix well
2. whisk in vegetable oil and mix until dry mixture is smooth and lumps are gone
3. if another recipe is calling for a box of jiffy corn muffin mix , add the above mixed ingredients to that recipe
4. to make corn muffins , preheat oven to 400f , spray muffin pan with non-stick cooking spray
5. optional: to mix , add any combination of optional ingredients you prefer
6. combine mix with egg and milk , mixing well
7. fill muffin pan 1 / 2 full , bake for 15-20 minutes
target.review: Works as advertised as a substitute for the box mix. I made a double batch to make a double batch of Recipe #337974 and it worked as good if not better. In fact I printed this recipe on the back of the other just so I would have it handy just in case I need it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick   easy gourmet corn muffins

i wanted a corn muffin recipe i could double and triple easily to bring to our thanksgivings this year. finances are tight so i wanted to make something that tasted and looked more expensive and gourmet than it really was. i remembered having some delicious gourmet corn muffins at a breakfast a few years ago with real corn kernels that were very sweet and moist and i wanted to make that deliciousness for everyone else. 

they turned out wonderful and picky dbf requested i make them again. major compliments everywhere. a definite crowd pleaser!!!! (and very simple per jiffy box). i recommend doubling the ingredients to make 16 because these are yummy and disappear fast! :)

i made 5 batches for thanksgiving so $2.15 for the 5 jiffy boxes $1.00 for the eggs (and i had extras to make breakfast for days) $1.50 for the cans of creamed corn and i had milk, honey, and spices on hand. i spent about $4.65 for 40 yummy corn muffins so not too shabby! i guess i'm sort of the "frugal gourmet." lol

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. mix all ingredients in a bowl and let the the batter rest in the bowl for 3-4 minutes
3. re-stir batter and pour into muffin tins / cupcake papers or a well-greased muffin pan
4. bake for 20 minutes or until the muffins are a gorgeous golden brown
demonstrations.review:
I have made these muffins twice now with great success both times. They make an excellent change of pace over regular corn muffins and really don't add anything to the prep time. I recommend trying these, as they are worth the extra minute it takes to throw them together.

The first occasion I made them for was for Thanksgiving dinner where I made 2 double batches using the Jiffy mix. After hearing the comment "These are Great! What is in these Muffins?" coming from around the table, I knew I found a winner.

On the second occasion I made a double batch using Recipe #345502 in place of the jiffy mix, and to go with Recipe #150863 .

On both occasions, due to the tastes of other diners, I substituted Chili Powder for the Chipotle Powder. But being a Chipotle fan myself I know they would be even better without the substitution. I also cut back a tiny bit on the milk (1/2 cup instead of 2/3 for a double batch) due to the extra liquid in the creamed corn. BTW I make double batches because I would rather have leftover muffins hanging around the house than a 1/2 can of Creamed Corn .

I will be making these often and I will be considering trying some add-ins such as green chillies and or some cheese.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
impossible peanut butter cookies

these are the quickest, simplest peanut butter cookies that you will ever make and they taste great!

1. mix peanut butter , sugar , and egg together until smooth
2. drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet two inches apart
3. if desired , roll in extra sugar before placing on cookie sheet
4. press with fork
5. press again in opposite direction
6. bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. do not brown
8. do not over bake
demonstrations.review: I am in So much trouble. My cookie jar normally stands empty for months on end. I am admittedly not a baker ( but I am working on it). With this recipe I no longer have an excuse. Fast, Easy and who doesn't have PB, Sugar and eggs kicking around the kitchen.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
now don t go  eeewww    before you try this

the only way to eat fresh tomatoes! in anticipation of the impending tomato harvest, i share with you a family secret. this is the reason we look forward to the end of summer, to the time when our gardens and our friends gardens are bursting with little red-skinned treasures. when i tell anyone about this, besides my brother and sister -- we learned it from mom -- and my children -- now that i've gotten them to try it -- they think i'm weird (well...yes, i am, but this isn't why). people looked at me oddly when i made this in the college cafeteria. at least i thought that was the reason. it never tasted right, though. i think the foodservice tomatoes were plastic. my husband seems to shudder if he sees me or the kids consuming this treat, but then, he hates warm peanut butter. period. won't touch it. i haven't managed to get any of my in-laws to give it a try; my husband's dad just looks at me and shakes his head. come to think of it, i get a lot of that from him. so, what is this food that most people seem to find so repulsive that they won't even consider it? i just call it exactly what it is: peanut butter and tomatoes on toast. if you're intrigued, the extremely difficult and intricate recipe follows below. if you think i'm weird, get in line. grossed out? get over it, and try it already. i thought it was pretty gross the first time i saw my mom eating it, too, but she made me take a bite, and i was hooked.

1. spread peanut butter on hot toast
2. concerned with calories-- you don't have to lay it on really thick , just make sure you can taste it
3. now , completely cover the toast with tomato slices
4. cut sliced tomatoes in halves or quarters , if necessary , to accomplish this task
5. sprinkle liberally with black pepper , and add just a bit of salt , if desired
6. eat while toast is still hot
7. if it gets cold , throw away and start over
8. well , i'd probably eat it anyway , but it's not as good cold
9. try it , you'll like it
10. trust me on this-- the salty peanut butter is just wonderful with the tomatoes , and at least a little bit of pepper is necessary
11. i know , you're going eeewwwwww !
12. but if you give it a shot , who knows-- maybe this is how you can find your inner weirdo
demonstrations.review: What... No Bacon?

target.recipe_text:
hoagie rolls

these are so good!!  we use them a lot for pulled meat sandwiches and such. enjoy!

1. in a mixing bowl , dissolve the yeast in 1 / 2 cup warm water add 1 t
2. sugar and then let stand about 5 minutes
3. add remaining water and sugar
4. beat in oil , salt and 4 cups flour until smooth
5. stir in enough flour to form a soft dough
6. turn onto a floured board
7. knead until smooth and elastic for about 6-8 minutes
8. place in a greased bowl turning once to grease the top
9. cover and let rise 45 minutes
10. punch dough down
11. turn onto a lightly floured board , divide into 18 pieces
12. shape into an oval
13. place 2 inches apart on a greased baking sheets
14. with scissors cut a 1 / 4-inch slash across the top of each
15. cover and let rise 20 minutes
16. bake at 400 for 13-18 minutes until golden brown
17. remove to wire racks to cool
target.review: These are delicious!  I sprinkled some parmesan cheese and garlic powder on top before baking.  I decided to make sausage and peppers for dinner and had no rolls, and I remembered that I had this recipe saved.  Nothing is better than fresh bread!  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate toffee graham treats

these are delicious and easy (only 5 ingredients)! if you like toffee bars like heath or skor, then you will enjoy these treats.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. arrange graham crackers in a single layer in a 15 x 10 baking sheet
3. combine butter and sugar in saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly until butter melts
4. then boil 2 minutes
5. remove from heat and stir in pecans
6. pour mixture evenly over crackers and spread carefully to edge of pan , covering crackers completely
7. bake for 10 minutes
8. remove from oven and sprinkle evenly with chocolate chips
9. when chips melt , smooth evenly to cover top
10. cool in pan for 5 minutes
11. carefully separate and transfer squares to a wax paper lined cookie sheet
12. refrigerate until chocolate hardens
demonstrations.review: These are addicting! I also followed the advice of other reviewers, and boiled the sugar mixture for 4 minutes. After coming out the oven, I topped them with semi-sweet, milk chocolate and butterscotch chips. This recipe is a keeper. Perfect for Christmas cookie trays because they are so easy and incredibly delicious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple cake filling

my grandmother has been using this for years! for those of you who love to bake a quick 2 layer cake, this filling is a must & goes great with fruit too!

**note** i recently used this filling for my son's 4th birthday cake (pictured the krabby patty cake in the photos) i used jello's brand banana cream pudding and instead of adding 1 tsp of the vanilla extr. i used 1 tsp of coconut extract. i put sliced strawberries on top of that and it truly was a great tropical type of flavor! i also did the bottom tier with reg. choco. pudding and then sliced bananas on that. you can truly use so many types of flavors. i did like the banana w.coconut flavor though! yum!

1. mix all ingredients together until thick
2. place in refrigerator until it sets
3. spread filling on cake & layer
4. you can also put sliced peaches or bananas on top of filling before sealing with the cake
5. this filling makes cakes so tasty ! be sure to use imagination with pudding & cake flavors and enjoy ! just remember , this filling is milk and heavy cream based so you must keep cool and / or refrigerated
demonstrations.review: I just made this to fill my son's 1st birthday cake.  I used french vanilla pudding and it is AMAZING.  I used half and half instead of whole milk, and heavy whipping cream.  It was very  pretty, like a thick mousse.  It really held it's form so I was able to pile it on...I looove a good filling.  My family couldn't keep their spoons out of bowl!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ultra moist cheese cupcakes

these cupcakes are my kids favorite snack to bring in their lunch boxes. they are so good that even the teachers would write me a letter requesting the recipe. enjoy!

1. in a large bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
2. in a medium bowl , beat butter , sugar , eggs and extract
3. pour in flour mixture in thirds adding 1 / 2 can of sweetened condensed milk in between
4. add in grated velveeta and blend well
5. put in muffin cups 3 / 4 cup full only
6. top with grated cheddar cheese
7. bake in 350 oven for 20-25 minutes
8. stays moist for 1 week in room temperature
demonstrations.review: This was the first time I've made a cheese cupcake, and I was pleasantly surprised.  The orange extract adds a really nice touch.  The cakes were light and fluffy.  I sent a good portion of them to work with my brother, and everyone there loved them..even a person who does not like cheese, said that they were excellent and ate more than one.  I personally would like more cheese in them next time. Thank you!

target.recipe_text:
easy hot wings

i was so tired of soggy skinned hot wings or too much vinegar in commercial hot wings, so i made this recipe up. i serve it with ranch dressing and sliced fresh veggies. great to take to parties.

1. cut wings into pieces discarding
2. wash and pat dry with paper towels
3. pre-heat cooking oil to 350 degrees
4. slowly add 1 / 2 of the wing pieces to hot oil
5. fry until golden brown
6. in the meantime , in a large pan , melt the butter on a very low heat
7. add bottled hot sauce and bbq sauce
8. keep sauce warm
9. add the cooked wings to the sauce
10. stir to coat
target.review:
In order to get wings with a crispy skin, and little fat bake them on a rack at 425 degrees F. The rack will allow the grease to drain off ontot the bottom sheet. If you start with frozen wings they'll take longer(50-55 minutes). Fresh or defrosted wings will cook faster(about 35 minutes). Of course your oven temperature may be different to mine...

To keep the skin crispy serve with warm sauce and blue cheese on the side.   As you eat dip the wings in the sauce. 

This is the only way I've found that keeps the skin crispy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
becka s macaroni   cheese

this is soooooo good. :-) even if it does have a can of soup, lol.

1. combine cheeses together in a bowl
2. butter or spray with nonstick spray a 13" x 9" lasagna pan
3. preheat oven to 350
4. in a 5-quart pot , melt butter
5. whisk in flour , mustard , salt , & cayenne
6. whisk in milk& cream
7. cook , stirring , until thickened and bubbly
8. add the soup and almost 3 cups of the grated cheese
9. stir until melted
10. stir in elbows
11. pour into prepared pan
12. top with remaining grated cheese
13. combine melted butter and bread crumbs
14. spread over top of grated cheese
15. bake 20 to 25 minutes , just until heated through
16. if the top is not crusty enough , broil briefly-- do not over bake
demonstrations.review: I lived in Alabama for 6 years and I have never had a better Mac and Cheese. Due to a gluten intolerance, I use corn pasta and add extra cheese in place of the soup. I also use corn starch in place of the flour. This dish is a hit every time I make it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicago style hot dogs

a long-time family favorite. the authentic stands use vienna beef franks and buns with poppy seeds and that trademark green relish and yellow mustard. if you're not fortunate enough to live near a stand (like us), this home version does nicely (with my own preferred changes of course)! the natural casing frankfurters have a pleasant 

1. simmer frankfurters in beer or water for approximately 10 minutes
2. warm buns in microwave , until slightly warm and soft
3. to assemble hot dogs , place frank in each bun
4. add mustard to taste
5. top with dill spear , relish , onion , tomato , and 1-2 sport peppers
6. sprinkle with celery and poppy seeds
7. serve
demonstrations.review: Have lived in Chicago all of my life and have never seen a dog with brown mustard. Chicago dogs always have yellow mustard. Points for the celery salt.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the real italian bruschetta

we lived in naples italy for 3 years and are actually going back for 3 more. here is the authentic bruschetta recipe, guaranteed to be a huge hit.

1. chop roma tomatoes , red onion , and garlic put into medium sized bowl , set aside in food processor chop the basil until very fine , add to tomato mixture
2. add red wine vinegar and oil , and salt / pepper and mix well
3. let sit
4. meanwhile grill / or broil bread until just toasted
5. serve and watch the eyes of your guests get dreamy over the unique taste of this great dish
demonstrations.review: This was probably the best tomato bruschetta I've ever had although I would make some changes. First, I would reduce the amount of olive oil by half because it was overpowering. Then I would suggest you make the tomato mixture and let the flavors meld together for 6 - 8 hours outside of the refrigerator. This was even better the next day!Looking forward to making it again.

target.recipe_text:
garlic shrimp from the gilroy california garlic festivale

this garlic shrimp recipe is served at the garlic festival known as the "garlic capital of the world." in gilroy, california. this simple shrimp recipe is a delicious and garlicky classic, and only takes a few minutes to cook.

1. make sure the shrimp are very well drained
2. season with salt and fresh ground black pepper
3. place a large skillet on high heat , and add the olive oil
4. when the oil is very hot , add the shrimp and saut on high heat for 2 minutes , or until the shrimp is about halfway cooked
5. add the garlic , and saut for 1 minute
6. add the cold butter , reduce the heat to medium , and cook for another minute , or until the shrimp is cooked
7. turn off the heat and stir in the parsley and lemon
8. serve immediately
target.review: Delicious! I followed the recipe exactly, but added some smoked paprika. Yum! Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zucchini lasagna  lasagne    low carb

great for anyone going low carb or who has so many zucchini, they don't know what to do!! :) we found the sauce to be very mild. i think it would be better with twice as much garlic. i boiled my zucchini slices for about 3 minutes so they were partially cooked. i wanted to make sure they were soft in the finished dish or i knew the kids wouldn't eat them. ;) the cottage cheese provides a slightly tangy note. i think we would have preferred ricotta, but that is personal taste. i use my 11x7 baking dish and got 6 pieces the size of what you see in my photos. both of the guys ate two so it fed 4 of us, and i double the meat. adjust the recipe accordingly for your family.

1. cook zucchini until tender , drain and set aside
2. fry meat and onions until meat is brown and onions are tender
3. drain fat
4. add next 8 ingredients and bring to a boil
5. reduce heat
6. simmer , uncovered 10 minutes or until reduced to 2 cups
7. in small bowl slightly beat egg
8. add cottage cheese , half of shredded cheese and flour
9. in baking-roasting pan arrange half of the meat mixture
10. top with half of the zucchini and all the cottage cheese mixture
11. top with remaining meat and zucchini
12. bake uncovered at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes
13. sprinkle with remaining cheese
14. bake 10 minutes longer
15. let stand 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: I cannot believe how delicious this dish was. I used  3/4 lb of ground beef, part skim ricotta, 8oz bag of part skim mozzarella as well as whole wheat flour. It was to die for. Next time I might skip the pre-cooking zucchini step since I like a little bit more texture, but that's just a personal preference. This one is a keeper for sure!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
festive caprese salad wreath

this is not really a recipe, so rather use the picture as a guide! use both sliced and whole tomatoes, and try to get different-sized types. i made this for our hot-weather christmas lunch, but it would be perfect for any occasion. we get the mozzarella balls in a light brine and the pretty white balls look great with the tomatoes, but you could cut up any good-quality mozzarella. the pesto was a nice bright green, but by the time i took the picture it had darkened somewhat. quantities are guesses: i had a lot of tomatoes and more or less "arranged" them to taste. a large white round platter would be best to use -- i could not find one in time, so used a pale green one.

1. wash and dry the tomatoes
2. slice the large ones neatly in thickish slices
3. do not peel
4. slice some of the larger grape tomatoes in half and keep others whole
5. arrange the slices of tomato and the different-sized tomatoes in a circle , preferably on a large white platter
6. drain the mozzarella balls , and arrange to your taste between the tomatoes
7. drizzle vinaigrette dressing over the tomatoes and mozzarella
8. place the pesto in the centre
9. garnish with sprigs of fresh basil , or use fresh oregano , which is equally good
10. put the sea salt flakes in a small bowl and ask guests to season their own salad
demonstrations.review: I almost never have fresh basil in the house because I find myself throwing it out a lot, however I do almost always have some homemade pesto in the freezer, so I love this recipe. Now I can enjoy a nice Caprese salad any time. Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
antipasto platter

antipasto is a traditional appetizer, which can also be served as a light meal. in our family its always served on holidays, but i frequently make it for a light weekend supper or when the guys are looking for a snack when watching a game. please adjust the amounts and ingredients to your preferences and the number of people you are serving.

1. sliced meats may be rolled up
2. arrange your choices attractively on a large platter , serve with thin slices of italian bread and bread sticks on the side
3. a cruet of olive oil and vinegar near by is a nice touch
demonstrations.review: So simple, yet so impressive. I would highly recommend this to anyone who is having a party. I served some mesclun greens and Recipe #168332 on the side so people could make their own salad if they wished. Thank you

target.recipe_text:
texas red enchilada sauce

this sauce can be used with beef or cheese enchiladas. the amount of "heat" in the sauce depends on the type and amount of chili powder you use.

1. melt butter / margarine in a sauce pan
2. make a roux by browning flour in melted butter / margarine
3. add spices and tomato paste
4. stir until well blended into roux
5. add water gradually , stirring constantly
6. heat until boiling
7. continue simmering and stirring until desired thickness is achieved
8. taste every so often and adjust spices as needed
9. once desired consistency and taste is reached , coat the bottom of a pan with the sauce , add freshly rolled enchiladas , then pour the remainder of the red sauce over enchiladas
10. place pan in oven and cook until enchiladas are done
target.review: I'm obviously in the minority, however this sauce was very bland.  I even doubled the spice measurements.  This isn't a bad sauce, it's a good 'base', but to truly taste great it needs lots more spices.  JMO.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dark chocolate yogurt cake

from little corner of mine blog, http://belachan2.blogspot.com/2008/10/dark-chocolate-yogurt-cake.html.

1. 1
2. preheat oven to 350'f
3. grease a 8
4. 5x3
5. 5 loaf pan
6. 2
7. in a large bowl , sift in flour , cocoa powder and baking powder
8. add in salt , sugar
9. stir to mix well
10. 3
11. then , add in all the wet ingredients: yogurt , eggs , coffee and oil
12. use a whisk and whisk everything together until blended
13. 4
14. pour into the prepared loaf pan and bake for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean
15. cool in pan for 5 minutes before taking it out to cool completely on wire rack
demonstrations.review: Fantastic!  I love it after a few days, when it gets slightly sticky and chewy.  It's so moist, and really delicious.  I substituted applesauce for the oil, and used a tablespoon of instant coffee granules.  This is perfect.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked chicken teriyaki

easy and delicious weeknight meal.  the sauce thickens while cooking so prep time is at a minimum and is perfect with rice and broccoli.  you can use any cut of chicken you like - just adjust the cooking time accordingly.

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. combine the first 10 ingredients in a bowl
3. place chicken pieces in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish
4. pour sauce over chicken and turn to thoroughly coat
5. bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes
6. turn pieces over , and bake for another 10 minutes , until no longer pink and juices run clear
7. spoon sauce over chicken and serve
8. if using bone-in chicken breasts , bake at 375 for 35-40 minutes
9. if using boneless chicken breasts , bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes
10. if you prefer , bring all the ingredients to a boil in a saucepan on the stove and let simmer until thick
11. brush the chicken with the resulting glaze
demonstrations.review:
Excellent flavour. I doubled the pineapple juice and may add even more next time (I prefer a thinner sauce). I'll reduce the amount of pepper next time as it overpowers the other flavours, but that's personal preference.

Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my no roll pie crust

the only pie crust i will use anymore. its flaky and slightly sugary and oh so easy to do. note: due to some major discrepencies please use a good quality oil, preferably a vegetable and a good name brand like mazola, it may not seem like it will make a difference but in the end it will, also use new oil not something that has been sitting around for a while.

1. mix dry ingredients together with a fork in a pie pan
2. make a well in the center and add the oil and milk
3. mix with a fork til it makes a ball
4. flatten and press into the pan in pie crust shape and flute the edge
5. bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes until golden
6. one crust pie , excellent for cream pies and crumb topped baked pies
demonstrations.review: This works GREAT. Pre-baking may take longer, depends on the thickness. My only changes are reducing the salt 1/4 tsp and using melted butter instead of oil. For quiches I just omit the sugar. GREAT recipe!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot kielbasa   sauerkraut

delicious comfort food.

1. slice 1 onion into thin strips and caramelize
2. drain and rinse sauerkraut
3. slice kielbasa into 1-inch lengths
4. combine water , cider and brown sugar
5. combine all ingredients well in crock pot
6. cook on high 6 hours
target.review: Great recipe, made it today.  Only thing I change was the length of cooking time.  Six hours on high is too long and cooks away any juice.  Had to add more water and set on low.  The sauerkraut was really good.  Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage kielbasa supper

this excellent recipe is from taste of home magazine.

1. in a 5-qt slow cooker , combine the cabbage , potatoes , onion , salt and pepper
2. pour the broth over all
3. cut sausage into serving-size pieces and place on top
4. cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours
demonstrations.review:
Excellent, made this today for Sunday dinner.  It smelled heavenly all day.  Comfort smell.
It was done way before direction time so potatos were a little too soft.  Next time I make this I will add more cabbage and some carrots and a shorter cooking time.
I would think that you could use most any meat. It reminded me of  Boiled Dinner.

Thank you talldoc for submitting this great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandpa s favorite corn fritters

my grandmother would make this for my grandfather...it was his favorite recipe for corn fritters.

1. sift flour , salt , and baking powder
2. mix eggs and milk
3. add to dry ingrdients and mix until smooth
4. add corn and shortning and drop from tablespoon into deep hot fat , about 370
5. drain on paper towels
6. serve with maple syrup
demonstrations.review: This was my first attemp on making fritters.  They were "Grrrreat".  Will be making again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
olive garden zuppa toscana

i used italian turkey sausage, and turkey bacon. i also added 1/2 tsp hot pepper flakes.

1. if sausage is in links , take out of wrapper
2. cook ground sausage , until done
3. cook bacon and onion over medium heat , when bacon is crisp , take it out of the pan and leave the onion
4. add garlic to the onion , and cook 1 minute
5. add chicken base , water , and potatoes
6. simmer 15 minutes
7. crumble bacon
8. add crumbled bacon , sausage , kale and cream
9. simmer 4 minutes , then serve
demonstrations.review: I made the Zuppz for Saturday light supper and it was terrific.  Everyone loved it.  I had my small grandchildren and the all had extra bowls.  Thanks.......

target.recipe_text:
fannie farmer s classic baked macaroni   cheese

to me fannie farmer's recipe is the only "real" macaroni & cheese. it's from my 1946 edition of "fannie farmer's boston cooking school cookbook". with time on it's side - this recipe is hands down the best for traditional, homemade baked macaroni & cheese - comfort food.

please note: if you use cheap cheese you will end up with a bland and flavorless dish!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. cook and drain macaroni according to package directions
3. set aside
4. in a large saucepan melt butter
5. add flour mixed with salt and pepper , using a whisk to stir until well blended
6. pour milk and cream in gradually
7. stirring constantly
8. bring to boiling point and boil 2 minutes
9. reduce heat and cook 10 minutes
10. add shredded cheddar little by little and simmer an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese melts
11. turn off flame
12. add macaroni to the saucepan and toss to coat with the cheese sauce
13. transfer macaroni to a buttered baking dish
14. sprinkle with breadcrumbs
15. bake 20 minutes until the top is golden brown
16. (you can also freeze this recipe in zip-lock bags for later use - once you have mixed the macaroni along with the cheese sauce allow to cool to room temperature before adding to your freezer - i generally pull it out the night before and allow macaroni and cheese to reach room temperature
17. i then add the macaroni and cheese to a buttered baking dish , sprinkle with bread crumbs and then bake for 20 to 30 minutes , until golden brown on top and bubbling
target.review: Was very good.  Like many others I made additions.  I added garlic powder, onion flakes, cayenne and sour cream.  I used Cabot "Seriously Sharp Cheddar Cheese" but did not use any bread crumb topping. Tasted somewhat similar to Stouffers although this was cheaper and had none of the unknown ingredients added as preservatives.  Will make again, thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
seasoned stuffed bell peppers

i like all well seasoned food so i guess that is what attracted me to this recipe.

1. cut off and discard the top fourth of the bell peppers
2. remove the seeds and membrane
3. place peppers upright in 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 inch salted water in heavy pot
4. bring water to a boil and cover tightly , then lower flame and cook for exactly 5 minutes
5. remove peppers , drain thoroughly and set aside while preparing the stuffing
6. in large heavy pot heat oil and saute the ground beef and onions until brown
7. add garlic , thyme , salt , black pepper , basil and red pepper
8. cook on low for 5 minutes
9. add drained tomatoes and cook 2-3 minutes breaking up tomatoes
10. add cooked rice and worcestershire , mixing well
11. cover and simmer for 10 minutes
12. remove from heat and add cheeses
13. stuff peppers and bake at 350 degrees , uncovered , for 20-30 minutes or until lightly brown
demonstrations.review: Flavor was good, not too difficult to prepare.  These were my first stuffed peppers and to me it was just TOO much pepper for me, I dumped the second one out and only ate the filling.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rich and creamy blue cheese dressing

this makes enough to dress about 10 cups of loosely packed greens. great over romaine and curley leaf lettuce. recipe can be doubled. the recipe comes from cooksillustrated.com

1. mash blue cheese and buttermilk in a small bowl with fork until mixture resembles cottage cheese with small curds
2. stir in remaining ingredients
3. add salt and pepper to taste
4. can be refrigerated up to 14 days
demonstrations.review: Very good and easy too!  Thanks! Didn't have buttermilk so made it with this Recipe #275034 recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
corn maque choux  fried corn

i had no idea this dish even had a name until i grew up. we had it any time we had fried chicken, which was often. i love this dish - to me it is comfort food.

1. in the skillet , heat the butter over medium low heat until melted
2. add the onion and saute until wilted but not brown
3. add the bell peppers and the corn and stir to coat everything with butter , sprinkle with some salt , pepper , and cayenne , and continue cooking over med-low heat , stirring frequently , until all liquid completely evaporates , the vegetables start to take on a slight caramalization and the whole room smells really , really good
4. taste , adjust the seasonings if you need to , and serve
5. however , if you don't have one , you can use another skillet- just know that it would be much better cooked in a cast iron skillet
demonstrations.review: Very good but will make in non-stick next time as my cast iron is still soaking.  : (

target.recipe_text:
easy blueberry almond scones

inspired by lalalous's recipe #371363, this simple scone recipe is so easy, you can make it in the morning before work!  raspberries work well, too -  use almond extract if you're using rapberries!  i use frozen berries (the individually frozen kind, not the kind in syrup) for these, and i like my berries, so my scoop of berries is more like a heaping 1/2 cup!

1. preheat the oven to 220c / 425f
2. in a bowl mix together flour , oats , baking powder , sugar and vanilla powder
3. add oil and stir to combine
4. fold in blueberries and almonds
5. add milk and stir to combine
6. if it is too sticky add more flour , if it is too dry add some more milk
7. pat out dough on a floured surface and cut or shape scones of desired size
8. i often shape dough into a large circle , and cut into triangles for a traditional shape
9. place on a paper-lined baking sheet and bake for about 15 minutes until baked through and golden brown
target.review:
Except we were missing vanilla, and adding a little cinnamon, nutmeg, and clove; in addition substituted sugar for honey!
This came out perfect, my first attempt at Scones and this recipe was so simple!
I also used almond milk and whole wheat flour.

Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super easy pumpkin bread

i got this recipe from...? you know i can't remember now! but, it was so easy and so tasty! my kids adore them, and they are picky eaters! i do hope you enjoy this recipe! (i used real pumpkin puree, but canned pumpkin will work just fine, too!)

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. sift together flour , salt , sugar , and baking soda
3. in a separate bowl combined pumpkin , oil , eggs , water , and spices
4. then , combined with dry ingredients but , do not mix too thoroughly
5. stir in walnuts
6. pour into a well-buttered 9x5x3 inch loaf pan
7. bake 50-60 minutes until a thin skewer poked in the very center of the loaf comes out clean
8. turn out of the pan and let cool on a rack
9. makes one loaf
10. can easily double the recipe
11. if desired , you can use them in a muffin tin as well
12. they come out just as moist
13. if you use muffin tin bake for 20-25 minute
demonstrations.review:
I followed the recipe, except for making allspice from scratch and using applesauce for the oil.

Then I made a simple icing (I stole from a pumpkin cookie recipe) and glazed it immediately..
Shared it with our plumber and we all loved.
The next day it was a little on the sticky side.  This smelled so good baking. 

So everytime we have visitors I'll think about baking a loaf of this fantastic bread!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spiced apple rings

makes great gifts jarred. fill jars preferably wide-mouth with apple rings and hot flavored syrup, leaving 1 2 inch head space. decorate with a ribbon around lid.

1. soak apple slices in water and lemon juice
2. combine sugar , water , cinnamon candy , vinegar , and cloves in a 6 quart saucepan
3. bring to a boil , then simmer 3 minutes , stirring constantly
4. drain apples , add to hot syrup , and cook 5 minutes
demonstrations.review:
These are great!  Served these warmed topped icecream and crushed gingersnaps! 

Yummm

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apricot whip pie  2

this recipe came out of my grandmothers 1941 cookbook 

1. add sugar , lemon juice , vanilla , and almond extract to apricot puree
2. soak gelatin in 2 t
3. cold water for 5 min
4. dissolve over hot water
5. stir into apricot mixture
6. fold in stiffly beaten egg whites
7. pour into prepared pie shell and chill overnight
demonstrations.review:
To learn more about the safety in consumming raw egg whites please consider this website where I learned that many dishes have raw egg whites in them.
It's healthy and very unlikely to have any bacteria in it.
Really should try recipes the way they are. *GRINS*  

http://whatscookingamerica.net/Q-A/EggPasturization.htm

target.recipe_text:
30 minute lemon meringue pie

for a quick and easy lemon meringue pie

1. combine biscuits and butter
2. press into a foil lined 8" pie plate
3. chill
4. combine condensed milk , lemon juice , rind , and egg yolks
5. place in crumb crust
6. beat egg whites until stiff
7. gradually add the sugar
8. beat until sugar has dissolved
9. spoon or pipe meringue over the lemon filling
10. bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes or til golden
target.review: This is an amazingly easy recipe and the taste is phenominal.  It is definately a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
south africa tomato salad

posted for zwtii tour . . .another qeth (quick, easy, tasty and healthy) recipe from the galley wench

1. arrange tomato slices in a serving dish
2. sprinkle with salt , sugar , and minced chile pepper
3. drizzle on the vinegar
4. let salad sit for about 15 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: How simple a dish and full of flavour.  This dish was a nice compliment to the chicken dish I prepared.  Definately a keeper

demonstrations.recipe_text:
maggie s minestrone soup

this is absolutely delicious on a cold winter day & one of my favourite soups! (sometimes i add some baby spinach leaves during the last 5 minutes).i'm enjoying a mug-full as i type this.

1. heat butter & oil in a large heavy pot or dutch oven over medium heat
2. add next 5 ingredients & saute for about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. add broths , seasonings , tomatoes & zucchini and simmer on low , stirring occasionally , for 30 to 35 minutes
4. add beans & spaghetti and simmer for another 15 minutes
5. garnish each serving with a shaving of fresh parmesan
demonstrations.review: My SO is raving about this soup - i did everything verbadum except the spaghetti - I used cheeze filled tortalini- This is very rich flavourful soup - if you are going to try it - don't change it up - try it as it - you won't be sorry... GREAT RECIPE ! (also freezes well)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asparagus  prawn and dill salad

this light dish would serve 2 as a main or 4 as an entree.

1. cook the asparagus in a small pan of boiling salted water for 1-2 minutes or until bright green and just tender
2. drain and refresh under running cold water
3. drain well and place in a large bowl
4. run a peeler down the length of the cucumber to form long ribbons
5. add to the asparagus
6. add prawns and dill dressing to asparagus and cucumber and toss to combine
7. serve immediately
8. dressing: place all the ingredients in a small screw-top jar and shake to combine
demonstrations.review: Yum EEE there is nothing more to say about this salad than that - super easy - mega taste.  Wonderful.

target.recipe_text:
best beer margarita

i make these all year around for my parties they are the best margarita,  don't worry you won't even taste the beer, you can double or triple this recipe if desired, if the mixture tastes too sweet you can add in a little more water, use the limeade can to measure out all ingredients

1. pour the limeade , tequila , seven-up , water and beer into a large glass pitcher
2. stir with a long-handled spoon until completely blended and the frozen limeade has completely melted
3. add in lots of ice
4. adjust with extra water if the mixture is too sweet
5. serve each glass with a lime wedge on the end
target.review: YUM!  I have been experimenting with making my own margs, trying to steer clear of the sugary mixes.  I used Fresca (0 sugars)  in place of 7Up, and Margaritaville tequila with lime!  I don't have to look any further, this is the best recipe ever.  Would even be good with some fresh fruit mixed in.... thinking raspberries?  Happy Summer and thanks for the great drink.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken and soba noodle salad

good food for summer. we are having this for dinner tonight. prep time doesn't include cooking the chicken.

1. cook the soba noodles according to directions
2. drain and run under cold water to cool
3. drain
4. combine all the salad ingredients in a large bowl
5. dressing: whisk the ingredients together until combined
6. toss through the salad
7. serve
demonstrations.review: Was looking for something different for a nice luncheon.  This is fantastic!  I didn't have fish sauce, and also used cilantro in place of coriander.  I let it chill and served on chilled plates, so light and refreshing with a nice sangria!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked salsa chicken breast

nan

1. place chicken breast in a 2 quart baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray
2. combine the salsa , brown sugar , vinegar and mustard in a bowl
3. pour over chicken bake at 400 for 30 minutes
4. serve with rice or buttered noodles
demonstrations.review: SASSY! The balsamic and salsa combo is so YUMMY!  I made extra sauce and added brown rice to the dish before cooking so it would be ready when we got home from t-ball.  I also put a bit of low- fat mozz on the top.  Next time I am going to add green olives  - hubby's fav.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
seafood pasta sauce

my friend prepared this meal for us one evening and i included it in our family recipe book; it remains a favourite.  tastes very rich but very low fat  and so easy to prepare. i followed some and added the seafood a bit later.

1. cook onions and garlic in butter and oil
2. set shrimps and scallops aside
3. add rest of ingredients and simmer about 5 minutes
4. add shrimps and scallops and cook 5 minutes
5. thicken with 2 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water
6. cook linguini and toss with 1 / 4 cup no fat sour cream
7. add seafood sauce to pasta and serve
8. offer some freshly grated parmesan cheese and crushed pepper
demonstrations.review: AWESOME!  I followed ChicagoRN's advise and added some crushed red peppers, and cut the amt of chicken broth.  I have tried to make a low-fat seafood pasta dish that my husband would like and this finally hit the mark!  thank you Sage!

target.recipe_text:
maple sausage

great tasting sausage just like what you but in the store

1. combine all ingredients in medium size bowl
2. chill for at least 1 hour or over night
3. form into patties about six
4. fry until no longer pink in the middle , but don't over cook
target.review: I made this recipe using lean ground turkey breast rather than pork and it still came out tasting wonderful and just like sausage.  Probably a bit dryer than when using pork because of the lack of fat...but the taste was still quite good.  Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican coffee  caf mexicano

posted for the zaar world tour 2006-mexico.
this drink is so yummy and definitely warms you up on a cold day.

1. place kahla , brandy , chocolate syrup and cinnamon in a coffee cup or mug
2. fill with hot coffee
3. stir to blend
4. top with sweetened whipped cream
demonstrations.review: Yummy,yummy, yummy.  I made this for myself last night and felt like I was out at a fancy cafe for an after dinner drink.  Thanks for bringing this experience into my own home!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot buffalo chicken dip

this is the best buffalo chicken dip.  i have brought this to many parties and it gets finished up quickly.  it is great for those watching their carbs.  if you use reduced fat products, it's not bad for those watching their fat.

1. heat chicken and buffalo wing sauce in a skillet over medium heat , until heated through
2. stir in cream cheese and blue cheese dressing
3. cook , stirring until well blended and warm
4. mix in 1 cup of the shredded cheese , and transfer the mixture to a slow cooker
5. sprinkle the remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese over the top , cover , and cook on low setting for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly
6. serve with celery sticks and crackers
demonstrations.review:
Yum, Yum, Yum!!!!!  This was the most popular dip at our last football party...I would make it again and again!

Thanks KelBel!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ground beef gyroll

instead of using pita bread this is made with pizza dough using ground beef, mushrooms, feta cheese and olives rolled into a pizza crust, you can substitute the feta for 2 cups (or more or less) mozzarella cheese if desired.

1. in a large skillet cook the beef with garlic , onion and red pepper flakes until browned drain fat
2. add in oregano , cumin , salt , pepper , chopped parsley , parmesan cheese and chopped mushrooms
3. cook for about 2-3 minutes
4. remove from heat and set aside
5. if you are using homemade pizza dough , then separate into two even pieces
6. roll out prepared pizza dough into two 11 x 7-inch rectangles
7. sprinkle half the crumbled feta cheese on the top of one crust , then half of the olives on top of the feta cheese , then spoon half of the beef mixture on top of the olives
8. roll up starting at the long end , sealing both edges as you roll
9. seal the seam across the roll and then tuck both edges under
10. repeat with the remaining pizza dough and remaining fillings
11. place the gyrolls on a lightly greased baking sheet
12. lightly brush with oil , then sprinkle each with about 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder and 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese
13. bake in a 400f oven for 5 minutes
14. reduce oven temperature to 325f and continue baking for about 35 minutes more , or until golden
demonstrations.review: Wow was this good!  When I ate it, it was all I could do not to go back for seconds and thirds. It is so yummy!  Definitely a keeper!

target.recipe_text:
country inn pumpkin bundt cake

a pumpkin spice cake with a pecan topping. compliments of the birch tree inn - flagstaff, az. for a special touch, serve the cake with apple cream topping - recipe # 40240.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. thoroughly grease a bundt pan
3. mix together the pecans and brown sugar , cut in the butter and sprinkle in bottom of the bundt pan
4. mix dry cake mix with dry pudding mix and spices
5. blend eggs , oil , apple juice , and pumpkin together then beat into cake mixture until thoroughly combined
6. pour into bundt pan
7. bake 45-50 minutes or until sides separate from pan
8. cool for 10 minutes and invert onto cake platter
target.review: This was very good!  I used a french vanilla cake mix because that is what I had on hand.  Very rich almost carmel flavor.  You don't really notice any pumpkin at all.  The topping made it very rich, you really don't need any topping.  Thanks for a great fall treat!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken tamale casserole   cooking light

got this from cooking light magazine.  it is great.  even the kids like it.

nutritional information
calories:354 (36% from fat)
fat:14.1g (sat 7.1g,mono 3.3g,poly 1.2g) 
protein:18.9g
carbohydrate:36.3g
fiber:2.5g
cholesterol:58mg
iron:1.7mg
sodium:620mg
calcium:179mg

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. combine 1 / 4 cup cheese and next 7 ingredients , stirring just until moist
3. pour mixture into a 13 x 9inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
4. bake at 400f for 15 minutes or until set
5. pierce entire surface liberally with a fork
6. pour enchilada sauce over top
7. top with chicken
8. sprinkle with remaining cheese
9. bake at 400 for 15 minutes or until cheese melts
10. remove from oven
11. let stand 5 minutes
12. cut into 8 pieces
13. top each serving with 1 tablespoon sour cream
demonstrations.review: I had been craving tamales for the longest time and this recipe fit the bill.  It  was excellent.  I used 1 large egg and 2% milk, otherwise make as written.  My daughter has been on an enchilada sauce kick lately, so this was great because she actually ate dinner instead of complaining and picking at her food!!  Topped mine with Tapatio hot sauce, sour cream and some black olives, it was heaven.  I will be making this often.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mounds cafe

so named because it has the flavors of a mounds candy bar. i came up with this one this morning and it is quite tasty if i do say so myself! this holds well in a good thremos.

1. pour coffee into a 10 oz cup
2. add extracts and as much splenda as you like and stir well
3. add the fat free evaporated milk if desired
demonstrations.review: I make this quite often, I use unflavored coffee but I add a bit of chocolate syrup.  I just love the combination of coffee, coconut, almond and chocolate.  Delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
samosa

curry filled pastry

1. cook potatoes and carrot in boiling , salted water until tender - about 10 minutes
2. drain and partially mash them
3. mist non-stick frying pan with cooking spray
4. saut onion until softened , about 2 minutes
5. stir onion , peas , cumin , ground coriander , chilli powder , turmeric , garlic puree and fresh coriander or mint into potatoes and carrots
6. season to taste
7. cool completely
8. preheat oven to gas mark 4 / 180c / 350f mist baking sheets with spray cooking oil
9. cut filo pastry sheets into strips , measuring approximately 30 cm x 10 cm
10. place a tablespoon of mixture at one end of a pastry strip
11. fold over and over to make a triangle
12. repeat to make 20 samosas
13. mist with cooking spray , place onto baking sheets and bake for 25 - 30 minutes , until golden
demonstrations.review: These were very good samosas.  I made mine using wonton wrappers and baked them for about 17 minutes.  The only thing that I will do differently next time is to decrease the amount of black pepper (my daughter thought they were too spicy as is.)  Great served with mango chutney.

target.recipe_text:
marshmallow buttercream frosting

i have posted this in response to a request, but have not tried it. this recipe will frost, but not fill, a 2-layer 8 inch cake. increase accordingly if you wish to fill the cake.

1. beat butter in a large bowl with mixer on high speed until creamy
2. beat in marshmallow creme
3. reduce speed to low , and beat in confectioners' sugar and vanilla
4. increase speed to high
5. beat until fluffy
target.review: Very easy and really well liked by kids & adults. I've not mastered the ability to not get everything in the kitchen sticky with Marshmallow goop, but it's a price worth paying. I made it a second time with margarine and butter flavoring as an emergency substitution and it still held nicely. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bisquick streusel coffee cake

the classic recipe from the box with a couple minor adjustments. you can substitute the milk powder and water with 2/3 c. regular milk.

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. mix streusel ingredients in a small bowl until crumbly
3. set aside
4. mix cake ingredients
5. pour batter into 9" greased cake pan
6. sprinkle streusel crumbs over the top of the cake
7. bake for 20-25 minutes
demonstrations.review: Love this! I usually make double topping.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chilean butternut squash casserole
