3. place chops in milk and allow to sit 5-10 minutes , turning so that each side gets down into the milk
4. mix together crushed cornflakes , breadcrumbs , paprika , oregano , garlic , onion powder , salt , black pepper , and cayenne
5. take chops out of the milk and coat with the seasoned crumbs
6. spray a shallow baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
7. place chops on pan
8. bake chops at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes
9. turn over and cook 15 minutes more or until juices run clear
target.review: Yummy!  I made this for the Wednesday night dinner at our church and rave reviews were shared by many!  Thanks for the great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese and garlic drop biscuits

these are very similar to red lobster's cheddar bay biscuits but a lot better than the recipes that start with bisquick, in my opinion. the kids adore them.

1. combine flour , salt , baking powder , cream of tartar , sugar and 1 / 8- 1 / 4 teaspoons garlic powder in a mixing bowl
2. cut in shortening using a pastry blender
3. mix milk and then cheese into mixture with a wooden spoon
4. drop by large spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet
5. bake at 425f for 10-12 minutes
6. mix melted butter and 1 / 8 teaspoons garlic powder together and brush on warm biscuits as soon as you remove them from the oven
demonstrations.review: WOW!!!  I made this recipe to help kick off the New Year of 2008 and my 7 year old sweet son said "Mom, these are the BESTEST biscuits in the whole wide world!"  Now that is a compliment!  Thanks for this great recipe.  It will be used again and again!  I doubled the recipe since I knew it would just not feed this family of six and there were crumbs left...only crumbs!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oatmeal scones

another good on the go breakfast, or enjoy with tea. note: these are very good adding a tablespoon of orange zest along with cranberries.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. combine first 5 ingredients in a food processor or bowl
3. add butter and process until it resembles coarse meal
4. add oats , currants and buttermilk and stir mixture until dough just sticks together
5. transfer to a floured work surface and knead about 5 times
6. roll out dough to 1 inch thickness
7. cut into pie shaped pieces or cut with cookie cutter
8. arrange on a slightly greased baking sheet
9. gently brush scones with egg and bake 20 minutes or until golden
10. serve with apple butter
11. enjoy
demonstrations.review:
Absolutely Fabulous!!!  I love these goodies!!  I had some golden raisins and dried cherries on hand and added those to the mix instead of currants but you could use any dried fruits.  Next time I am adding slivered almonds!  DELUXE!!
Thanks Barb for this delectable goodness! :0)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade chewy granola bars

nan

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease a 13x9-inch pan
3. in a large bowl combine brown sugar , peanut butter , corn syrup , margarine and vanilla , blend well
4. add remaining ingredients and mix well
5. press evenly into greased pan
6. bake at 350f for 15-20 minutes or until light golden brown
7. cool 1 hour
8. cut into bars
demonstrations.review: I just had to try it!  I had some granola that we had not eaten and took that, added chocolate chips and a little more oatmeal to equal the dry amounts and TA DA!!!  I have granola bars!  Thanks for the recipe for guidance!  Will make it again!

target.recipe_text:
heavenly whole wheat potato bread  bread machine

this bread makes wonderful sandwiches.  it doesn't crumble when slicing, even when warm. cooking times are approximate as times vary with different bread machines.

1. place all ingredients into the bread machine in the order listed or as suggested by the manufacturer
2. set the bread machine on the following settings: "basic" bread
3. "light" crust
4. "1-1 / 2 pound" loaf size
target.review: Yummy!!!  I made it in the bread machine but added too much yeast the first time.  Those packets have 2 1/4 tsp and I just dumped it in not realizing it was too much and the top collapsed and it looked like a sad loaf but was still tasty.  Used the correct amount the second time and it looks better but still tastes great!  Really good when the edges are crunchy!  I am amazed what a little potato can do for bread.  Thanks for sharing!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave pecan pralines

microwave peacans

1. mix brown sugar and whipping cream in 2 qt microwave bowl
2. place in microwave on high for exactly 13 minutes
3. remove and add butter vanilla and nuts
4. mix for about 1 more minute
5. using tablespoon place on wax paper until cool
6. walnuts can be used also
demonstrations.review: I have made these ever since I came back from New Orleans 3 years ago.  Making them in the microwave is so easy.  I do mine for 9 minutes and stir in the middle of microwaving.  These are wonderful and addicting (warning).  I make them to take places and they always disappear.  Enjoy!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
russian apple pie

cheap and very easy to make, low on sugar but has a great taste

1. remove core from the apples , cut in large chunks 2" , lay parchment paper on the bottom of your baking form
2. lay the apples on top of parchment paper
3. let eggs warm up for 10 minutes , then mix till light yellow and foamy
4. add sugar in , small portions at a time , let sugar dissolve
5. add flour
6. mix till you see air bubbles , pour mixture on the apples
7. it will soak throughout , do not mix apples with batter
8. bake for 55 minutes on 375f
9. when pie is done flip upside down , apples will be on the top
10. enjoy
demonstrations.review: I made this but it looks nothing like the picture.  My batter stayed basically on the top, like it was too thick.  I followed the recipe but used fructose instead of the sugar and added cinnamon.  It was pretty bland even with the cinnamon.  A cake or pancake batter would probably work better.  It's a good idea but didn't work for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheesy english muffin appetizer

these are a big hit at holiday gatherings and any kind of party or get together. they're quick, easy, yummmy and addictive. they can also be frozen before you bake them to have some apps on hand for unexpected guests.

1. mix the first six ingredients together
2. spread mixture on halves of english muffins
3. cut frosted halves into 4 wedges
4. place on cookie sheet and bake in oven at 350 until top is bubbly , about 10 minutes
5. you can broil them , but then you will have to watch them carefully
6. these can be frozen uncooked- just put the topping on the english muffin and freeze in an airtight container
demonstrations.review:
We found this very salty.  The olives, cheese and muffins are all high salt and the combination was way too salty.  I did use taco cheese which may have made it taste more salty.  It was just OK other than the salty taste.
We do like curry foods but this did not suit us.

target.recipe_text:
peach   tomato salsa

this is a spicy salsa that my family eats with tortilla chips. my daughter serves it with grilled chicken. it is easy to prepare and process if you use the canned shortcuts. (fresh is better, but it is still flavorful and spicy using canned tomatoes and peppers.) use only fresh, firm yellow peaches!

1. peel , pit , and chop peaches , and mix with lime juice
2. peel and chop fresh tomatoes to measure 4 cups
3. combine all fresh fruits and vegetables in a large stainless steel pot
4. add vinegar , honey , cilantro , cayenne , and crushed red pepper
5. bring mixture to boil over medium heat
6. cook for 3 minutes , stirring frequently
7. add any canned vegetables , and cook for 3 more minutes
8. continue frequent stirring
9. turn heat to simmer
10. ladle salsa into hot sterilized canning jars , leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
11. wipe jar rim with clean cloth or napkin
12. top with new sterilized lid
13. screw on band tightly
14. place jars in canning pot
15. add water , making sure tops of lids are covered
16. bring canner to boil , and process for 10 minutes
17. remove jars from canner , and place on towel in a cool spot
18. in about an hour , check to make sure that lids have sealed
19. refrigerate or reprocess any that are not sealed
20. allow to sit without moving for about 2 days
21. label and store jars in a cool , dark place
target.review: Nearly 5 stars! This recipe takes a fair amount of time but its worth it. I did not use but 1/2 cup vinegar. 1/4 malt and 1/4 white. (it's all I had) Everything was fresh and the Hanover Tomatoes were fine fine fine. I cut the red hot pepper out and used 3 Tablespoons of Franks Hot sauce. The final product was excellent.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian bread  bread machine

i love this recipe because it is very quick and easy. the ingredients for this recipe are always in most peoples houses. i've been known to whip up a loaf in the morning when i realized i was out of bread for school lunches. i don't always use the egg white in the recipe unless you want a crispy crust. most times i just brush on butter after if comes out of the oven. this recipe is tried and true and loved by all in my circle of family and friends; enjoy.


notes: easy and with no milk.
i have also added parmesan, thyme, garlic after the flour and salt just to give it an added flavor change every now and then. 
serving ideas: wonderful w/ pastas or stews.

1. add into bread machine container , warmed water , olive oil , sugar , yeast
2. let yeast foam a bit
3. dump in flour
4. add salt on top of flour
5. turn on bread machine to dough setting
6. watch for the first bit and add flour as needed to get a good dough
7. get cookie sheet ready by lightly oiling with olive oil and sprinkle on cornmeal
8. form dough into loaf and set on cookie sheet with tea towel to cover until doubled in size
9. preheat oven to 375f
10. cut slits diagonally in loaf with sharp knife
11. brush with egg white
12. bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes , until golden brown and when you knock the bottom of bread it sounds hollow
demonstrations.review: absolutely the best Italian bread I have ever made. This is easy! it's beautiful! I can not wait to make it again. Double Wow!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cream of asparagus soup

this soup is wonderful served hot or cold. half & half or milk may be substituted for the cream if fat content is a concern, although it won't taste quite as good.

1. soak and rinse asparagus
2. remove top 1 inch of each spear , discard tough lower part , and reserve middle portion of stalks
3. in a 3-quart saucepan , over medium heat , saut onion in butter for 3 to 5 minutes or until translucent
4. add chicken stock , asparagus
5. cover and bring to a boil
6. reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are soft
7. remove from heat and let cool
8. remove asparagus
9. place half of the soup at a time in a blender container
10. cover and blend at high speed for 20 to 30 seconds or until very smooth
11. pass through a fine sieve and return blended soup to saucepan
12. add reserved asparagus
13. be sure to adjust the seasoning after you add the cream , especially if you plan to serve it cold
demonstrations.review: I loved this soup. Its easy to make and the ingredients meld together for a wonderful delicate taste. I did not have any celery but it did not seem to matter. Thanks for a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple chocolate chess pie

this recipe was given to me by judy b. pruden many years ago. i have always enjoyed it; it is rich and chocolatey!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. prick pie crust and par- bake for 5 minutes
3. beat eggs well
4. add sugar and beat again
5. add milk , vanilla , chocolate and butter
6. pour into pie crust
7. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until pie begins to crack on top
demonstrations.review: I liked the final product. I used Splenda and The pie was not sweet enough. I did not have chocolate squares so I used a very premium cocoa powder. The chocolate flavor was excellent. I would use it again next time. I used a graham cracker store bought the crust and that worked out fine. This pie is extremely easy to make. Thanks for the recipe

target.recipe_text:
pete s scratch pancakes

it was the fall of 1987 when pete nyhus walked into our office, just to visit. we started talking about breakfast, and he reached into a wastepaper basket and pulled out a scrap of teletype paper. he wrote out this recipe, and my family has never used pre-mix since.

1. mix the dry items first
2. combine the eggs and melted butter to the milk and slowly stir into the flour mixture
3. let sit at least 10 minutes while heating the pan
4. these will be high , but light and fluffy --
target.review: These pancakes were absolutely delicious. I used 1 cup half and half and 3/4 cup water.  They were so nice and fluffy.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best baked beans

the perfect addition to picnics and barbecues! simple and delicious. sure to become one of your favorites. my mother makes this for every family get together. ham could be added, or more ketchup if desired, but try it this way first - you'll love it!

1. cut bacon into bite size pieces
2. cook bacon in microwave , checking after each minute , or cook in a skillet , draining fat
3. don't let it get crisp
4. meanwhile , mix the remaining ingredients in a 3 quart casserole dish
5. add bacon and mix a little
6. bake uncovered for one hour at 350
7. it's best if they set out to cool for one hour before you serve them
demonstrations.review: It's very rare that I don't add a little something to a recipe to make it my own.  I followed this one exactly and they came out perfect.  Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
demonstrations.review: These brownies were delicious. I added two cups of chocolate chips. Yummy! Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican stuffed shells  oamc

you can add jalapeños, hot sauce or green chilies to this to add a real kick! **edited on october 24 to add instructions for once a month cooking. i usually make these during a cooking blitz and freeze until i need them**

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add seasoning , water , onion , and 1 / 2 cup of salsa and 1 / 4 cup cheese
3. mix together remaining salsa , tomato sauce , and chili powder
4. spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 9 x 12 baking pan
5. fill each shell with the ground beef mixture and place in pan
6. pour remaining sauce on top
7. sprinkle on the rest of the cheese on top and garnish with green onion
8. cover and freeze at this point
9. defrost overnight and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
10. if desired sprinkle additional cheese on top after baking and return to oven for 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts
demonstrations.review: These were very good!! I doubled the meat and the sauce, and it came out wonderful!

target.recipe_text:
victory s triple decker club sandwich

very good and very tasty. deli fresh meat, fresh garden tomatoes, crisp lettuce, fresh toasted bread with crisp bacon with a touch of basil and a touch of miracle whip topped with a slice of cheese--a sandwich lover's dream come true.

1. cook bacon
2. toast bread
3. spread miracle whip on toast slices
4. sprinkle a little dried basil on the miracle whip on the toast slices
5. on the first slice of toast add the chicken breast slices
6. add lettuce on top of chicken
7. add second piece of toast with the miracle whip side up
8. add bacon slices , add cheese slice , and add more lettuce
9. top with tomatoes
10. put third slice toast miracle whip side down
11. cut sandwich in half
12. serve and enjoy
target.review: I agree, this sandwich is great and I could see myself making this for a quick lunch.  My husband works close to home and comes home for lunch.  Sometimes, it isn't easy taking care of a baby and making lunch on time.  This...was easy.  While my son was napping, I washed all the lettuce, cut the tomato, combined M.W. w/basil, and toasted the bread.  I simply put the toast in our small toaster oven and just waited till my husband came home.  5 minutes before he came, I retoasted the bread then put M.W. on them and built the sandwich.  It was easy and delicious.  I also cheated and used crumbled bacon and just spread it over the M.W. =)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oma s sticky wings

these very sticky wings have been a favorite since childhood, when my mom would fix up a batch of these with a side of macaroni & cheese and a green salad.  now, my kids always ask for oma's sticky wings.

1. place wings into pan of lukewarm water for 30 minutes , changing water every 5 to 10 minutes
2. remove wings from water and pat dry
3. preheat oven to 400 degrees
4. place wings on single layer on broiling rack , and bake for 30 minutes , turning once
5. while chicken is cooking , create glaze by combining sugar , cornstarch , salt , ginger , and lemon pepper in a medium saucepan , and mix well
6. add water , lemon juice , and soy sauce to sugar mixture stirring until well blended
7. heat glaze mixture slowly , stirring occasionally , until sauce begins thickening
8. once thickening starts , stir constantly until fully thickened
9. once wings have finished cooking for the first 30 minutes , remove from oven and dip each wing in glaze , coating well
10. return wings to oven , and an additional 30 to 40 minutes until done
demonstrations.review:
A few nights ago, I was craving some hot wings but since my son is just a baby, I needed another chicken recipe that wasn't spicy.  I remembered my mom making some sweet chicken wings when I was younger.  This recipe was pretty similar!  I added some sesame seeds on to the wings.  My son seemed to really like them.  I tried some too and they were pretty similar to what my mom's.  
I used your sauce combo...but I used a different way of making the wings.  Instead of putting the wings in lukewarm water, I boiled water and cooked them for 10-12 minutes. I then coated them lightly in flour and put it in a deep frier, then tossed the chicken and sauce together.  YUM! =)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pizza hotdish

it actually tastes like pizza!  kids love it, and it's a good way to hide veggies too.  feel free to add any leftover cooked veggies - green beans are great - or throw in some chopped tomatoes.

1. brown ground beef and onion
2. place in greased 2 quart casserole
3. cook macaroni per package directions , then drain and add to the meat mixture
4. add 1
5. 5 cans tomato sauce , water , basil , garlic powder or salt , oregano , and fennel seeds , and 1 c shredded mozzarella cheese
6. if you are adding tomatoes or green beans , add them now
7. mix well
8. spread the rest of the cheese on top , add a layer of pepperoni , and evenly spoon on the last half can of tomato sauce
9. sprinkle with some more oregano
10. bake covered at 375f for 20 minutes
11. remove foil
12. bake 10 minutes more or until cheese is bubbly and starting to brown
demonstrations.review:
I didn't get to eat it, my husband did.  He said that it tasted like pizza spaghetti.  I made 3 separate servings.  I served one today and have two more in the freezer for later.  Thanks for a creative idea!

edit:  I rolled out a piece of biscuit dough on top of the leftovers and my husband seemed to like it that way too.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
justin s tuna salad

nan

1. combine eggs and dill relish
2. add the rest of the ingredients , except tuna , and mix really well
3. then add tuna
4. if the mixture is dry , add some more mayonnaise
5. this is fine for a sandwich
demonstrations.review: When combining, I left the hot sauce out because my husband can't really eat spicy food.  I love spicy so I just got myself a bowl of salad, a scoop of your tuna salad, and dashed away with the hot sauce. Before, I used to add Tapatio when eating tuna salad, but Tabasco wasn't a bad substitute.  The hot sauce you use makes a difference~

target.recipe_text:
roasted cauliflower   16 roasted cloves of garlic

i find it totally amazing, that children and men all  love this recipe!  as for the female of our species we just love this for the flavor and the health benefits it brings our families.
roasted brings out a wonderful sweetness in this dish. the garlic is roasted to a tan color is creamy good. you can just pop them in your mouth. or you can spread them on your florets or fresh bread. just be sure to scoop up some of the rosemary, olive oil and black pepper that may have escaped to the bottom of the dish.
for halloween check out recipe #396674 version of my recipe.

1. mix oil , rosemary , salt , pepper and garlic together
2. toss in cauliflower and place in a large casserole dish in one layer
3. roast in a preheated oven at 450 degrees for 20 minutes
4. give a toss and bake for 10 more minutes
target.review: I will never make cauliflower any other way. This was just excellent, with enough olive oil in the bottom of the pan for dipping bread. Great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
feta cheese log with kalamata olives and sun dried tomatoes

a great appetizer for the holidays.

1. mix feta , cream cheese and oil with a mixer on medium speed until well-blended
2. add remaining ingredients and mix well
3. shape into a 10-inch-long log
4. combine walnuts and parsley and roll cheese log in this mixture , pressing slightly to get the walnuts and parsley to stick to the sides of the log
5. wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 5 hours before serving to allow flavours to blend
6. remove plastic wrap and lay log on an attractive serving platter lined with parsley
7. serve with assorted crackers and toasted baguette slices
demonstrations.review: I was a bit skeptical when it came to  shaping this into a log, as it was really soft and messy, but it turned out great! Really beautiful, and delicious too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
greek yoghurt cake

this is really a great cake. for some reason, i'm partial to it cold, straight out of the fridge, with a glass of ice-cold milk.

1. boil all of syrup ingredients together first to make syrup
2. it must be cool before being poured onto hot cake
3. beat butter with 1 1 / 2 cups sugar till creamy and light-coloured
4. add yolks , peel , extract and brandy and beat until pale and thick
5. sift dry ingredients and add alternately to the creamed mixture with the yoghurt
6. beat whites until stiff and glossy
7. fold into batter mixture along with almonds
8. pour into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2" baking dish and bake at 350f for 60-70 minutes or until done
9. check cake after about 25 minutes of baking
10. if the colour is already dark enough , cover with a piece of aluminum foil and continue baking
11. pour cooled syrup over hot cake and allow cake to cool completely
12. cut into diamond-shaped pieces and serve
demonstrations.review: This was unbelievably good! I was afraid that I would mess it up, as I've never made a cake from scratch, but the directions were simple to follow and it turned out wonderfully. A big hit!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft snickerdoodle cookies

these snickerdoodle cookies are so delicious, and they have the best texture. they are so fast to put together too! i actually got it from an old recipe that my great grandma had clipped out of a newspaper. grandma always knows best!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. mix softened butter , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , 1tps of vanilla extract and eggs thoroughly in a large bowl
3. combine flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt in a separate bowl
4. blend dry ingredients into butter mixture
5. chill dough , and chill an ungreased cookie sheet for about 10-15 minutes in the fridge
6. meanwhile , mix 3 tablespoons sugar , and 3 teaspoons cinnamon in a small bowl
7. scoop 1 inch globs of dough into the sugar / cinnamon mixture
8. coat by gently rolling balls of dough in the sugar mixture
9. place on chilled ungreased cookie sheet , and bake 10 minutes
10. remove from pan immediately
demonstrations.review: Wonderful cookies! The balls didn't flatten, however, so they're awfully round, but this doesn't affect the taste, which is delicious!

target.recipe_text:
meat   potato style tater tot casserole

this is such a wonderful hearty one dish meal. i love the sour cream  and cheese mixture in this. if your family is a meat/potato kinda family then they will go crazy over this. this is a combination of many different recipes rolled into one to meet my family's picky needs at the table.

1. brown and drain ground beef
2. mix ground beef , cream of chicken soup , cheese , milk , sour cream , corn and onions all together
3. i salt and pepper the mixture to taste
4. spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish or pan
5. the pan will be very full but it will all fit
6. i just line the bottom of my oven with foil just in case
7. cover the mixture with the entire bag of tater tots making sure to spread them evenly
8. i lay most on their sides and some upright and then kind of smash them down into the mixture a little
9. i give them a good smashing and smash as much as i can so just the tops of the tots are showing
10. bake uncovered in a preheated 350f oven for about 45 minutes
11. you can also sprinkle a little teeny bit of cheddar cheese on the top if you want
12. step away from the table because your meat eaters will love this
13. you can use more sour cream and cheese depending on your taste ! i sometimes use a lot
target.review: This was not a winner for my family.  We do the "typical" TTC recipe often, so I decided to try this when I realized I was missing an ingredient for the other.  I DID like some aspects...the addition of a veggie (I used corn), the sour cream, the tater tots on top, but I have to say the Cream of Chicken soup in a beef recipe skeeved me out.  I did not like that.  Next time, I will use Cream of Mushroom (or onion, or celery).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whole wheat zucchini bread

this is very different from the usual zucchini loaves. first of all, it bakes into a round loaf and contains wheat. this is one of my favorites. one of my former neighbors used to bake a lot of items with wheat flour, and this is one of her own creations that she shared with me. thanks carol! prep time allows for shredding the zucchini (i use my food processor).

1. spray a 9" round baking tin with nonstick spray and preheat the oven to 350f
2. stir together both types of flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , and cloves in a large bowl
3. make a well in the center of this mixture
4. in another bowl , beat egg whites until foamy
5. to the egg whites , add applesauce , buttermilk , and vanilla and stir using a wooden spoon
6. stir in the zucchini until well combined
7. pour this wet mixture into the"well" you made in the flour mixture and stir just until ingredients are all moistened and gently combined- press out any large lumps with your spoon , but don't overmix
8. gently fold in the nuts , if using , - don't overmix or you will have tough bread
9. pour into the prepared pan and bake for about 40-50 minutes or until a toothpick tests clean
10. cool bread in pan for 10 minutes , then remove to a wire rack to cool completely
demonstrations.review: YUM!  I had one baggie of shredded zucchini to use up and decided to make this into muffins to eat on the way to church tomorrow...now I can't wait for morning!  I didn't have cloves, so I just added 2t. of pumpkin pie spice instead of the seperate cinn., nutmeg and cloves.  I baked the muffins for about 25 minutes and they are perfect!  Moist and filling, but not heavy.  Thanks for sharing such a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vanilla scented granola

great snack for everyone, or the for kids lunches or even as an after school treat! serve for breakfast with yogurt and fruit or over ice cream for dessert. watch your time in the oven because sometimes it cooks a little quickly. this recipe came from bon appetit, march of 2002.
a few baking tips i have learned from making this recipe often: i use a jelly roll pan so the granola will have maximum exposure while cooking.  also, if you do like your granola to clump, do not stir while baking.  allow to cool in pan for about 10 minutes or so, then run a spatula between granola and the pan to loosen.  you will have so many clumps you will have to break them with your hands ; )

1. position rack to middle of oven and preheat to 300
2. lightly spray large baking sheet with nonstick spray
3. mix next 5 ingredients in large bowl
4. combine oil , honey and sugar in small saucepan
5. bring to simmer over medium heat
6. remove from heat
7. stir in vanilla
8. pour hot liquid over oat mixture
9. stir well
10. using hands , toss mixture until thoroughly mixed
11. spread granola on prepared baking sheet
12. bake until golden brown , stirring occasionaly , about 30 minutes
13. transfer sheet to rack
14. cool granola completely
15. makes about 8 cups
demonstrations.review: easy and yummy, the only 2 things i require!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: Yum!  Easy and staple ingredients, thank you!!!

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy no fail make anytime turkey gravy

i have been using this recipe for many years, my family loves this gravy and i have served it to dinner guests over the holidays and always receive rave reviews! --- you don't need to make this gravy using all pan drippings, if you do not have 4 cups of drippings you may mix with chicken broth to make the 4 cups, or it may be made with only chicken broth, please see note on the bottom of the recipe--- this may be made slightly ahead and kept uncovered on top of the stove until ready to serve, just whisk before using if you have any left over this gravy freezes very well or you may reduce all ingredients down to half and for a thinner gravy reduce flour by 1 tablespoon  --- also see my recipe#314890
for more of my recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. drain the pan drippings for the roasted turkey through a fine strainer
2. let sit and then remove any fat from the top of the drippings
3. add in chicken broth or water to make 4 cups if necessary
4. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine or butter
5. add in lots of black pepper
6. add in 1 / 2 cup flour plus 3 tablespoons
7. constantly whisk for about 3 minutes over low heat
8. slowly add in the 4 cups turkey broth / drippings
9. whisk constantly over medium-low heat until bubbly and thickened
10. use right away or keep warm over lowest heat setting , whisk again before serving
11. options to make this gravy using all chicken broth prepare as directed using 4 cups low sodium chicken broth and 1 tablespoon chicken boullion powder ---- or you may add in low sodium chicken broth omitting bouillon powder to pan drippings to make up 4 cups
target.review: Great! Tried it as a test for Thanksgiving. Passed with flying colors! Kids gave it 20 thumbs up!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
very low carb hamburger bun

i found this recipe on a low-carb forum when googling different low-carb websites--it sounds crazy, but the end result is amazing!  to quote the original post:

"this makes a wonderful hamburger bun, it tastes like a whole wheat bun. it's very sturdy and holds up well with all the juiciness of a hamburger with all the fixings."

note: you may need to add more ground flaxseed/flaxseed meal--the consistently of the "stuff" pre-microwaved should be thick and sort of pasty, like brownie batter, not liquidy.

1. mix all ingredients together in a microwave safe bowl or container
2. put the bowl / container in the microwave and nuke for 1 minute or until center is set
3. it will billow up in the bowl
4. leave it in the bowl for another minute then turn it out on a cooling rack and let it cool
5. once it has cooled take a long bread knife and slice the bun in half and make your hamburger as usual
demonstrations.review:
Great! Perfect for Atkins!
I used it for an egg, bacon avocado breakfast sandwich. Fantastic!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic parmesan flax seed crackers   low carb

found on about.com. a great high fiber, crunchy, nutritious, and tasty snack. good with dips, spreads, or plain.

the whole recipe is 6 grams of effective carbohydrate plus 35 grams of fiber

1. heat oven to 400f
2. mix all ingredients together
3. spoon onto sheet pan which is covered with a silicone mat or greased parchment paper
4. cover the mixture with a piece of parchment or waxed paper
5. even out the mixture to about 1 / 8 inch
6. i find a straight edge , like a ruler , works well , though you can use a rolling pin or wine bottle too
7. the important thing is not to let it be too thin around the edges or that part will overcook before the center firms up
8. so after you spread it out , go around the edges with your finger and push the thin part inwards to even it up
9. bake until the center is no longer soft , about 15-18 minutes
10. if it starts to get more than a little brown around the edges , remove from oven
11. let cool completely - it will continue to crisp up
12. break into pieces
demonstrations.review: Satisfied my cracker urge. Perfect for Atkins

demonstrations.recipe_text:
treebeard s red beans  and rice

this recipe is quite a favorite at treebeards' restaurant in houston. it's posted in response to a request.  cooking time does not include the pre-soak or pre-boil time.  to make it south beach friendly, substitute low fat turkey smoked sausage for the regular smoked sausage, and serve with brown rice.

1. sort and wash red beans
2. in a large soup pot , add 2 qrts cold water and red beans
3. let soak overnight
4. do not drain water !
5. add onions , celery , and bell pepper to beans and bring to a boil
6. cover , and reduce heat to simmer about 1 1 / 2 hours , or until beans are soft
7. do not stir more than necessary
8. stir in seasonings and sausage
9. simmer 30 minutes more
10. meanwhile cook a pot of rice , and serve the beans over the hot cooked rice , garnished with shredded cheddar cheese and chopped green onion
11. if you want thicker beans , remove the lid during the last 30 minutes of cooking time , or remove 1 / 2 cups of the beans and mash them before returning to the pot
demonstrations.review: Fantastic!! I made it exactly as stated in the recipe. (Okay, maybe I added a little extra cayenne pepper) Will be making this again and again!

target.recipe_text:
kidney bean chili  indian style  rajma in masala

this is one of the signature dishes of north india, and is spicy, aromatic, flavourful, and simply out of this world! for the authentic feel, try to stick to the original recipe ingredients as much as possible, but you may also use suitable substitutes as mentioned. this is from 

1. wash the kidney beans well and soak in water overnight
2. next morning , steam them until tender
3. or cook in a large pot of water for about an hour or until tender
4. remove 1 / 2 cup of cooked beans , crush coarsely and keep aside
5. grind 1 onion , ginger , coriander seeds , chili peppers , cumin , turmeric , peppercorns , and cinnamon to a very fine paste
6. heat ghee in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
7. add the chopped onions and saute until golden brown
8. add the ground paste and saute , sprinkling water occasionally , until the ghee starts separating from the paste
9. add the cooked beans , stir for a while and add salt and dried mango powder
10. pour 3 cups of water and add the crushed beans
11. mix well and bring to a boil , twice
12. serve hot over steamed rice , chappatis , or whole-wheat tortillas
target.review: Very good. I hope I didn't change it too much by adding a few fresh tomatoes? But it was really good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon pineapple baked chicken

enjoy. 

1. drain pineapple
2. combine the juice with garlic , cornstarch , worcestershire sauce , mustard and rosemary
3. set aside
4. arrange chicken in shallow pan , skin side up
5. sprinkle with salt
6. broil until browned
7. stir the sauce and pour over the chicken
8. bake at 350 degrees for about 25 minutes , depending on thickness of chicken
9. arrange pineapple and thin lemon slices around chicken , baste with the sauce in pan and continue baking 5 minutes longer
10. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - serving ideas : serve over rice
demonstrations.review: To the reviewer who suggested giving copywrite credit - A recipe is original if it has at least 3 changes in ingredients or preparation. I don't know if this one does, but hopefully that provides more information for the future! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
family favorite sesame chicken

a few months ago i made this great sesame chicken that my mother and i loved.... problem was it was one of those dinners where i added a little of this... a little of that.... and could not for the life of me remember what on earth i put in it!! so after months of tinkering in the kitchen i finally came up with the recipe last night, and wrote down all the ingredients!! enjoy!

1. combine chicken ingredients except cornstarch and let marinate for at least 30 minutes in the fridge
2. remove chicken from marinade and toss in cornstarch then cook chicken in hot oil on the stove top until cooked thru
3. remove from pan and keep warm in oven while making the sauce
4. combine all sauce ingredients except cornstarch in a sauce pan and bring to a boil over med
5. heat
6. mix cornstarch with a little water in a cup until disolved then slowly add to the sauce mixture on the stove and heat until thickened to you liking
7. add chicken to sauce on the stove until heated thru
8. remove and sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and finally enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was really delicious, and the sauce was a thick dark brown the way you get it in a Chinese restaurant. Great for someone who wants to enjoy real-tasting Chinese food with no MSG!! :) I made mine with steamed spinach and stir fried Bok Choy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft snickerdoodle cookies

these snickerdoodle cookies are so delicious, and they have the best texture. they are so fast to put together too! i actually got it from an old recipe that my great grandma had clipped out of a newspaper. grandma always knows best!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. mix softened butter , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , 1tps of vanilla extract and eggs thoroughly in a large bowl
3. combine flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt in a separate bowl
4. blend dry ingredients into butter mixture
5. chill dough , and chill an ungreased cookie sheet for about 10-15 minutes in the fridge
6. meanwhile , mix 3 tablespoons sugar , and 3 teaspoons cinnamon in a small bowl
7. scoop 1 inch globs of dough into the sugar / cinnamon mixture
8. coat by gently rolling balls of dough in the sugar mixture
9. place on chilled ungreased cookie sheet , and bake 10 minutes
10. remove from pan immediately
demonstrations.review: These were some of the best snickerdoodles I've ever made. The only addition was that I added probably 1/4 cup more flour so the dough wasn't so sticky. This eliminated the need to chill the dough as well. Also, I rolled them in pumpkin pie spice & sugar instead of cinnamon - because I grabbed the wrong bottle! :) But the extra spice really added something special.

target.recipe_text:
mom s best stuffing

a thirty year old recipe that just seems to get better with time. i went to visit my daughter 3000 miles away and i still had to make the stuffing for dinner.

1. saute sausage until brown
2. remove from pan and cut into small bites
3. in a large skillet , melt butter and cook onion , celery , and mushrooms over medium heat for 3 minutes or until softened
4. transfer sausage and veggies , including any butter that is left in the pan to a bowl
5. add stuffing mix , bread cubes , sage , thyme , poultry seasoning , salt , pepper , pecans , turkey stock , and eggs
6. toss well and adjust seasoning
7. stuffing should be moist but not soggy
8. add more stock if needed
9. transfer to a baking dish
10. bake in a 325 degree fahrenheit oven for 20 minutes covered and 10 minutes uncovered until heated through and crust forms on top
11. or better yet stuff it into a big fat turkey
target.review: EXCELLENT!! Thank you for sharing this recipe! I've finally found THE stuffing recipe that will become the family tradition for us at the holidays.  I added a couple of finely diced fuji apples to the mix as well during saute. A wonderful combination.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pineapple dump cake

nan

1. pour pineapple into a lightly greased 13x9-inch baking pan
2. sprinkle the coconut over , then top with the dry cake mix
3. pour melted butter over top , then sprinkle with nuts
4. bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes or until lightly browned
demonstrations.review: Everyone seemed to like this.  When I made it, I literally "dumped" everything in the pan and then spread it out.  I found it to be too dry. So next time I will probably mix everything around a bit to make sure everything is moistened.  I used pineapple chunks and next time I'm going to try crushed pineapple and brown sugar.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rogene s knorr spinach dip

rogene hollows out a bulb of bread and serves this inside, with the bread on the side.

1. stir together the soup mix , sour cream and mayonnaise together until well blended
2. squeeze the spinach dry and stir into the wet mixture
3. next stir in water chestnuts and green onions
4. cover and chill for 2 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: This recipe is so, so delicious (also found on back of Knorr's Veggie Soup packet). I buy 2 rounds of KING'S HAWAIIAN BREAD - One I hollow out as a bread bowl and the other is used for extra dippers (highly recommend this bread - perfect compliment to the dip). IDEAL FOR POTLUCKS OR PARTIES!! Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
festive appetizer spread

a must for that holiday party! :)

1. mix all ingredients with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
2. refrigerate
3. garnish with chopped nuts , parsley or fresh vegetable cutouts
4. serve with assorted crackers , breads , breadsticks or vegetables
demonstrations.review: This dip was so, so good and so easy. I didn't have fresh red peppers so I used jarred roasted red pepper instead. Followed the rest of the recipe to the letter. I will be adding this recipe to list of those to use for special occasions. Thanks for sharing. LOVED IT!

target.recipe_text:
oreo cheesecakes

i am not sure how many cheesecakes you get from this recipe. i got it from one of my resident's teenaged grandson's who baked them for her birhtday

1. prehat oven to 350 degrees
2. place paper liners in regular sized muffin pans
3. put 1 whole oreo cookie in bottom of each liner
4. in a large bowl beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth
5. add the eggs one at a time and until well blended
6. beat in vanilla extract
7. spoon mixture over each cookie
8. bake for 20 minutes or until the center is almost set
9. cool completely
10. then put in refrigerator for 1 hour
11. drizzle melted semi sweet morsels over top of each cake
12. top with a dollop of whipped topping
target.review: I made these at Chiristmas time and hardly wanted to put them out they are that good.  Every couple of months I get a HUGE craving for these and have to make them.  I try to make a small batch in case I  eat them all in one sitting!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandma s m ms cookies

i got this recipe from my grandma.  these cookes do not last long around the house when i make them.  cooking time includes time to cook each sheet of cookies and not the whole batch.

1. cream shortening , sugars , eggs , and vanilla thoroughly
2. sift together flour , soda , and salt
3. add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture
4. mix well
5. stir in 1 / 1 / 2 cups m&ms
6. reserve remaining candies for decorating
7. drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet
8. decorate tops of cookies with remaining m&m's
9. bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes , or until brown
10. after baking , some of the candies may be slighly cracked
11. this adds texture and interest to your cookies
12. makes about 6 dozen 2 1 / 2 inch cookies
13. if you use self-rising flour , omit soda and salt
demonstrations.review: Thank You Rachel and Grammy too! I have been on the quest for the perfect cookie recipie for choc chip cookies and I think I have found it.  Not to thin, not to puffy, tasty, not too chewy and not to hard. I made only a couple of subtle changes, used 3/4 c shortening and 1/4 c melted butter.  I also added extra flour after mixing until the batter felt stiff enough.  I chilled the batter overnight and baked the cookies on my dark nonstick sheets for about 9 minutes. I even made a batch using indulgent trail mix I picked up at the store. Thanks again Grandma!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wonderful salsa

this is the best salsa recipe i've found so far and i've tried about a dozen. i got it from one of the local hospital cookbooks that are sold in my area. i changed it a bit and have been canning it for years. the reason i plant a garden is for this salsa. we would be lost without it. hope you like it as much as we do.  one of our members who is a food scientist took this salsa to work, tested the ph and found it measured under 4.0 (well within the safety limit for boiling water bath processing).

1. mix all together and bring to a slow boil for 10 minute
2. seal in jars and cook in hot water bath for 10 minute
3. this is a medium salsa
4. this is also a chunky salsa so if you want a smoother salsa cut your veggies into smaller pieces
5. yields 3-6 quarts or pints
demonstrations.review: This is a great basic salsa recipe. I made several jars with the heat I like then added some extra heat to the hubby's I'm shootings for flames coming out everywhere when he eats it.  This was so good my daughter's freind asked for a jar for her birthday!!!! Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mini tacos

these can be a easy appetizer or a light dinner. i received this recipe in an email from the campbell's site, and after we made these for a tasty dinner, i knew i had to share!

1. cook hamburger until browned
2. drain the fat and stir in taco mix and 1 / 2 cup salsa / picante sauce
3. simmer for 3-5 minutes
4. press wonton wrappers into mini muffin cups
5. spoon beef mixture in cups and top with the 3 tbsp of salsa and cheese , evenly divided
6. bake in preheated 425f oven for 8 minutes , or until the wontons are nicely browned
7. serve with extra salsa , sour cream , olives and guacamole if desired
8. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
These are great, my kids LOVE them.  I've made them several times. It's especially good with that homemade salsa.  A great break from the ordinary taco dinner.
Thanks Bekah

target.recipe_text:
penne and smoked sausage

nice and cheesy.

1. cook pasta according to package directions
2. meanwhile , in a large skillet , brown sausage over medium heat for 5 minutes
3. drain
4. in a large bowl , combine milk and soup
5. stir in 1 / 2 cup onions , 1 / 2 cup cheese , peas and sausage
6. drain pasta
7. stir into sausage mixture
8. transfer to a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish
9. cover and bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until bubbly
10. sprinkle with remaining onions and cheese
11. bake , uncovered , 3-5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
target.review: Very, very good!  I omitted the peas as I was raised to believe that starchy greens are not "real" greens...my mother...  I used 2 cups of chopped green bell pepper as I wanted thsi to be a complete meat and veggie meal.  I used FF or LF everything, turkey smoked sausage and regular French Fried onions.  Also added some more spice powders: garlic, onion and a dash or two of cayenne pepper.  I have added this to my recipe tin.  Thanks so much for posting this cost effective meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
macaroni chili   oamc

great for the freezer, easy to reheat. just add a slice of bread with butter and you're good to go.  my version is only 11 grams of fat, the regular is 20 grams.

1. in large skillet cook ground beef , onions and garlic until beef is browned
2. drain
3. in large dutch oven pour in meat mixture , add beans , tomato sauce , tomatoes with juices , marcaroni , water , chili powder and cumin
4. bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. cover and simmer about 10 minutes more or until the macaroni is tender but firm
6. place in containers , sprinkle with cheese and freeze
demonstrations.review: Outstanding!  Such comfort food for me!  I did alter it some....  I used half kidney (light not dark) and half black beans.  I found that I needed twice as much tomato sauce so I added a can of Hunt's Zesty Tomato sauce in the can--- this spicier version didn't add too much italien zest.  I doubled the chili and cumin-- used ground adobo powder.  I used red fat cheddar.  This was just so good!  I have to figure out how to get a pan big enough to tripple recipe next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast burritos  once a month cooking

great for that run in the morning breakfast. you can also take frozen burritos with you when going camping. just place the bag of frozen burritos into the ice chest, and by the time you're ready for breakfast the first morning, the burritos are fully thawed. then simply reheat them in a large skillet over the campstove or fire grate.

1. scramble eggs in large skillet until done
2. stir in cooked sausage and salsa
3. warm tortillas in microwave 20-30 seconds or until warm and flexible
4. place 1 / 2 cup egg mixture into tortilla
5. roll burrito-style
6. freeze burritos in single layer on lightly greased cookie sheet
7. when fully frozen , wrap burritos individually
8. place wrapped burritos in large zip-top freezer bags
9. freeze
10. to serve: unwrap burritos from foil or plastic wrap that you used for freezing
11. wrap in a paper towel
12. cook in microwave until heated through
13. or thaw burritos , wrap burritos in foil , and bake at 350 degrees for ten minutes
demonstrations.review: These were great, Trish!  I reheat mine as you mention below but then I place it in my sandwich maker for another 3 minutes to get the top and bottom nice and crispy.  This is going in my regular rotation!  Thanks, Trish

demonstrations.recipe_text:
awesome artichoke dip

my friend made this at a party and i just had to have her recipe. this is the best artichoke dip that i have ever tasted. you might want to double the recipe because this stuff will go very quickly!  i've made this several times now and the key is to rinse the spinach well before putting it in the recipe.  otherwise you will have green dip!  other cheeses, and cheese blends work fine in place of the parmesan.  however, i feel the parmesan gives the best flavor combination.  fresh lemon juice really makes this recipe different from other spinach artichoke dips and adds a much needed zing to the recipe.  its also best to use the freshest garlic you can get your hands on.

1. preheat your oven to 375 degrees
2. grease a 7x11 baking dish in a medium bowl mix cream cheese and mayo until smooth add chopped artichokes , chopped spinach and parmesan
3. add lemon juice and minced garlic mix together well
4. for a smoother texture , pulse in a food processor until the desired texture is achieved
5. this will also help mix things more completely and give a better fusion of flavors
6. bake covered with aluminum foil for 20 minutes
7. during the last 5 minutes of baking remove the foil
8. the top should be golden brown around the edges when it is done
9. serve while hot with tortilla chips , fresh veggies , or italian bread
demonstrations.review: Very good even with my FF ingredients.  I think I added some garlic, onion and cayenne pepper but just to my taste.  It's a guilt free yummy pleasure for me and includes good for you veggies.  Ate this with Baked Tostito Scoops and it felt guilty yet not bad for me at all.  Thanks for this keeper!

target.recipe_text:
chicken lime taquitos

these are absolutely to die for!!! they are not your ordinary taquitos. they're so good, i don't even use guacamole with them, although some still prefer them that way. remember to get all your veggies in long thin strips. time includes marinating.

1. combine first 5 ingredients for marinade
2. marinate chicken in mixture for at least 2 hours
3. drain chicken well and grill until done
4. allow to cool and shred into 1 / 8 inch by 3 inch pieces
5. place chicken in bowl and sprinkle with salt and minced garlic
6. mix well
7. add red pepper , pasilla , onion , cheese and 1 / 2 ounce lime juice
8. mix thoroughly
9. to assemble , warm tortilla on griddle until soft and pliable
10. if necessary , add a little oil to the pan to help soften the tortillas
11. spoon 2 ounces of chicken filling over tortilla and roll tightly , securing with toothpick
12. deep-fry in oil at 350f for 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
13. drain well
14. serve with guacamole , sour cream , and or salsa
target.review: I guess since I am coming back to make this recipe AGAIN I should write a review.  I don't always make the taquitos but this is my go to recipe to marinade the chicken.  It's always nice to hear your kids say "mmmmmmm... you should make this more often."  Thanks for a great recipe.  No tweaks from me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork tenderloin   thai style

this asian style tenderloin takes very little time to prepare, but looks and tastes like a lot of work went into it. the recipe as is serves two, but doubles well if you are serving more people. i serve with chili-garlic paste on the side. prep time includes marinating time.

1. cut tenderloin in half lengthwise
2. in a ziplock bag , combine wine , soy sauce , pepper flakes , ginger , garlic , fish sauce , lime juice and brown sugar
3. place the pork tenderloin in the marinade
4. place in refrigerator for 1 / 2 hour , turning occasionally
5. remove meat from marinade , reserving marinade
6. heat oil in skillet
7. brown tenderloin pieces on all sides
8. cook until almost done
9. remove from skillet and place on cutting board
10. place marinade into the same skillet and bring to a simmer
11. while simmering , cut tenderloin into 1 inch slices
12. return to skillet and cook until the meat is no longer pink
13. if desired thicken sauce with a mixture of cornstarch and cold water
14. serve meat and sauce over steamed jasmine rice
15. garnish with red pepper , cilantro , green onions and lime wedges
16. sprinkle with peanuts
demonstrations.review: I was surprised how good this was!  I omitted the cilantro and fish oil because I didn't have any and used instant brown rice.  Also powdered ginger since I didn't have any fresh.  I've tried using pork tenderloin in other oriental recipes and have always been disappointed.  I will definitely make this again, thank you for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked greek chicken salad

for zaar tour 6.

1. place chicken breasts in a baking dish
2. sprinkle with spice mixture , recipe #425441
3. mix together lemon juice and melted butter
4. pour over chicken
5. bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hour , basting , until done , depending on size of your chicken
6. slice chicken into strips
7. toss lettuce , tomato , cucumber , onion , feta cheese , black olives , and fresh spinach
8. cover with the cooked chicken strips
9. mix lemon juice and oil and pour over salad unless you use the creamy greek dressing
10. if you need a salad dressing other than the lemon and oil one here , you can try recipe #59898 from evelyn of athens
demonstrations.review: Yum!  Used the Greek spice recipe as suggested and the creamy Greek salad dressing as well.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey cornbread

this is a delicious, moist, sweet cornbread that everyone will love. a family favorite that i have made for years.

1. in a bowl , combine flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. in a small mixing bowl , beat the eggs
3. add cream , oil and honey
4. beat well
5. stir into the dry ingredients just until moistened
6. pour into a greased 9-inch baking pan
7. bake at 400f for 20- 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: Very moist and delicious.  I also used 1% milk instead of the cream.  Its a keeper!

target.recipe_text:
lemon lush dessert

i am sooo craving this right now.

1. mix and spread the butter and flour together in bottom of 13x9x2 dish
2. flatten out
3. bake at 350 for 20 minutes
4. cool
5. combine powdered sugar , cream cheese , and 2 cups of the cool whip until well mixed
6. spread over crust
7. mix lemon pudding and milk
8. spread over cream cheese mixture
9. chill
10. serve with remaining cool whip
target.review: I added finely grated lemon peel to the cream cheese layer.  It was perfect!  Everyone loved it.  Will definitely make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s 100  whole wheat air buns  rolls   for abm

i find most 100% whole wheat buns are very dense, and let's be frank, taste like the floor of a barn. this recipe is an adaptation of my "mom's air buns" #168628, and makes delicious, soft, healthy,and easy to make rolls. i think the unusual addition of vinegar is what makes the difference.
edited to include links to recipe#419620, and recipe#419622 for those of you who wish to make whole wheat loaves instead of buns...same great taste and texture!
for those unfamiliar with how to shape rolls, you may find it helpful to look at the following links for instructions: http://www.recipetips.com/kitchen-tips/t--1121/shaping-rolls.asp 
http://www.finecooking.com/articles/shaping-dinner-rolls.aspx

1. put water , butter , honey , salt and vinegar in the machine
2. in the bottom of a one cup measure , put 2 tablespoons of gluten , and then fill the cup with w
3. w
4. flour
5. put that , and another 3 1 / 2 cups of flour on top of the liquids
6. add yeast to surface , and programme for "dough" cycle
7. i make two 9 inch pans of rolls , each with 9 rolls per pan , and let rise until double
8. bake at 350f for approximately 20 minutes
9. rolls will be deeply golden and oh so yummy
demonstrations.review: Even my daughter who doesn't like whole-wheat rolls loved these.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brown sugar bundt cake

my mom passed this recipe along to me. it is easy to make and has been a big hit at home and at the office. i get frequent requests for the recipe. it is very moist and delicious and makes a good breakfast cake as well as a dessert. increase nuts by another 1/3 cup if you like nuts!

1. grease a 10-inch bundt pan well and sprinkle pan with granulated sugar
2. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. combine cake mix , pudding mix , eggs , oil and water in large bowl and beat on medium speed until well mixed , about 4 minutes
4. add brown sugar and pecans and mix to combine well
5. pour batter evenly into prepared bundt pan and bake for 1 hour or until cake tester comes out clean
6. place bundt pan on wire rack and cool 15 minutes
7. invert cake onto rack and slip pan off cake
8. let cool on rack
9. can be stored covered at room temperature
demonstrations.review: Incredible!  My family died over it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon shrimp pasta

cooking for 2? this is the recipe for you. i have also doubled it for 4. it is elegant and light. have no clue where i got the original recipe. i have had it for a very long time.

1. coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
2. add oil and place over medium-high heat until hot
3. add minced garlic and saute 15 seconds
4. add shrimp and saute until pink
5. add peas and carrot
6. saute 1 minute , remove from skillet and set aside
7. add broth and cream cheese to skillet
8. cook over medium-high heat 3 minutes or until cheese melts , stirring constantly with a wire whisk
9. stir in shrimp mixture , farfalle , and next 4 ingredients
10. cook 1 minute
11. if desired , garnish with chives
demonstrations.review: Yummy!  Made perfect with a squeeze of fresh lemon and a few pine nuts.

target.recipe_text:
zucchini chocolate cake

don't you just love it when you can get your daily vegetable requirements from the dessert you eat? and a chocolate dessert at that!

1. cream butter then add oil and sugar
2. mix
3. add next 8 ingredients
4. mix well
5. fold in the chips and nuts by hand
6. put in a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
7. bake at 325 for 1 hour or until done
target.review: As most gardeners, I had an abundance of large zucchini this summer and found this a great way to use it.  I've made this about five times with rave reviews from those who've tried it.  I usually add a tablespoon of instant espresso crystals to boost the chocolate flavor.  The last time I made a couple of substitutions to increase the nutritional value.  I substituted 1/2 cup of ground almond meal for 1/2 cup of flour and added 4 tablespoons of soy protein power.  There was little difference in the finished cake - still delicious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gingered spareribs with brown sugar and soy

i love this sweet gingery dish. it is easy to make and is versatile using other meats. this is delicious served over a bed of steamed rice. this is one of my families favorites.

1. heat oil in large wide shallow pot over medium-high heat
2. working in batches , add ribs and brown on all sides , about 8 minute
3. transfer ribs to a large bowl
4. add garlic and ginger to pot
5. saut 30 seconds
6. add brown sugar , vinegar , and soy sauce
7. stir to blend
8. return ribs to pot
9. cover pot and simmer over medium-low heat until meat is tender , turning ribs occasionally , about 45 minutes
10. if sauce is thin , gradually add cornstarch mixture to ribs and simmer until sauce thickens slightly , about 2 minutes
11. serve ribs over rice
demonstrations.review: I really liked this recipe but my family only thought it was so, so.  Will keep it and maybe try it again and see if they like it better next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana oat muffins

nan

1. combine first 6 dry ingredients in large bowl
2. mix well
3. beat egg , banana and melted butter together in small bowl until smooth
4. add banana mixture to dry ingredients
5. stir just until moistened
6. stir in nuts , if desired
7. fill greased muffin cups almost full
8. bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes , or until top springs back when lightly touched
demonstrations.review: I made this for breakfast for a houseguest and he and my husband both loved it - me too.  I forgot to add the melted butter but didn't miss it from the recipe.  If you want to save some calories leave out the butter and it will be fine.  I also substituted brown sugar, which gave it a rich flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
a whole chicken on the grill

you can enjoy a moist, flavorful grilled chicken, complete with succulent juices, even without a spit. don't truss this bird, because the legs won't cook evenly when pressed up against the body. from the new basics cookbook! spanish inspired.

1. prepare hot coals for grilling
2. stir all the ingredients , except chicken , together in a bowl until smooth
3. brush the chicken well with the sauce
4. grill the chicken over low heat , preferably covered , for about 1 hour and 10 minutes
5. let the chicken stand 10 minutes before carving and serving
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was easy and looked lovely when cooked, however my family only thought it was OK.  It seemed to need something - maybe some salt or butter or something in the sauce to make it more savory.

target.recipe_text:
chunky chili con carne

nan

1. in medium skillet over medium-high heat , brown beef and onion , stirring to separate meat
2. spoon off fat
3. add soup , water , beans , vinegar and chilies
4. reduce heat to low and heat through
5. last half hour add tomato paste and heat
target.review: I enjoyed this recipe..It was very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
basil skillet scalloped potatoes

you may want to use milk in place of water

1. in large skillet over medium heat , melt margarine
2. cook onion with basil until tender
3. add soup , water and cheese
4. reduce heat to low
5. heat until cheese is melted , stirring often
6. add potatoes
7. heat through , stirring occasionally
demonstrations.review: The Best Scalloped Potatoes I've ever had!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken sausages and peppers with pasta

the pasta is the won you like. (;o)

1. cut chicken into thin bite-size strips
2. set aside
3. in a 12-inch skillet cook sausage for 5 minutes , stirring to brown on all sides
4. remove from skillet , reserving 2 tablespoons drippings
5. in same skillet cook chicken for 2 to 3 minutes or until browned
6. remove from skillet
7. cook sweet peppers and onion wedges in remaining drippings for 3 minutes
8. return sausage and chicken to skillet
9. add undrained tomatoes , wine , italian seasoning , salt , and black pepper
10. bring to boiling
11. reduce heat
12. cover and simmer for 10 minutes
13. stir cornstarch into tomato juice or water
14. stir into skillet
15. cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly
16. cook and stir for 2 minutes more
17. serve sauce over pasta
18. makes 4 servings
demonstrations.review: Wonderful

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious tomato sauce  spaghetti

mom made this for use for years. my grandkids love it.

1. in a deep saute pan
2. saute garlic in oil
3. add remainder of ingredients , but meat balls
4. bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 2 1 / 2-3 hours
5. the longer you simmer the thicker the sauce
6. last 15 minutes add meat balls
7. serve over fresh cooked spaghetti
demonstrations.review: Just like my mother used to make wonderful.

target.recipe_text:
madeline s favorite corn

this is my niece's favorite corn dish. we like it too.

1. in a large pot , add in corn and water
2. bring mixture to a boil
3. lower heat
4. cover and simmer for 4-6 minutes or until corn is tender
5. drain corn and put in a serving bowl
6. add the remaining ingredients and stir well to combine
target.review: A little late getting in this review. I made this corn dish for Thanksgiving. It was very popular with my family and there was none left-over. I thought the different herbs went together well and gave an interesting and delicious flavor. I usually cook whole-kernel corn with a little butter and salt but this was very good and a nice change from usual. Thanks Nurse di.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
50  whole wheat bread

this is our "everyday" lunch bread. i make it every night for the next day. i originally got it from the oster bread machine recipe book but i adapted it somewhat. the 100% whole wheat recipe was just too heavy for our family. it makes a 2 lb loaf. once i started making this bread, i couldn't go back to store bought!

1. put the ingredients into the bread machine pan in the order listed
2. select the whole wheat bread cycle
3. remove from the pan when it's done and let cool for 15 minutes before slicing
4. during the summer i reduce the yeast to 1 tsp because it seems to rise so much more during the summer than the winter
5. or you could increase the salt slightly so if you're getting a really huge loaf try one of these 2 things and it should be better for you
6. for some reason atmospheric pressure makes a difference in how a bread rises
7. enjoy !
8. thanks for all your great reviews ! another thing i've been doing to make this even healthier is adding 2 tablespoons of ground flax seed with the flour
9. it doesn't really change the flavour but adds some good for you omega 3s !
demonstrations.review: This makes one excellent loaf of bread. I used molasses and loved the touch of flavor it gave. I am trying to get away from plain white bread so will use this recipe instead of buying bread from the store. Had a nice texture. Thank-you for posting this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
granny s tea cakes

a granny special.

1. cream shortening in a large bowl
2. gradually add 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer
3. add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
4. combine flour and next 3 ingredients
5. add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk
6. mix well
7. stir in extract
8. cover and chill 1 hour
9. roll dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness on a floured surface
10. cut with a 2 3 / 4 inch round cookie cutter
11. place on greased cookie sheets
12. bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until edges begin to brown
13. sprinkle with sugar , if desired
demonstrations.review: My niece and her friends wanted to have a "real" tea party. I made these to serve the young ladies and they were so delicious. A soft, melt in your mouth cookie with a delicate almond flavor. Squeals of delight from the little girls and me!!. Thanks you Nurse Di.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bbq caribbean beef kabobs

now this is tasty! you can use the same marinade for chicken but make more marinade and reserve before you put the chicken in it, discard the marinade that you used on the chicken and use only the reserved marinade for basting, i like to serve these kabobs with bbq'd veggie kabobs and potatoes done on the grill too (there will be other recipes for the veggies and bbq potatoes on zaar)

1. whisk the marinade ingredients to gether
2. pour into a zip lock bag and add the meat
3. marinade in the fridge from 8 to 24 hours , turning the bag every so often
4. reserve the marinade
5. thread the cubes on skewers
6. grease your grill
7. medium-high heat , baste occasionally
8. cook for 7-10 minutes
9. the meat should be browned outside and still pink inside
demonstrations.review: I used this marinade on both beef and chicken kabobs. Wonderful stuff. The blend of spices was exquisite. Both meats were tender and juicy. We also grilled some vegetable kabobs. Thanks Bergy for a keeper.

target.recipe_text:
homemade chicken pot pie

this recipe is a combination of a southern living recipe and my grandmother's recipe.  i used short cuts when they worked and this is a recipe that my whole family loves. even when older kids leave for college, they beg to take some of this with them! all ages love this and the house smells great!  great comfort food!  line your oven with foil paper; there is a lot of filling. or you can divide it and make one pot pie for now and one for later!

1. saute potatoes in margarine for 5 minutes in a dutch oven
2. add onion , celery and thawed frozen vegetables
3. saute for another 10 minutes
4. add flour gradually to the sauteed mixture , stirring constantly for one minute
5. allow refrigerated pie crust to come to room temperature
6. meanwhile , combine chicken broth and half and half
7. gradually stir into the vegetable mixture
8. cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
9. stir in salt and pepper
10. add chopped chicken , stirring well
11. add additional salt and pepper to taste
12. preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
13. spray a 9 x 13 casserole with nonstick spray
14. place pie crust on the bottom of the pan to cover , cutting to fit
15. pour chicken / vegetable mixture over the pie crust
16. top with the remaining pie crust
17. cut vents in the top crust
18. bake for 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown
19. enjoy !
target.review: This turned out really good. I did use a little of Paula Deen's poultry seasoning and next time I think I will uses puff pastry and make enough to freeze. This would  excellent for family gatherings. I will definitely make this again

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simply sour cream chicken enchiladas

easy to assemble, deliciously creamy and a great choice for once-a-month cooking. and there is no canned cream soup in my enchiladas -- hope you give them a try!

1. in a frying pan , cook chicken and onion together in oil over medium-high heat until chicken is just done
2. divide cooked chicken evenly between 8 tortillas
3. add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese to each tortilla
4. roll enchiladas and place seam-side down in a 9x13" baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with no-stick cooking spray
5. melt butter in a medium saucepan
6. stir in flour to make a roux , stir and cook until bubbly , and gradually whisk in chicken broth then bring to boiling , stirring frequently
7. remove from heat
8. stir in sour cream and green chilies
9. pour sauce evenly over enchiladas
10. top with remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese and bake at 400 f for 20 minutes until cheese is melted and sauce near edges of baking dish is bubbly
demonstrations.review: Really good I added salsa to the chicken while frying in small pieces , half can of rotel tomatoes with green chilis

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fish tacos and cilantro coleslaw  20 minutes max

this is one of my best-kept secrets recipe for serving a healthy, easy and really flavorful dinner in about 20 minutes.

1. bake fish fillets according to package directions
2. wrap the tortillas in aluminum foil and place them in the oven to heat
3. or heat them at the last minute in a microwave in plastic wrap
4. shred or chop the cabbage
5. in a medium bowl , combine the cabbage with all the remaining ingredients
6. cut each hot fish fillet into 6-8 pieces , then pile into a hot tortilla with lots of slaw
demonstrations.review: This is soooo good on fish taco's. My husband takes tilapia spices it with alt pepper and spicy seasonings and a sqeeze of lemon before and after. Cooks it in a steam bag, topped with this slaw its excellent. I put a liitle jalepeno and tomato. Yummy for my tummy:)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramelized baked chicken legs wings

delicious! yummy  caramelized legs, kids love these! so quick and easy and no marinating required. just prepare the sauce, pour over the chicken and pop in the oven!  i actually like this with wings better ;-)
 

very important to leave it in the oven until it has caramelized to avoid disappointment. 

thank you to everyone for their positive reviews!

try adding sambal oelek as chef  #27416 has suggested in his review. what a great idea ;-)

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit or 180 degrees celsius
2. place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. mix together the oil , soy sauce , ketchup , honey , garlic , salt and pepper
4. pour over the chicken
5. bake in preheated oven for one hour , or until sauce is caramelized
6. could also use wings or pork ribs
demonstrations.review: Everybody loved this. My daughter said the room was quiet lol. I removed the sauce after and boiled it with a little cornstarch poured it back over and baked it at 385 for 10 minutes after cooking and basting at 350 for 1 hour. Will make many more times

target.recipe_text:
sourdough  bread starter

this is your basic sour dough bread starter to be used over and over again. look for the sour dough bread recipe to make use of this starter.
there are two ways to make sour dough starter one without yeast where you feed the starter daily and this recipe where you just let the yeast do the work and  let it sit for 3 or 4 days. be sure that you clean the jar well before putting the saved starter back in it.

1. dissolve yeast in 1 / 2 cup warm water , rest for ten minutes
2. mix in flour , sugar& remaining water
3. allow to stand , loosely covered , in a warm place for 3 or 4 days
4. use a large bowl as it will rise considerably
5. every time the batter is used to make a product set aside 1 cup to be used as a"starter" for another batch
6. keep covered in the fridge
7. to make it into a basic batter again , add another 2 cups flour& 2 cups warm water and allow to stand at room temp overnight it is now ready to use , but again reserve a cup of the starter
target.review: Makes wonderful sour bread.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blackberry jam bars

nan

1. cream butter , gradually add sugar , beating well
2. combine flour , soda and salt , add to creamed mixture , mixing well
3. stir in oats
4. press half of mixture into a lightly greased 8-inch square an
5. top mixture with jam , spreading to within a 1 / 4 inch of edge
6. press remaining crumb mixture on top
7. bake at 400 for 30 minutes
8. cool , cut into bars
demonstrations.review: Wonderful, the kids loved them!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker cheesy chicken

almost too easy, the chicken cooks in a creamy, cheesy sauce that is delicious over noodles. this freezes well, too

1. place chicken breasts in the crock pot
2. mix the undiluted soups together with the garlic powder and pour over chicken
3. cover and cook on low 6-8 hours , until chicken is tender
4. serve with the delicious sauce over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: My very favorite crock pot meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick and easy baked ziti

this is a quick dish i like to make when i need to get dinner on the table in a hurry. if you like a zestier ziti, use a hot italian sausage. note: cooking/prep time does not include time for cooking pasta.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. lightly grease a 9x13" baking dish
3. set aside
4. in a large saucepan , cook sausage , onions , green pepper , and garlic over medium heat until sausage is browned
5. drain fat
6. add pasta sauce and cook until mixture is hot , stirring occasionally
7. add pasta to the sauce mixture and mix well
8. stir in 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese , mixing until well combined
9. pour mixture into the prepared baking dish
10. top with remaining 1 cup mozzarella cheese and the parmesan cheese
11. cover with foil
12. bake at 350f for 15 minutes
13. remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes
