3. meanwhile on stovetop or microwave , warm the bbq sauce up a little for easier spreading
4. remove crust and apply the bbq sauce
5. then apply small pieces of chicken and top with cheese
6. place the pizza back in the oven and bake another 10 minutes or until cheese is all melted
7. remove and slice into squares
demonstrations.review: So simple and delicious. I used grilled boneless chicken thighs seasoned with  "Zatarain's Creole Seasoning" and..just because I had half and avocado I wanted to used up, I chopped it up on top before serving the pizza. I really liked the combo.

target.recipe_text:
cauliflower cheese pot pies

last night i had a craving for cauliflower -- i checked through all my recipes and the only one that sounded satisfying was this one. we made a few changes to it and it turned out like i thought it would! sheer comfort food!!! ;) i am sorry if i have confused you with my ingredient mature cheddar cheese - i have been told to add the word vintage to it so it would be better understood. (in my mind - one is sharp & the other sharper.) ;)

1. preheat the oven to 356f
2. mix the creme fraiche , cheddar cheses , spring onions , cauliflower , peas , & garlic & red pepper flakes
3. season with salt and black pepper , if you choose
4. divide between 4 small ovenproof dishes
5. top with pastry circles , press down firmly and glaze with egg
6. bake for 25-30 minutes until crisp and golden
target.review: I made this delectable dish last night, and am rating it 5 despite confusion with the 2nd and 3rd ingredient.  I have not heard the term mature cheddar, and manami said I could use sharp, but then sharp is listed for 1 oz as a third ingredient.  So I ended up using 3 1/4 oz sharp cheddar, and  1 oz. parmesan cheese, and it was scrumptious.  Thanks for a different but easy dish that my family raved over.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blackberry sauce  for desserts

this sauce is yummy over cakes, custards, etc. enjoy! servings are just an estimate... it really depends on how much (or how little) you use :-)

1. wash blackberries and put them in a bowl with the granulated sugar
2. mash the berries with a fork to bring the juices out
3. in another bowl , mix together thoroughly the butter and powdered sugar
4. stir in the egg white , stiffly beaten , and add the berries just before serving
5. you can serve this over custards , ice creams , cakes-- your favorite desserts !
demonstrations.review: This was delicious.  My only problem was that the soft butter didn't integrate completely, so there were tiny globules present in the dark sauce.  Don't know what I did wrong--I don't see without complete melting how I could mix it well enough.  But the taste was scrumptious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
macaroni and cauliflower cheese bake

sourced from the recipe section of a friends woman's day magazine.  i have a hankering for anything with cauliflower lately.  you could substitute other vegetables if cauliflower is not your thing.

1. preheat oven to 200c / 390f cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling salted water following packet directions
2. add cauliflower half way through cooking time
3. drain well and return to pan
4. in separate pan , melt butter on medium heat , saute onion 3-4 minutes until tender , add flour and cook stirring for one minute
5. remove pan from heat and gradually add milk and thyme and whisk until combined
6. return pan to medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens
7. remove from heat , stir in 1 1 / 2 cups of parmesan and the mustard
8. season to taste
9. add cheese sauce to pasta mixture , stirring to combine
10. transfer to shallow oven proof dish
11. top with bacon , bocconcini and remaining parmesan
12. bake for 25-30 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a filling and yummy dish.  Pure comfort food.  My picky 17-year-old took one bite and said, "ooooh, this is GOOD."  Then she took a second bite and turned to me with a suspicious look in her eye--"this is quite a tricky way to hide cauliflower!"  The vegetable blends in perfectly with the macaroni and cheese--your child will never know it's there until their taste buds have already told them this is delicious.  I gave it 4 stars because while there was nothing that couldn't be worked around, I found it odd to have metric measurements alternating with western.  I also didn't know the boccocino was a mozzarella cheese.  It didn't say whether to cook the bacon, so I assume you are supposed to put it on raw, but I was worried the low cook temperature for only 20-30 minutes would not cook it sufficiently.  So I cooked bacon first and increased the temp anyway to 300 degrees--just seemed necessary to me to heat casserole all the way through in the given time.  But fun and excellent dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
smothered sweet and sour chicken

this recipe is from a book called 365 ways to cook chicken by cheryl sedaker.

1. in a large frying pan , heat oil over medium heat
2. add chicken and cook , turning , until golden brown , about 10 minutes
3. meanwhile , in a small bowl , combine onion , ketchup , vinegar , soy sauce , sugar , pepper and 1 / 2 cup water , blend well
4. pour sweet and sour mixture over chicken
5. cover , reduce heat to low , and cook 20 minutes , until tender
6. remove chicken to a serving platter
7. add cornstarch to 1 / 4 cup cold water , add to sauce
8. raise heat , bring to a boil , and cook , stirring until sauce thickens , about 2 minutes
9. pour over chicken and serve
demonstrations.review: This was a great sauce, but I followed the cooking directions instead of my own instincts as a cook, and the drumsticks were not cooked through (even in my all-clad pan that retains heat really well).  I'd say at least 30 minutes cooking at low.

target.recipe_text:
shrimp and goat cheese grits

this recipe was demonstrated at the 2008 pensacola seafood festival by chef jim shirley of the fish house restaurant.  if you don't like goat cheese, feel free to substitute any cheese that you like.  i've never had anything that jim shirley prepared that wasn't delicious!

1. add stock to a medium saucepan or large skillet and bring to a boil
2. stir in the grits and continue to stir for approximately 4 minutes , then reduce heat to a simmer
3. add cream as needed to keep the grits moist
4. place shrimp in a large ziplock bag with the garlic , red pepper flakes , salt , pepper and lemon zest
5. make sure the spices are mixed well and coating the shrimp , then place the bag in the refrigerator to marinate for 20 minutes
6. after the 20 minutes are up , add butter , goat cheese , parsley and basil to the grits
7. stir and add salt and pepper
8. heat a saute pan to medium high heat
9. in a little butter , add shrimp and saute for 5 minutes , or until shrimp are opaque and form a "c"
10. do not overcook the shrimp !
11. to serve , spoon grits onto a serving plate , and add 4 shrimp and some liquid from the saute pan on top of the grits
target.review: Fan-flipping-tastic! Left out basil and parsley and used a little chive instead otherwise stayed true to recipe. Thank you for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy slow cooker chicken dinner

serve with a green salad, bread and wine, such as, pinot noir or zinfandel for a perfect meal. cook time is 5 to 9 hours.

1. place chicken , carrots and potatoes in slow cooker
2. combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over chicken
3. cover and cook on high about 5 hours or on low for about 9 hours , until chicken leg and thigh come off easily when pulled
demonstrations.review: The chicken had a wonderful flavor and was falling off the bone.  I used thighs instead of a whole chicken because I just didn't need that much. Great for people on the go who still want a homecoooked meal.  Thanks Barb!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy ranch pork chops   rice

an easy and tasty 

1. heat oil in skillet
2. add chops and cook until browned
3. add soup , milk and 1 / 2 pkg
4. salad dressing mix
5. heat to a boil
6. cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes or until done
7. sprinkle with paprika
8. serve with ranch-style rice
9. i've also made this using cream of mushroom with garlic soup and it was wonderful
10. the garlic adds a nice flavour !
demonstrations.review:
This was so good!  And the rice was so simple but delicious too!
Thanks for posting!  It's a keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon  avocado   tomato salad

the chunkier the veggies, the better.  if you want to save on time, use oscar meyer ready to serve bacon.

1. fry bacon until crisp , drain & crumble
2. mix oil , vinegar , salt , pepper & hot sauce & pour over avocados
3. toss gently
4. gently fold bacon , tomatoes and onion into avocados
5. cover and refrigerate up to 2 hours
6. serve on lettuce leaves
demonstrations.review: Excellent salad!  I love all the different textures that are in it and the taste is outstanding.  Will be making often.

target.recipe_text:
savory golden lentil and sweet potato soup

the combination of sweet, savory, and spicy flavors makes this hearty (check out that protein and vitamin a content!) but healthy soup a perfect choice for whatever you happen to be in the mood for.  the spices i chose gives it almost an indian or moroccan feel; whichever gastronomic prefix sounds tastier to you.  it serves well both hot and cold and is delicious over some steamed rice or any other starchy filler.

1. soak the lentils in roughly 1 cup of cold water or green tea for at least 30 minutes
2. in a medium-sized stock pot over medium-high heat , saut the diced onions and garlic in 1 / 4 cup of the chicken broth until the onions become translucent
3. add the carrots , sweet potatoes , and red wine
4. cook for around 1 minute or until the wine becomes very fragrant
5. add the lentils , water , and chicken broth
6. bring to a rolling boil , stirring the mixture occasionally
7. reduce the heat
8. add the red pepper flakes and fennel seed and cover , allowing the soup to simmer for about 20 minutes or until the lentils and sweet potatoes begin to fall apart
9. remove the lid and add the spices
10. if you would like to get a thicker consistency , kick the heat back up and reduce until it hits the desired thickness
11. you may want to adjust the amounts of salt and pepper , depending on your own tastes
12. serve the soup either on its own or over a starch with a dollop of raita or sour cream
13. garnish with whatever you like
target.review:
This was very good! I didn't have any fennel seed on hand. I reduced all seasonings to 1tsp with exception to red flakes at 1/2tsp, cayenne at 1/2tsp, and cumin at 1tbs and 1tsp. I also added a tsp of tumeric.
I let it simmer an extra hour so it was nice and think and served over rice that I had cooked with curry powder.
My 9month old twins went NUTS over this, they loved it! Mommy, daddy and my in laws did too. My 8 year old... well he ate it :)
Thanks for a wonderful recipe that tastes great and made my home smell amazing. Will use this one again for sure!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegan fudge

nan

1. lightly grease a 5x9-inch loaf pan using a little of the margarine
2. place the remaining margarine , sugar , cocoa , vanilla , and soy milk in a heatproof mixing bowl , or the upper part of a double boiler
3. place the bowl or boiler over simmering water and stir until smooth
4. add the nuts if desired
5. pour the mixture quickly into the prepared pan
6. chill thoroughly and cut into squares
7. chill at least one hour , but for best results chill overnight as the fudge will be firmer and more like regular fudge
demonstrations.review: YUM! This is so easy to make, and is delicious. We make it in double batches.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panera s cream cheese potato soup

this is my favorite recipe for potato soup.  it's a copycat of the one they use to serve at the st. louis bread company (panera).  the recipe originally called for shredding your potatoes, but i never could get them to cook that way. i know they should cook faster, but i never could get it to work.

1. combine broth , potatoes , and spices
2. boil on medium heat until potatoes are tender
3. smash a few of the potatoes to release their starch for thickening
4. reduce to low heat
5. add cream cheese
6. heat , stirring frequently , until cheese melts
demonstrations.review: So simple yet so delicious! I made it vegan by using vegetable broth and Tofutti "better then cream cheese". I also added broccoli. Yum!! Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lentil sloppy joes

a grown-up version to the sloppy joe

1. cook beef , onions , and garlic in large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink
2. drain
3. add water , tomato sauce , lentils , ketchup , vinegar , mustard and pepper
4. bring to a boil
5. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 60-70 minutes till lentils are tender
6. serve on buns
demonstrations.review:
Yum! I rated it a 4 because my family liked it but didn't rave about it. My toddlers wouldn't eat it and my oldest child didn't hate it :)
I thought it was REALLY good! I appreciate the comments about it being bland. I added a vegetable bouillon cube to the water, and about 4oz green chilis. Since lentils are best when they soak up flavors I cooked the ground turkey, onion and garlic then put all ingredients in the crockpot on high for 3.5hrs. Texture was great. I love lentils and was really happy with this.

target.recipe_text:
pizza skillet

a quick and easy supper for the working moms and dads out there. this is one the kids will like.

1. cook noodles as package directs , drain
2. set aside
3. in skillet brown beef and onion
4. drain
5. add tomato sauce , spaghetti sauce mix and water
6. bring to a boil
7. cover , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
8. stir in cooked noodles
9. top with cheese , cover and cook on low for 5 minutes , until cheese melts
target.review: Very easy and tasty.  Although I altered it slightly.  Instead of the 8oz can of tomato sauce I used a 15oz can of Hunt's tomato sauce for pizza and cut up 2 Hormel pepperoni sticks that I added at the same time of the sauce, spaghetti mix and water.  The recipe didn't call for a specific type of noodle so I chose rotini noodles and used about half the box.  My daughter said this is her new favorite recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian ground beef dinner

this quick italian supper is great on a busy day. lots of flavor.

1. mix the first 7 ingredients
2. add ground beef , and 3 t parmesan and mix well
3. shape into 6 patties
4. brown patties for 2 minutes per side
5. mix tomato sauce and italian seasoning , pour over patties
6. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
7. place spaghetti on plate
8. add pattie , and spoon sauce over
9. sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: Wow......delicious!!  The only change I made was I doubled the tomato sauce and Italian seasoning so we could have more sauce over the noodles.  It was wonderful!  I can't wait for lunch today because I brought some leftovers!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
betty white s chicken wings

from my celebrity recipe collection; they sound perfect for a football party!  the smell while these sticky wings bake in the oven is amazing.

1. arrange wings in shallow baking pan
2. heat butter , soy sauce , sugar , water mustard and garlic powder if using , until butter and sugar melt
3. cool
4. pour over wings and marinate at least 2 hours , turning once or twice
5. bake in same pan at 375f for 1-1 / 4 to 1-1 / 2 hours , turning occasionally
6. drain on paper towels and serve
demonstrations.review: These are excellent!  I made 6 lbs of wings, doubled the sauce recipe but took the advice of others and reduced the soy sauce to 1 1/2 cups (as recipe was doubled).  I used  two 9x13 glass baking pans, baked for 40 min, turned the wings, poured off half the sauce (as another poster suggested) and baked for another 35 min.  They came out browned nicely, sticky and fall off the bone good.  I will definitely be making these again.  Thanks for posting Lennie!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
i ve died   gone to heaven chicken slow cooker   crock pot

are you ready for tasty goodness?  get out that crock pot, slow cooker or multi-cooker & come along with me!

1. in a medium bowl- mix onion soup mix , milk , cream of mushroom soup & rice together
2. set aside
3. in your slow cooker- spray lightly with non- stick spray & lay chicken breasts at bottom
4. place 1 tablespoon of butter on each breast & pour soup mix over top
5. season with s & p & sprinkle with the parmesan cheese
6. turn crock pot on low & cook for 8 - 10 hours , or until chicken cooked throughout & ready to eat !
demonstrations.review: This recipe deserves 10 stars!  It was very delicious and my whole family loved it!  Very easy to make and I had all the ingredients on hand, although I substituted the cream of mushroom soup for cream of chicken and cream of celery since my family doesn't like mushrooms. I will definitely make this again, thanks for sharing Foxxyladyone!

target.recipe_text:
sauteed spinach and portabella mushrooms

this recipe is delicious and loaded with nutritional value.  this goes well with a roast, fish, pasta and can be eaten alone as a light meal with a nice crusty bread to soak up the juices.  i made this up myself for a mushroom loving friend.  the best spinach to use is the flat spinach, stems removed.  slice the portabellas into medium pieces, including the stems, which should be sliced separately.   i use a lot of garlic, but that can be adjusted to taste.  this recipe needs to be made quickly, so make sure all the ingredients are prepped in advance.  do not substitute red wine for the whte wine.  if you don't have white wine, just make this without it.

1. wash and stem spinach and mushrooms
2. slice mushrooms including stems
3. mince garlic
4. heat pan with olive oil
5. add garlic and saute one minute
6. add mushrooms and saute for a few minutes
7. add spinach in batches , so pan doesn't get too crowded
8. add salt and pepper to taste
9. add parsley
10. add white wine and stir ingredients one final time
11. serve hot
target.review: Wonderful recipe! I omitted parsley and only used a 10 oz bag of spinach (curly leaf, which worked fine), but kept everything else the same. I drained off the liquid before serving. This is very, very good and I will make it again and again. The only suggestion I have is that you might want to use more than one pan at a time. I only used 10 oz of spinach and by the time it was all cooked, some of it seemed to be slightly overdone.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sugared cranberries and sage leaves

these would be great as either a garnish for sweet potatoes or meat platters, or just as snacks. bon appetit nov/07. cooking times do not include 3 hours drying.

1. bring water and 1 / 2 cup sugar to a boil in a small heavy saucepan , stirring until sugar has dissolved , then simmer , uncovered , 2 minutes
2. remove from heat
3. put remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in a small bowl
4. lightly brush cranberries and both sides of sage leaves with sugar syrup , then immediately roll in sugar
5. transfer to a lightly oiled rack and dry at room temperature , 2 to 3 hours
6. cooks'
demonstrations.review: I used this method to make sugared strawberries and they turned out beautifully. Very good and easy method for sugaring if you don't want to use egg whites. I will definitely use this method again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potion   9

this is a very good drink that i like to recommend when i'm bartending. it's not too sweet, but fruity and refreshing.

1. fill pint or sour glass full of ice
2. add vodka , chambord , cranberry juice and stir with a cocktail stirrer
3. float 1 / 2 oz 7up on top and garnish with a lemon twist
demonstrations.review: I increased the 7-Up (used diet, actually) to one oz. and omitted the raspberry Chambord. In addition, I didn't have any lemons, so I added a dash of lemon juice. This was a wonderful drink. It reminded me of fruit punch. Loved it, and will definitely make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dragon tofu

a wonderful vegetarian delight...i hope! i haven't tried it yet, so if you do, please let me know how you like it.  prep time includes standing tofu at room temp for 20 minutes.

1. whisk soy sauce into peanut butter in small bowl
2. press tofu lightly between paper towels
3. cut into 3 / 4" squares or triangles
4. place in single layer in shallow dish
5. pour soy sauce mixture over tofu
6. stir gently to coat all surfaces
7. let stand at room teperature for 20 minutes
8. cut zucchini and yellow squash lengthwise into 1 / 4" thick slices
9. cut each slice into 2x1 / 4" strips
10. heat nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
11. add peanut and chili oils
12. heat until hot
13. add garlic , zucchini and yellow squash
14. stir-fry for 3 minutes
15. add tofu mixture
16. cook 2 minutes or until tofu is heated through and sauce is slightly thickened , stirring ocasionally
17. stir in spinach
18. remove from heat
19. sprinkle with cashews if desired
demonstrations.review: This dish was quite good and very easy to prepare. Substitutions I made were: instead of zucchini and squash I used red and yellow peppers. I also used extra hot chili oil. It was very good. Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
west indies fish cakes with curry aioli

the light, slightly crispy fish cakes can be a welcome change to any caribbean meal. use the accompaning curry aioli (lots of garlic flavor there!) with it or use your favorite tartar sauce. note: if using salt cod, you will have to soak that for several days in water, changing out the water about every 6 hours until the saltiness goes away (refrigerated). then you will need to remove any bones, skin and cartilage if they are present, before boiling and flaking your fish. enjoy!

1. you can prepare the aioli in advance if you wish
2. place all ingredients for the curry aioli in a food processor or blender and puree until smooth and creamy
3. set aside
4. mix all ingredients for fish cakes together in a mixing bowl until blended
5. adjust water or flour , if necessary , to achieve a consistency similar to pancake batter
6. heat 1-2 inches cooking oil in a large skillet until hot
7. spoon or drop approximately 1 / 4 cup fish cake batter into hot oil and cook about 2-3 minutes per side or until golden , puffy , and firm
8. do not overcrowd pan
9. drain fish cakes on paper toweling
10. serve fish cakes hot with curry aioli or tartar sauce , and lemon slices , if desired
target.review: A first class recipe and I am looking forward to making them again with the *right* ingredients. True to form I did not have all the stuff I needed so I improvised. First off I had left over Dover sole so I used that. Then I had no cayenne pepper so I compensated with a little bit more curry powder and a smidge of chil powder. Of course I had no scallions so substituted dried onion flakes (I need to go to the store badly!!). Anyway they were excellent but I am sure they will be even better when I cook them again properly. However it does prove you can mix and match and these still rock!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
authentic italian tomato sauce

this is a recipe i got from my father who got it from a little old lady he knew from italy. i always simmer this sauce with my meatballs (recipe posted). you can also add sausage if you like. this sauce is to die for!!!!

1. in a large pot , saut onion and garlic in olive oil
2. empty plum tomatoes into large bowl and squash with your hands
3. add all ingredients to pot and simmer for 3 hours
demonstrations.review: OMG!  I am not suprised this has so many ratings it is sooooooo good. Ther is total room for improvisation also which is great. For one thing I did my second batch on low in the crock pot and it was outstanding. I have also increaesed the amount of cheese which works too. I am not too keen on cloves so I have not added them in with any of the sauces I made and I increased the garlic as I love garlic. I am busy cooking some now with some sun dried tomatoes added so we will see how that turns out. It freezes well too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy bisquick chicken pot pie

this is so good and easy to make.  the recipe came from the back of the bisquick mix package.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. bottom crust:
3. cut 2 tablespoons butter into 1 cup bisquick baking mix until mixture resembles fine crumbs
4. stir in 2 tablespoons milk until mixture begins to form a ball and cleans side of bowl
5. pat dough on bottom and up to rim of an ungreased pie plate
6. bake for 5 minutes
7. heat remaining butter in 2 quart saucepan until melted
8. stir in 1 / 4 cup bisquick baking mix , onion and pepper
9. cook , stirring constantly until mixture is bubbly , remove from heat
10. stir in chicken broth
11. add vegetables
12. heat to boiling , stirring constantly
13. boil and stir 1 minute
14. stir in chicken
15. heat through
16. pour chicken mixture into bottom crust
17. mix remaining ingredients until smooth
18. pour evenly over chicken mixture , spread gently to edge
19. bake 25 minutes or until golden brown
20. let stand 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: I loved the pot pie meat and sauce part but I cannot get away with the Bisquick batter type topping, so I replaced that with dumplings and it was very tasty :-)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken curry soup with coconut and lime

anything with coconut and lime just takes me right back to the tropics. i love this soup. it's actually a thai recipe and is very easy and quick create. plus, i usually have these ingredients on hand anyway, so it is also inexpensive. enjoy.

1. bring chicken broth , coconut milk , curry powder and chili to a simmer in a heavy medium saucepan over medium heat
2. add chicken and simmer until chicken is just cooked through , stirring frequently , about 5 minutes
3. mix in lime juice
4. season with salt and pepper
5. divide rice between 4 bowls
6. ladle soup over rice
7. sprinkle with green onions and cilantro
8. pass lime wedges separately
9. serve
demonstrations.review: Excellent for a quick meal. I added some mushrooms and a little fish sauce just because I can't help myself LOL! I give this soup 5 stars and I am making it again tonight!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot stifado

a tasty greek stew, made easy with a crock pot.

1. heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown beef-- in batches if necessary , adding more oil if needed
2. transfer beef to crock pot with a slotted spoon
3. reduce heat to medium and add onions to skillet , cooking until soft
4. add garlic , cinnamon and allspice and cook for 1 minute
5. add vinegar , tomato sauce , sugar and bay leaf and stir well to combine
6. pour mixture over meat
7. cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours , until beef is tender
8. add feta cheese , cover again , and cook on high for 10 minutes
9. discard bay leaf and serve over hot buttered pasta or mashed potatoes
target.review: I've made this atleast a dozen times.  The first time I made it was for my parents.  The second time was for my brother.  He is extremely picky but asked to take home the leftovers! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peanut butter chocolate dessert

mind blowing delicious!! needs to chill at least 3 hours.

1. put 16 cookies in a heavy duty zip-lock bag and crush
2. pour crumbs into a bowl
3. add butter and toss to coat
4. press crumb mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 9-inch square dish
5. in a bowl , beat cream cheese , peanut butter , and 1 cup powdered sugar until smooth
6. fold in half of the cool whip
7. spread over crust
8. sprinkle with chopped peanut butter cups
9. in another bowl , beat the milk , pudding mix and remaining powdered sugar on low for 2 minutes
10. fold in the rest of the cool whip
11. spread over the peanut butter cups
12. crush the remaining cookies and sprinkle over the top
13. cover and chill for at least 3 hours
demonstrations.review: This was a HUGE hit with kids & adults alike last weekend.  I made a 10x14 pan and came home with a clean pan... One kid described it as "heaven on a paper plate"... enough said!  Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
snow cream

lovely project for children, just make sure your snow is from a non-polluted area.

1. add sugar to cream and flavor highly with vanilla
2. stir in newly fallen snow till thick as ice cream just before serving
3. any kind of juice may be substituted instead of cream
demonstrations.review:
I love snow ice cream.  
I use a little less sugar.  
Try substituting canned coconut milk for the cream, YUM!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet potato burritos

serve these vegetarian burrito's with sour cream, chopped green onions and salsa. for vegan burritos, omit the cheese and sour cream

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. heat oil in a medium skillet , and saute onion and garlic in until soft
3. stir in beans , and mash
4. gradually stir in water , and heat until warm
5. remove from heat , and stir in the chili powder , cumin , mustard , cayenne pepper and soy sauce
6. divide bean mixture and mashed sweet potatoes evenly between the warm flour tortillas
7. top with cheese
8. fold up tortillas burrito style
9. bake for 12 minutes in the preheated oven , and serve
demonstrations.review:
Fantastic! 
I made a couple changes for my taste. I deleted the chili powder, substituted Sriracha for the cayenne pepper and left out the cheese.
This recipe is incredibly flexible. 
Thanks for posting.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy tuna or chicken noodle casserole

this is a delicious casserole that can be made using either tuna or 1-1/2 cups or more of cooked cubed chicken or even cooked turkey
 --- for a thinner sauce use 1 cup of milk or half and half instead of 3/4 cup, prep time includes boiling the egg noodles, if you are not a garlic-lover then you may omit the garlic powder and to zing the flavor up even more add in 1-1/2 tablespoons of lemon juice

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. grease a 2-quart casserole dish
3. cook the egg noodles in boiling salted water
4. drain then toss with 2 tablespoons butter
5. in a large saucepan , mix the undiluted mushroom soup , garlic powder , parmesan cheese milk or half and half , sour cream , salt , pepper , chopped onion , pimiento , bell pepper and celery
6. cook over low heat , stirring frequently for 15 minutes
7. add in the tuna or chicken
8. mix to combine
9. combine the mixture with the cooked egg noodles
10. transfer to prepared greased baking dish
11. sprinkle top with the broken ritz crackers
12. bake for about 25 minutes
target.review: well, it only gets a 3 but that's an average. I loved it. It was really creamy and the peppers give it a nice crunch. My husband hated the peppers though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the sweetest blueberry muffins

very tasty and sweet.

1. heat oven to 375
2. grease 18 regular-size muffin cups
3. in bowl , mix butter until creamy
4. add sugar and beat until pale and fluffy
5. add eggs one at a time , beating after each
6. beat in vanilla , baking powder and salt
7. with spoon , fold in half of flour then half of milk into batter
8. repeat
9. fold in blueberries
10. spoon into muffin cups and sprinkle topping onto each muffin
11. bake 15 to 20 minutes , until golden brown and springy to touch
demonstrations.review: These are delicious! Though I totally forgot to put on the topping, which would have made them even better.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
herbed green bean casserole

after finding this recipe in the crisco best recipes -- year-round holiday magic cookbooklet of nov 2003, i tweaked it slightly!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. if using fresh beans , rinse them & cut them into 3"-to'4" pieces , before steaming them for about 15 minutes , or until they are only slightly crisp
3. set beans aside
4. in a large bowl whisk together breadcrumbs , basil , salt , pepper , thyme , oregano , parsley , garlic powder & parmesan cheese
5. add vegetable oil to crumb mixture & stir well , before setting aside 2 tablespoons of the crumb mixture for topping the casserole
6. in an ovenproof dish , combine green beans & crumb mixture , then sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture
7. bake about 30 minutes or until top is golden & crispy
demonstrations.review: Yummy! I wanted something fancier than plain green beans for our Thanksgiving dinner, and this fit the bill. Even the daughter that hates green beans loved this. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese scalloped potatoes

this is a recipe by emeril lagasse (from the essence of emeril show) that my husband enjoys.

1. preheat oven to 350f fry the onion in butter until soft , add flour and whisk in with butter for 2 minutes
2. then whisk in the milk and cook until thick and bubbly
3. remove from heat and add 3 / 4 cup of cheese , stirring until melted
4. season with salt and pepper
5. layer half of potatoes in a small baking dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. cover with half of sauce
7. layer remaining potato slices on top of sauce and season
8. top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with remaining cheese
9. bake , covered , for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender
demonstrations.review: These potatoes sure tasted good, but they took forever to bake. Like Wreckage, I had to bake for almost an hour. I think the dish I baked them in was not the best choice, though. It was one of those round, deep casserole dishes. Next time I'll try it with a shallower rectangle so that the potatoes can be spread out more. I think that will shorten the baking time.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s extreme chocolate brownies

if your looking for an everyday run-of-the-mill cake-style brownie then pass this by, this is a a moist chewy extreme chocolate bakery-style brownie that takes little time to make and tastes even better the next day, it's everything a good brownie should be!  --- i have even made these using half brown sugar and half white sugar, the amount of sugar listed will give you a sweet brownie you may reduce the sugar by 1/4 cup or more if desired or if you have a sweet tooth use amount stated --- add in a couple of tablespoons of coffee-flavored liqueur in place of the vanilla if desired -- according to a reviewer oil may be used in place of the butter successfully --- these brownies freeze very well,  they are so simple to make just mix everything by hand, they bake out so rich and sinful! --- see recipe#89207

1. set oven to 325 degrees f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. in a heavy saucepan , bring butter , sugar and water to a boil , stirring constantly until the butter is melted and sugar is dissolved
4. remove from the heat , with a wooden spoon , stir in 2 cups chocolate chips until melted
5. cool slightly , beat in vanilla
6. in a mixing bowl , whisk eggs , gradually add in the chocolate mixture , beating with a wooden spoon until completely mixed
7. mix together flour , baking soda and salt
8. add to the egg / chocolate mixture
9. mix well to combine
10. stir in the remaining chocolate chips
11. spread into prepared baking pan
12. bake for 35-40 minutes
13. cut into squares
target.review: I didn't even realize that I made these wrong until after they were baked & frosted! I melted ALL of the chocolate chips in the butter/sugar/water mixture. (blush) It would have been good to have the little bits of chocolate chips in there too; but, nonetheless, these are really good, very moist, & very fudgy. I reduced the amount of sugar, halved the recipe and baked them in an 8"x8" baking dish for just two of us. Used Kittencal's Easy Chocolate Buttercream Frosting/Icing (and halved that too). Will make these again and add nuts next time. Thanks for the great brownies!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sourdough whole wheat bread

great sourdough bread that can be made in the bread machine with the dough cycle.

1. measure the culture into bread machine pan
2. add remaining ingredients , with flour being last
3. set machine for dough cycle and start
4. at end of cycle , remove dough from machine and shape into desired loaf
5. cover and let rise in warm place until doubled--this can take as little as 1 hour or several hours , depending on what type of starter you use and how active it is
6. top of loaf can be slashed at this stage , if desired
7. uncover and bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes , or until done
8. remove from baking pan and cool on wire rack
demonstrations.review: I had to make this twice before I had success! The first time, I made it according to recipe, but I think in my cooler climate, my sourdough starter is not as active as others' might be because my dough wouldn't rise properly. So I tried again today, but I "cheated" and added 2.25tsp dry yeast (1 package-worth). I made this without a bread machine and used 1c King Arthur Organic White Whole Wheat flour, 1/2c whole wheat flour, and 1.5c white bread flour (minus 3T that I substituted with vital wheat gluten which I always use to help with rising here). This was the first time I tried using my new French bread loaf pan, too, and the bread turned out really great! I'm going to try this again when the weather is warmer to see if I can get my sourdough starter to do the job on its own! Thanks for the recipe, Donna!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican fish

if you like mexican food and fish- this dish is for you! one of my favorite meals. from harpoon henry's restaurant in san diego. this comes together in a flash with simple ingredients.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. coat fillets with flour seasoned with salt and pepper to taste
3. heat butter in skillet and lightly sautee fillets in butter til done and flaky
4. transfer fillets into individual casserole dishes or small oven proof bowls
5. divide sauce and chilis among them evenly and then sprinkle cheese over each evenly
6. bake for 15 minutes till cheese is nice and melted
7. sprinkle with cilantro leaves
8. a one dish meal and you have only one barely dirty skillet to clean !
9. fry fish-pour a little sauce-add a tbs of chilis- sprinkle some cheese
10. it's not brain surgery or rocket science
11. save what's left in the cans for another use like adding to scrambled eggs
12. i hope you enjoy this dish as much as i have for many years
demonstrations.review: We enjoyed this dish a lot.  I halved the recipe for two of us.  Also reduced the grated cheese way down to less than 1/2c; half a pound would have caused some serious lower G-I issues. :)  Thanks, Pot Scrubber, for a tasty recipe that was very easy too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asparagus chicken with hollandaise sauce

this recipe came from another recipe site. it is mouthwatering delicious. beautiful presentation. simple, simple, simple to make. originally found the recipe in february and just got around to making it. i'm sorry i lost all of that time eating it! i'll make up for it now. cook time does not include 2 hours for marinating.

1. to marinate: place chicken in a nonporous glass dish or bowl
2. pour wine over chicken , then sprinkle with tarragon
3. cover dish and refrigerate to marinate for 2 hours
4. preheat oven to broil
5. remove chicken from dish or bowl discarding remaining marinade and broil for 25 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear
6. meanwhile , steam asparagus to desired degree of doneness
7. prepare hollandaise sauce according to package directions
8. when chicken is cooked , arrange the breasts on a platter , place 4 spears of asparagus on each chicken breast and dribble with prepared hollandaise sauce to taste
9. sprinkle with cheese and serve
demonstrations.review: We enjoyed this chicken very much.  I ended up only having about 45 minutes to marinate it in the wine/tarragon, so I pounded the chicken to help the flavor infuse into the meat; added a bit of salt too.  I'm not very experienced in broiling meats successfully (do you put the temp at 500F, or lower, and on which rack level; recipe doesn't specify a temp); so I grilled it for about 4 minutes on each side; topped with asparagus and hollandaise, as written; and skipped the cheese altogether.  Served with steamed basmati rice.  A very lovely meal.  Thank you for sharing your recipe, Nimz!

target.recipe_text:
no bake vanilla orange balls

this is a holiday favorite from my mother. she makes these every year.

1. mix crushed wafers with sugar
2. add melted oleo
3. add nuts
4. then add juice
5. stir well
6. make into balls and roll in fine coconut or powdered sugar
7. refrigerate
target.review: These have great taste!  Make SURE to use correct measurements!!! I put 12 oz of OJ in, not paying attention to recipe (I just 'saw' the can part...) and had a gooey mess, but it tasted great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best cranberry chutney

i know there's a thousand cranberry chutney recipe's out there, but this one is truly the best!  best if made a day in advance to really let the flavors meld.  i never really measure the spices either, so i am guessing about 1/2 tsp. of each.  taste the cranberries after letting them set for awhile and re-season if necessary. prep time does not include refrigeration time. enjoy!  update: when i posted the original recipe i forgot about the sugar you need in the water for the cranberries.  thank you to chef sydney mike for pointing out my error!

1. bring a pot of water with the 1 / 2 cup of sugar to a boil and boil cranberries until they pop , usually just a few minutes
2. be careful not to over boil or they will be mushy
3. add all other ingredients except raisins and mix well
4. let set in fridge at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours
5. stir in raisins just before serving
demonstrations.review: This was great!  I added about 2 tablespoons of sugar because the orange wasn't too sweet and the lemon was really strong, but my family loved it!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegan vegetarian salad

this salad is not only for the vegetarian, but works well for healthy conscious individuals, dieters, and fast food eaters.

1. mix romaine , bean sprouts , and vegetables in large bowl
2. right before serving , mix yogurt , lemon juice , salt & pepper and jalapeo
3. pour over salad
4. can top with tofu , nuts , or whatever you wish
demonstrations.review: The topping wasn't my favorite, but I love the use of the oranges and sprouts!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade hamburger buns  bread machine

you will never want to buy hamburger buns again after trying this recipe. easy to do using a bread machine and so awesome! you can also top rolls with sesame seeds after brushing with melted butter.

1. place all ingredients , except butter , in pan of bread machine according to manufacturer's directions
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is complete , turn out onto floured surface
4. cut dough in half and roll each half out to a 1" thick circle
5. cut each half into six 3 1 / 2" rounds with inverted glass as a cutter
6. place on greased baking sheet far apart and brush with melted butter
7. cover and let rise until doubled , about one hour
8. bake at 350 for 9 minutes
9. some reviewers baked these anywhere from 12 to 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: I LOVE this recipe!  I've used it to make both hamburger and hotdog buns & they are a hit every time!!!!  My friends think I'm super mom because I make homemade buns!  If only they knew how easy it is!

target.recipe_text:
yellow squash puppies

if you like hush puppies, you gotta try these squash puppies.  i think a person who doesn't like squash will love these.

1. combine the first 5 ingredients in large bowl
2. stir together the squash and next 3 ingredients
3. add to the cornmeal mixture
4. stir until blended
5. pour oil to the depth of 1 / 2 inch deep into a cast iron skillet
6. heat to 350f drop batter by rounded tablespoons full in batches
7. fry 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown drain on paper towels
8. sprinkle evenly with the 1 / 2 tsp of salt
target.review: these were so yummy!  i'm throwing out my hush puppies recipe and sticking this one in its place...thanks so much for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pan seared tilapia with chile lime butter

nice, fresh-tasting dish that comes together in a snap. make it even quicker by preparing the chile lime butter ahead of time. it can be made 1 day ahead, covered and chilled. just make sure to bring to room temperature before using. i like this served atop jasmine rice. -adapted from gourmet

1. make chile lime butter:
2. stir together butter , shallot , zest , lime juice , chile and salt in a bowl
3. prepare fish:
4. pat fish dry and sprinkle with salt
5. heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until just smoking
6. saute 3 pieces of fish , using a spatula to turn once , until golden and just cooked through , 4 to 5 minutes
7. transfer to a plate and saute remaining fish in same manner
8. serve each piece of fish with a dollop of chile lime butter
demonstrations.review: this is a 5-star recipe all the way.  i LOVE the compound butter - it really makes the dish.  i used trout instead of tilapia, and i used bacon drippings instead of veg oil, but followed the butter recipe exactly.  DH absolutely raved about this, which is quite the compliment since he normally only likes his fish battered and fried.  this one is a total keeper!  thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
skillet parmesan chicken

this is real comfort food. a family favorite. if you can, buy the fresh mozzarella. you won't believe the difference and it's worth it. the texture isn't rubbery like the typical mozzarella. i got it from watching an emeril show on the food network.

1. pound the chicken breasts between two slices of plastic wrap until about 1 / 4" thick
2. season with salt and pepper
3. dredge chicken in flour and shake off excess
4. dip in egg / milk mixture , then in breadcrumb / parmesan mixture
5. heat the butter and olive oil in a large deep skillet
6. brown the chicken breasts over medium heat until golden on each side
7. remove to a plate and keep warm
8. add the marinara sauce to the skillet
9. heat to boiling and simmer 10 minutes
10. add the chicken breasts to the sauce and sprinkle parmesan over them
11. place a slice of mozzarella on each piece of chicken
12. cover and simmer about 8- 10 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the chicken is tender
13. serve with your favorite pasta- we like linguine
demonstrations.review: this is nothing short of DELISH.  and it couldn't be any simpler...i am so glad to have this recipe!  thanks PanNan!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
diana s fried chicken

serve this chicken with recipe #9456 and recipe #11668 and you've got a terrific dinner!

1. steam the chicken until done-this keeps the chicken very juicy and you have a great stock base to freeze for later use
2. in a large heavy fry pan , heat 2 1 / 2-3 inches veg oil over medium high heat
3. set up three bowls
4. in the first bowl add 1 cup flour and all the salt
5. mix well in the second bowl add eggs and milk and whisk well
6. in the third bowl add remaining flour , pepper and spike
7. mix well now dip in salted flour , dip in egg milk mixture , dip into spiced flour and into the hot oil it goes for around 5 minutes total-just to golden brown on all sides
8. drain on a rack-not paper or paper towels and you've got some great chicken-juicy , crunchy and very tasty
demonstrations.review: what a smart way to fry chicken!  i absolutely loved this method.  not only was it totally juicy on the inside, i also really loved not having that nagging "did-i-cook-it-long-enough-yet" feeling during the frying stage.  this is the way i'll fry chicken from now on!  thank you so much for posting this recipe (and answering all my silly questions along the way!).

target.recipe_text:
chicken broccoli alfredo soup

here's a scrumptious soup served at dairy keen (three-time "best of state" winner) of heber city, utah. this is a recipe i've not had long, but have made over and over and over again. it is that good!

1. in a heavy stockpot over medium heat , saut onion and garlic in butter for 2-3 minutes
2. add flour and cook , stirring , for another 2-3 minutes until bubbly
3. gradually whisk in chicken broth and half & half
4. cook , stirring frequently , until thickened
5. meanwhile , in a separate pan , add water to broccoli and bring just to boiling then remove from heat
6. do not drain cooking water from broccoli
7. add parmesan cheese to soup-base in stockpot
8. cook over low heat , stirring , just until cheese is melted
9. add cooked broccoli along with its cooking water , chicken , seasonings , and bow tie pasta to the stockpot
10. heat through
11. also , decrease the salt by half if you happen to substitute full-sodium chicken broth in this recipe
target.review: This soup was incredibly tasty! It reminds me of a creamy turkey soup that I make. I boiled chicken leg quarters with half an onion, a carrot and celery to make the broth for the recipe and used the meat off of the bones. I also skipped a step and didn't precook the broccoli, but just put it in at the same time as the pasta (adding 2 cups of broth instead of the broccoli water). As I didn't have nutmeg, I used Allspice, which worked well. To cut back on the fat content, I used milk in place of the cream. It turned out very well and is reminiscent of a soup a local restaurant offers. Thank you kindly for a lovely recipe, which I will certainly be making again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken drumsticks pierre

this is a very easy recipe for a chicken dish that will suit people who like their chicken spicy, but not too hot. served on a bed of rice, it is colorful and elegant enough for company. update:  i suggest that you not substitute regular mustard for dry mustard. regular mustard is made by mixing dry mustard with a substantial amount of vinegar and will completely change the flavor of the dish.

1. mix together the flour , salt and pepper
2. dust the drumsticks with the seasoned flour
3. melt the butter in a skillet with a lid
4. brown the chicken over medium heat on all sides
5. remove the chicken from the pan and drain on absorbent paper
6. in the same pan , combine the tomatoes thru hot pepper sauce
7. bring to a boil
8. reduce the heat and return the chicken to the pan
9. cover and simmer about 45 minutes
10. serve with pan juice
11. good over white or brown rice
demonstrations.review: This is a fantastic recipe! The blend of ingredients produces an outstanding flavour. I didn't have chili powder and just used more hot pepper sauce. I also didn't have celery seed and didn't miss it in the recipe. I also used more garlic, as we are huge fans. I have used the same sauce to cook seafood (a blend of shrimp, scallops, mussels, calimari, squid) and was amazed with the results. Thank you for a great recipe, which I will be making over and over again!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey garlic chicken drumsticks

sounds like a good recipe but i haven't tried it yet.

1. preheat oven to 375
2. place skinless chicken legs in a roasting pan and bake covered for 60 minutes
3. drain all juices and save for another purpose
4. while legs are cooking make the sauce
5. combine sugar with cornstarch
6. add water , honey abd minced garlic in a saucepan
7. bring to a boil stirring constantly
8. when chicken legs are cooked place in a heat proof casserole
9. pour sauce over and serve immediately or keep warm in oven
demonstrations.review: This dish was absolutely lovely. I used chicken wings and also basted the wings with the sauce for the last 30 minutes of the cooking time. I sprinkled the wings with some sesame seeds in the last 15 min. The flavour was amazing. Oh, I also ran out of cornstarch and substituted flour in equal amounts. Thank you for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mrs  geraldine s ground beef casserole

this recipe came from a local church fund raising cook book. mrs. geraldine is a good friend of the family. she reminds me so much of mrs. clause, that i can't help but smile every time i think of her. this recipe freezes well. do not bake before freezing. just put it together, freeze it, thaw it and cook.

1. brown meat in large skillet or dutch oven
2. add onions , pepper and celery and simmer for 15 minutes
3. add tomatoes and tomato sauce , mushrooms , brown sugar and worcestershire sauce
4. add salt and pepper to taste
5. cook in skillet for 1 hour
6. place cooked pasta in bottom of large casserole dish
7. spoon mushroom soup over pasta
8. pour sauce over the soup and top with cheese
9. bake in 350f oven for 30-45 minutes
10. can sizes do not have to be exact , just as long as they are within a close range , everything will work out
demonstrations.review: All the praise is entirely justified. It was an absolutely lovely dish. I followed the recipe closely, only substituting the cream of mushroom soup for a cream of mushroom and onion and using two cans. I find the combination of the creamy sauce with the tomatoes is exceptional. Thank you for a true keeper!

target.recipe_text:
awesome baked pork chops

these chops remain moist and tender, and the sauce is to die for! you probably have all the ingredients in your kitchen to make this! serve these chops over rice!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. rinse pork chops , pat dry , and season with garlic powder and seasoning salt to taste
3. place the beaten eggs in a small bowl
4. dredge the pork chops lightly in flour , dip in the egg , and coat liberally with bread crumbs
5. heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat
6. fry the pork chops 5 minutes per side , or until the breading appears well browned
7. transfer the chops to a 9 x 13 baking dish , and cover with foil
8. bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour
9. while baking , combine the cream of mushroom soup , milk and white wine in a medium bowl
10. after the pork chops have baked for an hour , cover them with the soup mixture
11. replace foil , and bake for another 30 minutes
target.review:
I have made them about 5 times now and I get rave reviews each time I have made them! They are moist and so tender you do not need a knife to cut them. I used golden mushroom soup instead of the cream of mushroom.. and I double or triple up on the gravy depending on the side dish.
Thank you so much Yooper

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sugar and spice nuts

i make these often during the holiday season -- everyone loves them. they also make a great hostess gift in a pretty jar. thanks to chatelaine, where i found this gem.

1. preheat oven to 325f degrees
2. grease a baking sheet and set aside
3. beat egg white in a large bowl with a fork or whisk until foamy
4. stir in two cups of unsalted nuts until coated
5. stir in sugar and spices
6. toss with nuts until coated
7. put nuts onto prepared baking sheet
8. spread out well
9. bake , stirring often , until golden-- about 20-25 minutes
10. cool completely
11. store in an airtight container
demonstrations.review: These were great! easy to make and quite the taste sensation... Thank you for posting it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hearty beef spaghetti sauce

this is family favorite sauce. it cooks on the stove a couple of hours and makes the kitchen smell delicious. it is thick and filling, just add a salad and slice of garlic bread for a complete meal.

if i am in a rush, i use frozen chopped onion and fresh garlic in a jar.

note: you can vary the size cans of tomatoes and sauce to your taste.

1. saute onion and garlic in oil until soft
2. add beef and mushrooms and saute
3. drain fat
4. add all seasonings and one to one and a half cans tomato sauce , paste and tomatoes and beef consume
5. cook , covered over a slow flame for 2 hours
6. add additional tomato sauce if needed to achieve the consistency and taste you desire
7. serve with your favorite pasta to good appetites !
demonstrations.review:
We loved the addition of the beef consomme to the sauce it did give it a richer taste! I used ground turkey instead of beef and since I needed a shorter cooking time I didn't add any water to the sauce. This was easy and so delicious!!!
Thank you Jan

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: These were out of this world..even with my goof of adding in a 1/4 cup of dried parsley instead of merely the 1-2 teaspoons.... My finance said is there a higher rating than a 10 when I asked him what his rating would be... Thank you Kitten!!!!

target.recipe_text:
impossible peanut butter cookies

these are the quickest, simplest peanut butter cookies that you will ever make and they taste great!

1. mix peanut butter , sugar , and egg together until smooth
2. drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet two inches apart
3. if desired , roll in extra sugar before placing on cookie sheet
4. press with fork
5. press again in opposite direction
6. bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. do not brown
8. do not over bake
target.review: I did not like these cookies. They were too sweet and crumbly. We ended up having to add butter, flour, and baking soda to the remaining dough to make the cookies better. I did use natural peanut butter, so I'm not sure if that had an effect. It should have made them less sweet, because natural peanut butter has no sugar or high fructose corn syrup, but they still tasted like pure sugar.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
german quark crumb bars

these bars are delicious! they have a crumbly topping and a cheesecake-like filling on the inside - what's not to like!

1. preheat oven to 350f mix the ingredients under the quark filling section and set aside
2. blend crumb topping ingredients with a pastry blender
3. measure out 2 1 / 2 cups of crumbs
4. pat into a greased 13x9 glass baking dish
5. pat crumbs up about 1 / 2 inch up sides of baking dish
6. bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes
7. pour quark mixture over baked crust
8. sprinkle remaining crumb mixture evenly over quark layer
9. pat down very lightly
10. bake 30-35 minutes
11. cool before cutting
12. storage: keep refrigerated but bring to room temperature before serving
demonstrations.review: I thought I had already reviewed this! My German boyfriend is constantly asking me to make these! Easier than making a whole cheesecake and it tastes delicious. I always leave out the dried fruit, but I do add about a tablespoon of lemon juice to the filling. Last time I made only half of the recipe and it was perfect for a 9 inch pie plate.( I found with a whole batch it was even too much for a 9 x 13 pan and I ended up having to throw some away.) The best part is my hard to please German family- in- law loves it. : )

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nikki s health cookies

amazing power-packed cookies filled with everything you want to eat and nothing you don't!  vegan and delicious!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in large bowl combine bananas , vanilla and coconut oil
3. in another bowl wisk oats , almond meal , coconut , cinnamon , salt and baking powder
4. add dry ingredients to wet ones
5. fold in chocolate chunks
6. drop small dollops on parchment or silpat lined baking sheet
7. bake 14-18 minutes , as long as possible without burning
demonstrations.review: I first saw this recipe on 101 cookbooks. I love these cookies and make them all the time, but I sub olive oil for the coconut oil. Thanks for posting here!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nana s chocolate frosting

smooth and creamy with great chocolate taste.

1. combine chocolate and butter in large saucepan
2. cook over low heat until melted
3. stirring constantly
4. remove from heat
5. cool
6. sift sugar
7. add to chocolate alternately with milk and vanilla
8. beat at high speed until of spreading consistency
demonstrations.review: This was really great. Everyone at my party loved it. I didn't measure exactly (my fault) and had a problem with the texture being a little grainy, so I added about a tablespoon of cream cheese and it worked perfectly. Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
easy baked potato wedges

we love these potatoes, they are simple to make and taste great!

1. wash potatoes , cut into wedges
2. place potatoes skin down in a baking dish
3. mix the next 6 ingredients together and brush onto potatoes
4. bake at 350 for 1 hour
target.review: Perfect potato wedges!  These were tasty and easy to make, I don't need to look for another recipe now.  I topped with them some chopped up cooked bacon, and some grated cheddar.  Divine!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
demonstrations.review: Beautiful banana read recipe!  There's a simple solution to those wanting to bake it in a loaf pan without the edges burning - simply cover the pan with a small tent of foil (so that the pan is sealed).  Remove it 5 minutes before the end to allow the top to brown up a bit more.  This traps the moisture and prevents the top sides from burning.  I used 1/2 wholemeal / 1/2 plain and the result was a beautiful and evenly cooked cake.  I also double sifted the flour for lightness.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
irish pub beef stew

start this sunday morning and your ready for kick-off!

1. preheat oven to 300f degrees
2. in a heavy skillet brown the beef in the butter over medium high heat
3. add the soup and water and stir well
4. add the rest of the ingredients and cook for about 5 minutes , stirring once
5. transfer to a cast iron dutch oven or oven proof pot and cook in the oven , covered for 5 hours , stirring occasionally
6. remove from oven , remove bay leaves and serve with irish soda bread and butter
demonstrations.review: Fantastic Irish stew, just as I remember it as a kid.  I had no tomato soup so I used a can of diced tomatoes instead and I had no sherry so used Chinese cooking wine!  It still came out beautifully - what a tasty way to get your veges!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chucumber  indian cucumber salad

this salad comes from north india and tastes excellent served with beer as a first course. i have also eaten it as a packed lunch. a lovely combo of flavours and textures. the original recipe calls for unroasted and unsalted peanuts, but i find the roasted, salted and esily available peanuts work great and that's what i use. omit or reduce the chillies if desired. recipe source is a book i borrowed from the library. the book is written in german but has been previously published in english with the title 'food of india'.

1. mix red onion , cucumber , tomatoes , cilantro , chilli , lemon juice , oil , pepper and chaat masala in a bowl and mix well
2. this could be done some hours in advance as the flavours will improve
3. just before serving , add the chopped peanuts and taste if extra salt is necessary
demonstrations.review: Delicious and tasty!!  I had no chillies except dried, but it still came out beautifully.  I used garam masala also as I did not have chaat.  Highly recommend this one as an alternative to a plain salad!

target.recipe_text:
honey ginger grilled salmon

super easy, sweet and spicy!

1. in a large self-closing plastic bag , combine first six ingredients
2. mix well
3. place salmon in bag and seal tightly
4. turn bag gently to distribute marinade
5. refrigerate 15 minutes or up to 30 minutes for stronger flavor
6. turn bag occasionally
7. lightly grease grill rack
8. preheat grill to medium heat
9. remove salmon from marinade
10. reserve the marinade
11. grill 12-15 minutes per inch of thickness or until fish flakes easily with a fork
12. brush with reserved marinade up until the last 5 minutes of cooking time
13. discard leftover marinade
target.review: 5/19/08 Yummmmmy!  My 4 year olds just loved this the taste is great.. I did not have honey so I used Lyons Treacle..any Brit will know what this is... I Grilled it .. yep and it stayed moist and tender just remember to keep basting it...Anyway this is a definite keeper, thank you so much for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potatoes sauteed with shrimp

delicious, different supper.

1. fry potatoes in 3 t olive oil until browned and tender
2. remove and keep warm
3. add remaining oil to skillet , add shrimp
4. cook for 2 minutes
5. add remaining ingredients and saute for 3 minutes
6. return potatoes and mix well
demonstrations.review: 2/9/08 Just ate this for dinner. My 4 year olds LOVED it.  I reduced the amount of Oil to 2 tablespoons.  I cooked the potatoes first in 2 table spoons of Olive Oil in a Non Stick Pan and I used the remaining oil in the pan to cook the shrimp etc.  I also microwaved the potatoes after the saute for 2 mins on high to be sure they were cooked through.  this is a definite keeper.  Thank you for posting

demonstrations.recipe_text:
paula s black olive spread

a specialty passed on to me by a friend!

1. combine all in a food processor or blender
2. spread on french bread slices , english muffin halves , or pre baked pizza crust
3. bake in preheated 350f oven for 10 mins or until bubbly
demonstrations.review: 2/16/09 I liked this a lot, it is a little milder in taste because of the Mayonaise, but you don't loose all that great Olive flavour.   Very easy to make, great on crackers.  I even spread a little on the end of celery. Yum.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
orzo   spicy italian veggie sausage medley

this is a quick, easy, one-pot meal in which i used yves spicy italian veggie sausages.  i'm sure you could sub ordinary italian sausage if you wanted.

1. slice sausages into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
2. heat oil in a large pot
3. add garlic , onion , carrot and green pepper
4. saute for about 2 minutes
5. add sausage slices and cook for 5 minutes
6. sprinkle with sage and salt and pepper
7. stir in tomatoes and water and bring to a boil
8. stir in orzo and reduce heat to medium
9. simmer uncovered , stirring often till most of the liquid is absorbed - about 10 minutes
10. stir in broccoli and remove from heat
11. cover and let stand till liquid is absorbed - 3 to 5 minutes
12. sprinkle each serving with parmesan cheese , if you like
demonstrations.review: 3/31/10 Yum.. Yum.. Yum, really easy to make and modify.. I did not add the Green Peppers.  I used Sosmix for the sausage and I spiced the whole thing up by adding red pepper flakes when I added the tomatoes.  I found it needed about 2 cups of fluid, I used vegetable stock for that.  Be generous with any of the seasoning and VOILA a most EXCELLENT meal.. it's a keeper.. thank you for posting.

target.recipe_text:
nestle toll house chocolate chip pan cookie

this recipe was in my paper recently and i made them for my co-workers. divine! i looked & looked and was surprised i couldn't find it already on zaar.

1. preheat oven to 375 grease a 15x10-inch jelly roll pan
2. combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
3. beat butter , both sugars and vanilla in large mixer bowl
4. add eggs one at a time , beating well after each
5. gradually beat flour mixture into butter mixture
6. stir in chocolate chips and nuts
7. spread into prepared pan
8. bake 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
target.review:
This was a great hit!  i brought it to a meeting I had and the entire pan was devoured by 7 people!  It gets more cookie like as it cools, at first it's almost cake-like, but so good!
Thanks for the recipe!!  I'll definitely be keeping this in my cookbook! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tofu bites

cooking light 2003. these are really an appetizer, but i would serve them (to just me and dd!) as a main dish.

1. place tofu on several layers of heavy-duty paper towels
2. cover tofu with additional paper towels , and let stand 5 minutes , pressing occasionally
3. heat oils in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. add tofu
5. saut 7 minutes or until browned
6. place in a bowl
7. drizzle with soy sauce and vinegar
8. toss gently to coat
9. cover and chill at least 1 hour , stirring occasionally
demonstrations.review: I was looking to see if anyone had posted this recipe yet, and happily, I saw it was already discovered!  It's a great recipe!  My friend and I ate it warm as a main course--delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry shortcake old fashioned style

can't be summer without this strawberry treat! tip: the berries with be juicier if sprinkled with sugar and left to sit for one hour before layering on the shortcake. use a strawberry glaze also if desired!

1. wash and hull the strawberries
2. drain
3. place the berries in a large bowl , and sprinkle with sugar , cover and refrigerate
4. prepare the shortcake
5. set oven to 375f
6. grease 2 large baking sheets
7. in a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
8. with a pastry blender or two knives , cut in the cold butter until particles are the size of small peas
9. stir in egg , milk and extract
10. mix only to combine
11. on a lightly floured surface , gather up 1 / 2 cup dough per biscuit
12. pat dough into 8 rounds
13. bake for 15-17 minutes , or until golden brown
14. cool slightly (can fill with the whipped cream and strawberries when cake is still warm
15. in a bowl , beat the whipping cream with 4 tbsp sugar until stiff peaks form
16. to serve , split the baked shortcakes into halves
17. ladle strawberries in the middle and on top of the shortcake
18. top with whipped cream
19. delicious !
demonstrations.review: these were GINORMOUS!!!  I would say you could even make them smaller and do a dozen or more of them from one batch!  I guess I didn't realize that they really would expand a lot.  haha. but these were delicious and i will definitely stick with this recipe.  very light, flaky, and buttery!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white chocolate chip cranberry oatmeal cookies

i originally made these at the request of my old chorus director john kelleher, who also worked at seattle area starbucks (i think he'd had the combo in a cookie there, once). i was surprised but very pleased they came out so tasty! these days, these are pretty much the only cookies which are requested and i make on a fairly regular basis.

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. in a large bowl using an electric mixer combine the sugar , brown sugar and butter
3. mix well to cream together
4. add in egg and vanilla extract and mix until combined
5. add the cinnamon , baking soda , salt and flour and mix well
6. fold in the oatmeal , dried cranberries and white chocolate chips- making sure that all ingredients are uniformly distributed
7. roll dough into 1-inch balls and place 3 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes , just until the edges are lightly golden
8. remove from oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes on the cookie sheet , then transfer cookies to cooling rack
demonstrations.review:
mmm!
i may cut back on the white chocolate chips cuz they're super sweet, but this was a great cookie.  friends loved them, and so did i!  
i will definitely be making these again.
right when they come out of the oven they're crispy and chewy...delicious!
thanks for the recipe ! :)

target.recipe_text:
strip steak with stilton port butter

category: grill                    
serves:  2

great!

1. place the butter in a food processor bowl and run until smooth
2. add the cheese and wine
3. pulse until blended
4. place on a small piece of wax paper or parchment
5. roll into a 1-inch cylinder
6. refrigerate
7. grill the steaks to the desired temperature
8. top each steak with a few 1 / 4-inch slices of the butter
9. serve warm
target.review: I'm a great fan of blue cheese w/steak so I tried this with a white Stilton cheese with lemon. The white Stilton was very mild compared to the blue so I added some horseradish for more zip. I'd stick with the traditional blue Stilton for this one - it's great! Thx for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken bombay  oamc

from company's coming make ahead meals.

1. combine all ingredients , except chicken , in a small sauce pan
2. heat over medium heat until smooth and slightly warmed
3. roll each piece of chicken into the sauce and place in a greased , 9x13 inch baking pan
4. bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 375f
5. spread remaining sauce over chicken and bake for an additional half hour or until chicken is done
6. to freeze: after casserole has cooled , label and freeze for up to 4 months
7. to serve: thaw overnight and bake until heated through add an additional 30-45 minutes if baking from frozen
demonstrations.review: This was really delicious and surprisingly rich. I'd definitely make it again. I used skinless chicken thighs and let them marinade overnight in the sauce. The sauce itself, I doubled the chili powder and curry powder and used regular yellow mustard and found it mild, yet nicely spiced. I baked sauce and chicken together right from the start and then served over rice. Soooo good!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chili s salsa

you can make this sauce easily at home. from copykat.com (http://www.copykat.com)

1. in food processor place jalapenos and onions
2. process for just a few seconds
3. add both cans of tomatoes , salt , sugar , and cumin
4. process all ingredients until well blended but do not puree
5. place in covered container and chill
6. a couple of hours of chilling will help blend and enrich the flavor
7. serve with your favorite thin corn tortilla chips
demonstrations.review: So quick to make and so delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honig brat mandeln  honey roasted almonds

posting this recipe for world tour 2006.
in english this is honey roasted almonds.
recipe taken from internet site recipesbycindy

1. spread the almonds in a single layer in a shallow ungreased baking pan and place in cold oven
2. bake at 350f , stirring occasionally , until the internal color of the nut is tan to light brown , 12 to 15 minutes
3. set the roasted almonds aside
4. thoroughly mix the sugar and salt , and set aside
5. stir together the honey , water , and oil in a medium-size saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat
6. stir in the roasted almonds and continue to cook and stir until all of the liquid has been absorbed by the nuts , about 5 minutes
7. immediately transfer the almonds to a medium-sized bowl into which some sugar mixture has been sprinkled
8. sprinkle the remaining sugar mixture over the almonds and toss until they are evenly coated
9. spread the almonds out onto a silicon pad or parchment paper
10. when cool , store at room temperature in a tightly covered container or plastic bag
11. will keep up to 2 weeks
demonstrations.review: So delicious! I made two batches and with one, I accidentally added too much salt but they were excellent as well. Sweet and salty. Really can't go too wrong with this recipe. Thanks for posting it!

target.recipe_text:
freeze ahead manicotti

really good served with a spinach salad. i usually make a few of these and lasagna's the same time and they are ready to pull out at any time. (it's just as easy to put a couple together at this point and have them ready.)

1. boil manicotti according to package directions , adding oil to water so they won't stick meanwhile , mix ricotta cheese , cottage cheese , mozzarella and parmesan cheese , salt , pepper , parsley , and eggs
2. drain manicotti
3. run cold water over it
4. stuff each manicotti with cheese mixture
5. place them in a 3 qt casserole after treating the dish with nonstick spray , and pour sauce around the manicotti
6. cover dish with foil and freeze
7. when frozen you can pop it out of the container and put in a freezer bag if desired
8. to prepare for serving , thaw and preheat oven to 350f
9. cover and bake for 45 minutes
10. uncover and bake for 15 minutes more
target.review: The recipe was easy to follow and the Manicotti was good, but I like my Manicotti to have a little more flavor.  I tried this recipe as is, but next time I'll probably try to add some additional cheeses to help intensify the filling's flavor.  Overall, it was a good recipe and easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
island mango bread

lots of flavors come together to make a yummy and different quick bread or muffin.

update--i obviously committed a big oops!  so sorry, the temp i cook this at (and truly thought i had posted) is 350°f.  i am so sorry to have omitted that important fact and hope it didn't ruin the outcome of anyone's bread.

1. mix sour cream and margarine together and then add mangoes
2. add eggs , sugar , then extracts , then coconut and raisins
3. mix dry ingredients together and incorporate into the wet ingredients , stir till all is combined well
4. pour into a greased large loaf pan and bake in a preheated 350f oven for approx 1 hour
5. you may need to make a tent out of aluminum foil for the last 15 minutes or so to prevent it from darkening to much
6. remove from pan and cool on a wire rack
demonstrations.review: This bread was amazing!!!  I did not include raisins since I don't really like them, but this was the kind of bread I was looking for.  It definitely has the "island" flavor!  I made two batches and made one regular size loaf and 4 mini loaves to give to friends.  I will definitely be making this bread again!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mean chef s apple brine

i adopted this recipe from mean chef. "mild brine for turkey, chicken or pork."

1. bring apple juice , sugar and salt to a boil over high heat , skim foam , let cool to room temperature
2. add remaining ingredients
3. brine turkey for 24 hours
4. quantity is sufficient for a 14 pound turkey
demonstrations.review: This was simple and easy.  I didn't have a bag large enough to brine the turkey, so I put it into my cooler with bags of ice around it to keep cold.  The turkey came out moist with only a slight hint of sweetness.  The gravy that I made with the turkey juices turned out great as well.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana chocolate chip muffins

wow! get this...a very low-fat muffin recipe that actually tastes great!! after failing at many attempts to create a really tasty, low-fat muffin, i came across this recipe, and it is really good...great for dieters!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
