2. lightly coat 12 muffin tin liners with cooking spray and place in muffin tin
3. in large bowl , mash bananas with fork
4. whisk in egg , milk , granulated sugar , and brown sugar
5. in separate bowl , combine flour , baking soda , and salt
6. add flour mixture to banana mixture and combine well
7. fold in chocolate chips and walnuts
8. spoon equal amounts of batter into 12 muffin cups
9. bake 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. allow to cool slightly in pan , then remove to wire rack
demonstrations.review: I made this today and was very satisfied.  I was looking for something guilt free and this was it.  I used 4 bananas because that is what i needed to get rid of.  I also substituted 1/4 c egg beaters for the egg, I used whole wheat pastry flour instead of the all purpose flour, 1/2 cup splenda for the sugar and added in 1/2 cup of applesauce.  The flavor was great.  Just enough sweetness and a hint of chocolate.  I will definitely be making these again.  Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
panko crusted tilapia

panko is a japanese bread crumb, coarser than regular breadcrumbs. it makes a delicious crunchy coating for baked tilapia that is lightly seasoned with butter and lemon.

1. heat oven to 375%
2. spray a baking pan lightly with cooking oil
3. in a shallow dish , combine melted margarine , garlic powder , and lemon juice
4. in a separate shallow dish , combine panko and old bay seasoning
5. dip each filet in butter mixture , then roll well in the panko mixture
6. place filets in a single layer onto prepared pan
7. press any remaining panko mixture onto tops of filets
8. bake 12-14 minutes , until flaky
9. serve with lemon wedges
target.review: It was a very easy dinner to prepare.  I had one fillet so I did everything accordingly although I did add more Old Bay and used minced garlic in place of the powder.  The fish was very moist and flaky but the crust didn't get very crunchy so I'll work with that next time.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
k d  lang s indonesian salad with spicy peanut dressing

a very filling and exciting salad, good for main course or as a side dish or appetizer.

1. heat the oil and salt in a medium frying pan over medium heat
2. add the tofu in small batches and saute until lightly browned on both sides , about 5 minutes
3. remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel
4. arrange the tofu , potatoes , spinach , and cabbage on six separate plates
5. prepare the dressing by placing all of the dressing ingredients in a blender and blending until smooth
6. if the dressing seems too thick , add another teaspoonful of water
7. top the tofu and vegetables with the bean sprouts and dressing , and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: I had a huge craving for peanut dressing today so I found this and thought I would try it.  I did everything as stated and then added thumb sized hunk of fresh ginger that I had chopped up with a couple more peanuts since I like my dressing thick.  Awesome!!! Next time I'll make the salad, which sounds great as well.  It really hit the spot thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
veronica s easy spanish rice

dh wanted spanish rice one night so i made the following recipe that i got from betty crocker. omg, it was just like eating my mom's. i forgot how good her spanish rice was!!! try it, you won't be disappointed!!! serve as a meal in its self or as a side dish.

1. in a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. add rice and onion and cook stirring occasionally , until rice is golden brown and onion is tender
3. stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until rice is tender
demonstrations.review: Okay note to self, when having the BF make the rice tell him that anything in ( ) is not a suggestion.  He took a 15oz can of tomato sauce and thought it was the same thing and then decided upon eating his creation that it had way too much tomato taste.  Besides that, the rice was perfectly done, we used half white and half brown rice, and didn't stick to the pan and was perfectly moist!!  We will be trying this again with the recommended amount of tomato and I'll update on the taste!  It was very easy to follow and took no time at all.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potato salad dressed with red wine vinegar

simple and relatively low-fat. you can either boil the potatoes on the stovetop or cook them in the microwave in a dish with 1/3 cup water. the latter takes about 16 minutes in my microwave but i know this varies from oven to oven. may be served warm or chilled in the refrigerator. whether to peel the potatoes before cubing them is up to you (i don't usually when making them for myself but do when i'm serving company.)

1. sprinkle the potatoes with the vinegar , garlic& onion
2. toss
3. combine the miracle whip , parsley and salt and mix with the potatoes
demonstrations.review: Wonderful!!!  I used baby potatoes from the farmer's market, regular mayo (can't wait to try it with Miracle Whip) and dried onion powder.  I'm sure I had less than four med. potatoes so I just guesstimated at the amount for the rest.  Loved it, thanks!!

target.recipe_text:
tilapia fish tacos

i found that these are a great way to get a bit more fish into our diet, plus they taste great.  and by not frying the fish, these are pretty healthy, depending on your toppings. i love topping them with a mango or pineapple salsa and homemade coleslaw.

1. in a nonstick pan , heat over medium high heat the oil and then add the tilapia
2. season with half the lime juice , salt , cumin and southwest seasoning
3. once that side is cooked , flip and season , cooking till golden
4. heat a small pan over medium heat and then spray with cooking spray
5. add tortilla , cooking and heating both sides
6. fill tortilla with a portion of fish and then top with desired toppings
target.review: This was a fast, easy and low cost meal and low in calories.  I read the reviews two days after I made this and next time I cook these I will take the sugguesion of, just sautee jalapenos, onions, yellow, orange bell peppers with garlic and add to fish while cooking.  That would add so much flavor. YUM my mouth is watering just thinking of the next time I make this.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cooking light garlic chicken pizza

quick lighter version of this pizza, using a thin boboli crust.  very light meal, serve with a side salad

1. preheat oven to 400
2. combine first 3 ingredients , stirring well with a whisk
3. place crust on a baking sheet
4. brush vinegar mixture over crust
5. top with chicken , tomato , and mushrooms
6. sprinkle with cheeses and green onions
7. bake at 400 for 15 minutes or until cheeses melt
demonstrations.review: My husband and I absolutely love this pizza!  I was a bit scared at first when I saw red wine vinegar as an ingredient, but all the flavors really come together when baked and make for an absolutely delicious and healthier-than-average pizza.  For an added fiber kick, this pizza works really well with the Whole Wheat Boboli pizza crust rather than the white flour variety.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork chops   rice

simmered in a creamy mushroom sauce, this one-dish meal is unbeatable comfort food! a great yet simple meal with minimal prep time.

1. brown pork chops in oil then place in large baking dish or roaster
2. while browning , mix soup , milk and water in large bowl
3. pour rice over chops , then pour soup mixture over all
4. sprinkle with pepper according to taste
5. cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hr or until tender
demonstrations.review: This is one of my favorite comfort foods; thanks for posting this easy recipe!  I use brown rice in this dish instead of white rice, but you have to cook it for just a bit longer if you make this modification (about 20 mins. more).  To get a nice crust on the rice (which I just love), remove the foil for the last 10 minutes of the cooking time, and turn your broiler on low.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
salmon w  roasted asparagus   lemon caper sauce

nan

1. whisk first 6 ingredients in small bowl to blend
2. season sauce with salt and pepper
3. preheat oven to 450 degrees f
4. evenly space three 1 / 2-inch deep slits crosswise in top of salmon
5. arrange asparagus in even layer on rimmed baking sheet , drizzle with oil and toss to coat
6. season with salt& pepper
7. place salmon on top of the asparagus
8. season with salt& pepper
9. roast until salmon is just opaque in center-- about 20 minutes
10. arrange on serving platter and drizzle with sauce
demonstrations.review: Easy, quick, & delicious -- this is an excellent recipe for a busy weeknight!

target.recipe_text:
gingerbread caramel corn

just a variation on caramel corn...tastes especially good in the fall with a cup of hot cider..

1. divide popped popcorn equally between 1 lightly buttered 13x9 baking pan
2. combine salt , butter , brown sugar , corn syrup , molasses , ginger and cinnamon in a large heavy saucepan
3. heat over medium heat till mixture comes to a full boil
4. boil for 5 minutes , stirring frequently , remove from heat
5. add baking soda , it will foam up -- stir well
6. pour over popcorn in prepared pans and toss to combine well
7. bake at 250 for one hour , stirring every 15 minutes
8. till popcorn is crisp --
9. cool completely , and store in an airtight container
target.review: Yummy!  I think this would make great Christmas gifts.  I used the whole tbsp of ginger; it sort of gives the aroma of ginger snap cookies.  I also used the full tsp of baking soda and didn't have a problem with it foaming too much (maybe my baking soda was a little on the old side, so it didn't react as much as it would have if it were fresh?).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blue ribbon tuna casserole

my mom won a blue ribbon at a cooking contest for this casserole back when i was a little girl. it was a regular at our house and each time we had it, she told us again about her blue ribbon. it definitely tasted like a winner. (mama added juice from one can of tuna to casserole and drained the other down the sink.)

1. cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. drain and set aside
3. in same pot , melt butter and saut celery and onions until tender
4. combine all ingredients in large casserole , except for potato chips and 1 / 2 cup cheese
5. bake at 350f for 30 minutes
6. put cheese on top , then sprinkle top with potato chips
7. return to oven for a few minutes to melt cheese
8. eat with crusty bread
9. yum
demonstrations.review:
Made with the following changes:
subbed fusili for the egg noodles
omitted the celery (had none)
Miracle Whip for the mayo
frozen mixed veggies for the peas/carrots
& added a splash of lemon juice.  The whole family loved it - probably the tastiest tuna casserole I've ever made.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
orange pumpkin poppy seed cake

very simple cake that is perfect for serving at dinner parties and special occasions.  glaze uses orange juice instead of milk for a nice variation and a play on the orange flavor within the cake.  found this on the very best baking website.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. grease and flour as 12-cup bundt pan
3. combine cake mix , pumpkin , eggs and orange juice in a large mixer bowl
4. beat on low speed until moistened and then beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
5. add poppy seeds and mix until blended
6. pour into prepared bundt pan
7. bake for 35-40 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean
8. cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes and then remove to wire rack to cool completely
9. for glaze
10. sift the powdered sugar until fine
11. mix the powdered sugar with 2-3 tbls of orange juice in a small bowl and stir until smooth
12. drizzle glaze over cooled cake and allow to set up before serving
demonstrations.review: Made the cake but didn't try the glaze (made a cream cheese glaze instead, but still added the o.j. for flavour).  Cake was very moist, thanks to the pumpkin.  Super-easy to make, too.  Will try to remember this one for next Halloween - the bright-orange cake with black poppy seeds would be a great fit!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beef and macaroni chili

leftovers are good reheated the next day and can be frozen.

1. cook macaroni about 7 minutes
2. brown meat in largest saucepan and drain off all fat
3. add garlic , chili powder , salt and pepper
4. mix well and cook on low about 5 minutes
5. add cooked macaroni and tomato soup
6. heat thoroughly
7. just before serving add grated cheese
8. cover and heat until cheese melts
demonstrations.review: Yesss! If I didn't find this recipe on here I was going to post it myself... this was one of my favourite weeknight meals that my mom would make for our family.  The title is a little deceiving, it's a lot more like Hamburger Helper than chili.  But quick, easy, and yummy!

target.recipe_text:
easy way lasagna

my son says he has eaten lasagna in so many restaurants, trying to find one as good as mine, but never has. so every time we visit him in michigan i'm sure to make this for him.

1. in 13x9 pan , spoon a little of the sauce
2. place 3 lasagna noodles on the sauce
3. mix cottage cheese , egg , and parmesan cheese in a bowl
4. spread 1 / 3 of this over noodles
5. add 1 / 3 of the sauce
6. sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella
7. now , add 3 more noodles , 1 / 3 more cottage cheese mixture , 1 / 3 more sauce
8. add 1 cup more mozzarella cheese
9. one more time , do the layers
10. bake in 350f oven for about 1 hour
11. top should be light brown and bubbly
target.review:
I made a recipe very similar to this, being very impressed with the outcome.  

Uncooked elbow macaroni 
Black olives

1 jar spaghetti sauce
1 lb browned hamburger

cottage cheese 
2 eggs 
1-2 cup pre-shredded mozzarella/cheddar cheese 

Layer, with cottage cheese mixture in middle layer.

Cover,refridgerate over night
Bake 1 hr
Top with full layer of pre-shredded mozz/cheddar cheese and baked another 15 min.  
YUMMM and so easy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy kielbasa casserole

sauerkraut, topped with kielbasa, swiss cheese and buttermilk biscuits. rinsing mellows the sauerkraut. a mayonnaise-horseradish sauce gives it a zippy new flavor that blends well with the sausage and cheese.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. combine sauerkraut , mayonnaise and horseradish and spread in the bottom of an 8x8-inch greased casserole
3. add kielbasa , top with cheese and bake for 15 minutes
4. place biscuits on top and bake 13-15 minutes more
demonstrations.review: Just made this and we really like it!  I made the mistake of mixing the kielbasa with the kraut and horseradish sauce, but it worked out fine.  I also used cresent dough rather than buttermilk.  Yumm!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cranberry fizz   non alcoholic

garnish with orange and lemon slices. great party drink.

1. in large non-metal pitcher or punch bowl , combine cranberry , grapefruit and orange juices
2. add sugar
3. blend well
4. just before serving , add ginger ale
5. stir gently
6. diet gingerale and sugar substitute can be used in place of regular ginger ale and sugar to reduce calories per serving
demonstrations.review: This drink was a great hit at my work yesterday! I went by the recipe, doubled it to make a gallon, and used a full bottle (9 cups) of cranberry cocktail, small individual bottle of orange and RUBY RED grapefruit juice (2 cups ea), and a 33 oz bottle of ginger ale.  I DID NOT add sugar, as I thought that the ruby red grapefruit would make it sweet enough.  It worked out perfect and everyone complimented on the nice color and refreshing taste.  They could tell that it consisted of cranberry juice, but could not pin point the other ingredients.  This recipe was so easy, that it will definitely be added to my recipe file! Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet   sour spareribs

absolutely delicious ribs! best i ever had. my mom has been making this recipe and anyone who has ever tried it asks me for the recipe! enjoy!

1. place ribs on rack in a large shallow pan
2. bake uncovered at 350f for an hour and a half
3. meanwhile , combine sugars and cornstarch in medium size pan over stove
4. stir in ketchup , vinegar and water
5. bring to a boil
6. cook and stir until thickened and clear
7. remove ribs and rack from pan
8. discard fat
9. pour about a cup and a half of the sauce over the ribs
10. bake 30 minutes longer
11. cut into serving pieces
12. brush with remaining sauce
13. yields 6 to 8 servings !
14. absolutely delicious !
demonstrations.review: What I really appreciate about this site is reading comments before trying the recipe.  I began fixing this recipe with those comments in mind.  I was out of brown sugar but that was ok because it might be too sweet anyway.  I only used 1/2 cup white sugar.  I did not have a full cup of ketchup, but there was mention of chili sauce.  I added chili sauce with a big dollop of ketchup.  After 1and1/2 hr cooking, I set the meat down in the foil lined pan and added 1/2 the amount of the sauce to the meat, cooked for another 1/2 hr, added the rest of the sauce and let set on warm for another hr.  Nice appearance and very good taste!

target.recipe_text:
puppy chow snack mix

very popular with kids, teens and adults alike. i like how i only have to buy one box of cereal for this recipe compared to the 2 types some call for.

1. melt chocolate chips , butter & peanut butter over medium heat
2. stir to blend
3. pour over crispix in large bowl
4. pour confectioners sugar in paper grocery bag
5. add crispix and shake vigorously until it breaks apart
6. serve in new doggie dish
target.review: Just made this in matter of minutes to take to work tomorrow for our Christmas snack day. Just as I remembered as a child.  YUMMY-  Thanks for posting it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious homemade egg noodles

this is one of our family's best recipes ever! it came from my great-grandma who was the best cook in our family. i love it, my family loves it, and we hope you do too!

1. measure flour into bowl
2. make a well in the center and add egg yolks , whole egg and salt
3. with hands , thoroughly mix egg into flour
4. add water , 1 tablespoon at a time , mixing thoroughly after each addition
5. turn dough onto well-floured board
6. knead until smooth and elastic , about 10 minutes
7. cover
8. let rest 10 minutes
9. divide dough into 4 equal parts
10. roll dough , 1 part at a time , into paper-thin rectangle , keeping remaining dough covered
11. roll rectangle around rolling pin
12. slip out rolling pin
13. cut dough cross-wise into 1 / 8-inch strips for narrow noodles and 1 / 4-inch for wide noodles
14. shake out strips and place on towel to dry , about 2 hours
15. when dry , break dry strips into smaller pieces
16. cook in 3 quarts boiling salted water 12 to 15 minutes or until tender
17. drain thoroughly
demonstrations.review: I thought I was someone that could not make homemade noodle UNTIL I tried this recipe. Easy to make and great tasting. My family went wild when I finally learned to make homemade noodles thanks to this recipe. You must try if you have never made good noodles or never made noodles at all. A*****

demonstrations.recipe_text:
carnation famous fudge

this is a recipe from nestle. it's easy to make and pretty good with or without nuts.

1. line an 8 inch baking pan with foil
2. combine sugar , evaporated milk , butter and salt in a medium saucepan
3. bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
4. boil , stirring constantly for 4-5 minutes
5. remove from heat
6. stir in marshmallows , chocolate chips , nuts and vanilla extract
7. stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted
8. pour into prepared pan
9. refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm
10. lift from pan and remove foil
11. cut into pieces
demonstrations.review: Made this recipe six times during the holiday. It is good plus it is very easy to make. A great combination. Thanks for posting it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my family s favorite sloppy joes  pizza joes

i've tried many recipes, this is the best. i once 'dec-tupled' (10x) this recipe to sell sandwiches at a craft fair at my church. people were waiting in line to buy leftovers. freezes well, goes up to the lake or camping well and is a hit on halloween...it's no-fail. easy to double, triple, etc. i've been making joes this way for over 20 years.
***03-08-09, i just reinvented this recipe tonight when i went to make it for dinner and found i didn't have an 8-oz. can of tomato sauce (shame on me).  the family was upset with me when i subbed an 8-oz. can of pizza sauce and told them to suck it up and call them 'pizza joes' and then served them up with shredded mozzarella cheese on the toasted buns, top and bottom.  they loved it.  i left out the bbq sauce in this preparation and just used a 1/2 cup ketchup.  pizza joes are good to go!

1. in a large skillet , brown ground beef , celery and onion
2. drain the fat , who needs it ?
3. stir in remaining ingredients , simmer covered , 15-20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. if joes appear too'loose' , leave cover off and let moisture evaporate
5. cook until it's the consistency you like for serving on toasted buns , with french fries and cole slaw
demonstrations.review: Great recipe will be sure to make it again. Thanks for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
mashed pumpkin

this dish is often eaten with roti ( a local flatbread) but it will make a great vegetable side dish to any meal. what west indians call pumpkin is actually calabaza squash.

1. heat oil in a saucepan and fry onions until translucent
2. add garlic and fry until light golden brown
3. add cumin seeds and fry until they begin to pop and release their aroma
4. mix in the pumpkin and saute for 1-2 minutes
5. add 1 / 4 cup water
6. cover and lower heat to med low
7. cook for about 10 minutes or until tender
8. remove lid and mash pumpkin with fork or potato smasher thingy:-)until smooth
9. add salt if using
10. if water is not yet absorbed , cover and simmer until water is absorbed
11. remove pot from heat and serve as a side dish with rice or roti
target.review: This was just delicious and a refreshing new way to serve winter squash. The onions and cumin add such a nice smoky contrast to the sweetness of of the squash.   I used calabaza in mine and served it along side a jerk pork tenderloin.  About the preparation, it took me about 20 minutes for mine to cook to the point of being tender enough to mash.  Other than that the recipe was quite straight forward and easy to follow.  Have some leftovers and may even be inspired to grab a roti tomorrow. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked beets with balsamic vinegar

the beets become very sweet when baked in this way. they take a long time but can be baked with sweet potatoes or baked potatoes.

1. heat oven to 400f
2. place each beet on a square of aluminum foil and wrap tightly
3. place on baking sheet
4. bake until the beets are tender when pierced with a wooden toothpick , usually 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
5. poke holes in foil to let steam escape and carefully unwrap
6. when the beets are cool enough to handle , slip off the skins
7. slice the beets and place them in a bowl
8. add the vinegar and salt and pepper to taste
9. toss to combine , adding a little more vinegar if needed
10. let stand at least 15 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: Combine one of my favorite vegetables with my favorite condiment and I'm a happy lass.  The baking method worked well in during the winter, the extra heat generated was welcome.  My one comment was that by the time the roots were fully tender, the edge flush to the baking sheet was a little overcooked. My suggestion is to rotate the beets during cooking time.  Thanks Mary.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
szechuan chicken with peanuts 6 ww pts

i've made this several times and we really enjoy it. i believe it came from a weight watchers cookbook, but i can't quite remember. it has 6 ww points, if you are following that program. even if you're not, it's great, and i think even better than what you'd get in a restaurant. my husband, who is definitely anti-diet food anything, really likes it.

1. combine the chicken , 1 tbsp of the hoisin sauce and 1 tbsp of the cornstarch in a bowl
2. toss to coat and set aside
3. combine remaining 2 tbsp hoisin sauce , 1 tbsp cornstarch and the chicken broth , rice vinegar , sugar and chili garlic sauce and set aside
4. heat a large , deep skillet over medium heat
5. add oil
6. then add chicken
7. stir fry until almost done , 2-3 minutes
8. add ginger and garlic , stir-fry about 15 seconds
9. add pepper , carrots and peanuts
10. stir-fry until crisp-tender about 2 minutes
11. add hoisin sauce mixture and cook , stirring constantly until it boils and thickens and chicken is done
12. serve with rice , if desired
demonstrations.review: I made a wonderful variation on this dish and rather than post a near duplicate will comment here.  I loved this recipe and found it both easy to prepare and satisfying.  In my own meal, I made three minor changes on the vegetables 1) cutting the carrots on the diagonal and then into match sticks, 2) used a combination of red and green peppers and 3) added 1 stalk of sliced celery.  If you are looking to conserve points, omit the peanuts and save a point.  Dinner will still be great.  SO glad this recipe is posted.  Thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spaghetti squash casserole  south beach diet p1

i got this from another website and everyone in my family liked it. i thought it was delicious and very filling. i use the "mexican style" type diced tomatoes. for a different taste, use parmesan or low fat cheddar on top.

1. pierce the squash in several places , put on a plate and microwave until tender
2. allow cool while you cook the meat and veggie mixture
3. brown meat with garlic , onion , salt and pepper , and bell pepper
4. drain and add italian spice and tomatoes
5. if it seems really liquidy , cook some of the liquid off
6. cut the squash in half and scrape out the seeds and discard them
7. use a fork to scrape the spaghetti into strands and mix gently with sauce mix
8. transfer to a large casserole dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray
9. bake uncovered for 35 minutes at 350 degrees
10. sprinkle the cheese on top and bake 10-15 minutes more
demonstrations.review: I love using spaghetti squash as a healthy and point friendly alternative to pasta and was instantly drawn to this one.  I did an Italian styled version for 2 people and used a mix of lean ground turkey and Italian sausage seasoned veggie crumbles.  Topped with a mix of reduced fat feta and mozzarella, it was a perfect comfort meal that was healthy to boot.

target.recipe_text:
palak paneer  indian fresh spinach with paneer cheese

creamy and rich, a delight to eat. a dish i fell in love with at a local restaurant and adapted a recipe to closely resemble theirs.

1. cut spinach into shreds and cook in 3 tablespoons water until tender
2. remove from heat
3. saute onion , cinnamon , cardamom , and ginger in 1-2 tablespoons ghee or oil until onion is translucent
4. then add garlic and chopped tomatoes , and reduce heat
5. cook this briefly and slowly blend in yogurt a little at a time to prevent curdling
6. add coriander , garam masala , paprika , and salt , mixing well
7. add cooked spinach with liquid , cover and simmer on low heat for approximately 20-30 minutes
8. remove from heat
9. take half of spinach mixture and puree in food processor or blender , and return to mixture and stir
10. slowly stir in heavy cream , and heat through on low heat
11. add paneer cubes
12. serve
target.review: Amazing flavor! My family and I loved it. We will definitely make it again. To make sure I get all the benefits of eating greens, I use my pure clay pot to cook it. The steam locker lid hold almost all the steam and seal essential water soluble nutrients in giving you the healthiest food possible. Most importantly, it metal and chemical free (does not react with the food). I got mine from mecware.US (online)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked beans in clay pot

these are my baked beans i have been making for years.i just discovered how perfect they are baked in a clay pot.
these are great to make and freeze in individual containers.

1. soak beans in cold water overnight
2. drain
3. cover with fresh cold water
4. heat to boiling point then simmer 30 minutes
5. drain reserving 1 cups cooking water
6. in medium bowl mix ketchup , mustard , brown sugar , salt , pepper and cooking water and add another 1 / 2 cup water
7. in a clay pot , cast iron or crockery pot , layer 1 / 3 bacon slices , onions , beans and ketchup mixture
8. repeat ending with beans
9. cover with remaining bacon slices
10. put lid on pot and bake in a 250 oven for about 8 hours
11. with clay cooker you put the pot in a cold oven
12. heat to 400
13. after 30 minutes reduce heat to 300
14. cook for 3 hours
15. reduce heat to 250 for another 1 / 2 hour
16. serve with a boiled potatoes , ham , fresh bread and ketchup ,
demonstrations.review: Bacon with beans sounds delicious! The last time I tried a bean recipe in my clay pot turned super delicious. The clay pots cook the food evenly and taste soo good. Most importantly it holds all the nutrients in the food and look great in the kitchen. I got mine from mecware.US (online), they are un-glazed and no fear of metals or chemicals getting into our food.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
curried chickpeas and black beans low fat

this is a quick and simple vegetarian curry with lots of flavor, tons of protein, and not alot of fat. i recommend using a real flavorful, mild curry powder, or one that you've mixed yourself. my "simple, sweet and mild curry blend" works well with this dish. however,if you do like heat, feel free to add some cayenne or crushed red pepper to suit your taste.

1. heat oil in a large , non-stick skillet over medium heat
2. add onion and ginger and saute about 3 minutes , or until tender
3. add curry powder and stir to coat onions evenly
4. add tomatoes with their juices and cook 1-2 minutes or until mixture seems slightly thickened , stirring well
5. add black beans , chickpeas and salt to taste
6. stir to coat beans evenly
7. cover , reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes or until chickpeas are heated through
8. turn off heat , and stir in fresh cilantro , and lemon juice
9. serve warm
10. this dish goes nicely over some jasmine or basmati rice
demonstrations.review: Yummy! My family loved it. I used my pure clay pot to cook it to make sure I get all the nutrients from the food. The special steam locker lid seal all the nutrients in and gives healthy food and it cooks the food with far-infrared heat emitted from the walls of the pot let seasoning & spices penetrate deeper giving you delicious food, perfectly cooked. I got mine from mecware.US

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy shrimp in coconut milk

steamed rice is perfect with this very tasty exotic dish.

1. heat oil in lg skillet on med-hi heat
2. add onions and stir cook for 3 minutes
3. add garlic and ginger , cook 2 minutes
4. add next 5 spices , cook 1 minute
5. add tomatoes , cook 1 minute
6. add coconut milk , water , and salt , and bring to a simmer
7. simmer until thickened 5-10 minutes
8. add shrimp , simmer , stirring for 5 minutes
9. stir in cilantro
10. serve with lime wedges
demonstrations.review: Delicious! I love seafood. I liked the combination of coconut milk and shrimps. I cooked it in my pure clay pot and turned out fantastic. The special steam locker lid seals all the water soluble nutrients in and gives you the healthiest food. Most importantly, its metal and chemical free. Here is the <a href=http://miriamsearthencookware.com/>website</a> where I got mine from and the best place to learn this unique way of cooking.

target.recipe_text:
mango lassi frozen yogurt  for ice cream maker

mango lassi happens to be one of my favorite dairy treats, so the combination of "frozen" and "lassi" seemed like an obvious one. i hope you enjoy this frozen treat as much as i do on a hot day.

1. first begin by pureeing two fresh mangoes in a blender with just enough water as was necessary to grind them to a smooth mixture
2. combine 16 oz of greek yogurt together with the mango mixture and 1 / 2 cup sugar in the ice cream maker
3. while the mixture was churning in an ice cream maker , add 1 / 2 tsp cardamom and 3 drops yellow food coloring for a vibrant yellow color
4. also add 1 / 2 tsp vanilla extract
5. after 30 minutes of churning , the frozen mango lassi will be ready to be frozen in a freezer
6. allow to freeze for at least four hours before serving
target.review: This was just wonderful. I made some minor substitutions (homemade yogurt and heavy cream instesd of store-bought greek yogurt, plus rosewater instead of vanilla and a little more cardamom than called for). Really complex and creamy and mango-y. Almost too sweet; next time I might use less sugar as long as I had really sweet mangoes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fragrant paneer rice

the heady scents of rose-water and saffron in this is intoxicating. it's a good dish to prepare if you have guests over and want to seduce them with the aroma of the food before it even touches their plate. the core of the recipe here is really the layering of fragrances by the various spices, so you may choose to omit the paneer, or substitute with other pretty and colorful veggies.

1. heat ghee and add cloves , cinammon , bayleaves and cardamom
2. after a minute , stir in rice , water and salt
3. allow to boil , reduce heat and cover
4. cook on simmer for 15-20min until the rice is cooked and tender
5. add the paneer
6. dissolve saffron in rose water
7. drizzle this over the rice and toss to mix evenly
8. serve with curry
demonstrations.review: This was a great side dish, although it might be better cooked alone so you can enjoy the wonderful aromas wafting out of the kitchen!  My only tiny complaint was that after all the fabulous smell, the flavor seemed a tiny bit on the bland side, so I added a little more salt and butter.  The saffron/rosewater mixture was definitely a plus in its favor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sauce that goes with everything

(or just about!) this is a simple sauce i created that we've used for many things, and it's especially handy if you don't want to make a side of veggies- makes meals heartier. we love it on pork chops, chicken, and pasta. you could even put it in a roll for a sandwich- because it's thick/chunky. 
hope you like!

1. heat oil in large deep skillet
2. add onions , frying til soft
3. add garlic , frying but not burning
4. add tomatoes , red peppers , seasonings
5. cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally for about 8 minutes
6. add olives , capers , artichokes , mixing thoroughly
7. cook on medium-low for about 12-15 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is very good, MrsMM. Very Mediterranean flavors, and it's pretty low in fat!  I especially like that you were generous with the capers -- I had this on chicken and will try it next on pork. Thanks for an easy, flavorful recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted pears with caramel sauce

from usa weekly.
this is elegant enough to serve for company, but also perfect for an end to a comfortable family meal.
instead of the sour cream, you could use cool whip or vanilla ice cream to serve.

1. heat oven to 400 degrees
2. place butter in a baking pan large enough to hold the pears in a single layer
3. set baking pan with butter in the heating oven until the butter melts
4. sprinkle sugar over melted butter
5. place pears , cut side down , on top
6. bake until tender , about 30 minutes
7. remove from oven
8. turn over pears and baste with pan sauce
9. return to oven
10. bake until golden and glossy , about 10 minutes
11. let cool slightly
12. transfer pears to dessert plates or bowls
13. top each with a dollop of sour cream , drizzle with caramel pan sauce , sprinkle with nuts
14. serve and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This is very easy and very good, and makes a huge amount of very sweet caramel sauce. My only suggestion would be to add a bit of salt to the sauce to temper the sweetness a little bit.

target.recipe_text:
fiesta cheese rice

a quick, easy, spicy side dish.

1. in a bowl , combine the rice , water , tomatoes and bouillon and mix
2. pour into a greased microwave dish
3. cover and microwave on high for 10 minutes
4. stir in the sour cream and 1 / 2 cup of cheese and mix
5. sprinkle with the remaining cheese
6. cover and microwave for 45 seconds or until cheese is melted
target.review: It's 94 degrees here at noon, we're tired of sandwiches, and I wanted to make something for lunch that wouldn't heat up the house. I had put pork chops on the grill and needed something to go with them. I had just printed out this recipe last night as one to try when I needed something in a hurry and my DS thought we should try it today. Am I ever glad that I did! I had to finally put the dish away so we would have some leftover for tonight when we come from his baseball game. Made this in the same dish I mixed it in so only have one dish to wash! Thanks for a super easy and delicious recipe that I will definitely be making again. DS suggested mxing in some cooked chicken or browned ground beef and making a casserole of it--will have to try it that way also.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
desperation cookies

i love these cookies! they are sooo good & always come out perfectly done.  evryone i've ever made them for compliments them.  (the only problem is it makes 10 dozen, althought i guess that could be a good thing....) i got this recipe from joanne fluke's book peach cobbler murder.

1. melt the butter
2. mix in the white and brown sugar
3. add the vanilla , baking soda , salt and mix
4. add the eggs and stir it all up
5. then , add half the flour and all the chips and nuts
6. stir well
7. add the other half of the flour and mix
8. drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheets
9. bake at 350 f for 10-12 minutes
10. allow them to cool for two minutes , then transfer to a wire rack to finish cooling
demonstrations.review: Loved these cookies! They spread quite a bit but we like a crispy/chewy cookie! They are great dunked in coffee or milk! Definitely will be making these again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dudewiches

this is a tangy and sweet sandwich filling that can also be made with lean ground beef or turkey, or be made vegetarian by substituting soy crumbles and vegetarian worcestershire sauce. it's quick (prep time includes cooking time of roast) and satisfying, and can be frozen to have on hand for a treat anytime.

1. roast meat at 325 degrees f for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , covered , until meat falls apart and shreds easily
2. saute onion in butter until translucent
3. stir in chili sauce and vinegar
4. add 1 / 2 cup of water , then mix in brown sugar , mustard , worcestershire sauce , black pepper , salt , cayenne pepper and garlic
5. cook over low heat until thickened
6. shred the roasted beef
7. stir meat into the sauce , and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes
8. serve on sandwich rolls brushed with garlic butter
demonstrations.review: This was really good. The only thing that I did differently after shredding the meat and pouring on the sauce was to cover it and put it bake in the oven to bake for about an hour at 300 degrees.  My kids thought this was fantastic and I will definitely make this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white chili   football soup

this recipe comes from the blue owl restaurant and bakery in historic kimmswick, mo. my daughter named it "football soup" because we always make it when we have a crowd over watching the game after church! incredibly easy, freezes beautifully, and my bean hating husband even loves it. i add an extra can of green chilies for more flavor. you can make it without the chicken for a cheaper meatless meal, and you can make it without the monterey jack cheese for a low-fat, less thickened soup (but the cheese adds a lot of flavor!)

1. heat oil in large pot over medium high heat
2. add onions and saute until translucent , about 10 minutes
3. stir in garlic , then chilies , cumin , oregano , and cayenne and saute 2 minutes
4. add undrained beans and stock and bring to a boil
5. reduce heat and add chicken and cheese to chili and stir until cheese melts
6. season to taste with salt and pepper and ladle into bowls
7. for freezing: pour soup into a rigid container , label and freeze
8. to reheat , thaw in refridgerator overnight or simply put frozen soup into a large pot and gently heat , with lid on and stirring often , till heated through
demonstrations.review: Really loved this soup!  I took some to a friend who was sick with a cold - it cleared out her sinuses in no time!  She now swears that this is better than chicken noodle for curing a cold!  This freezes very well.  Thanks for a great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
wendy s burger goulash

this is a very tasty one pot meal. the kids really love this one. we make it a lot.

1. in dutch oven heat oil , cook onions and peppers
2. add hamburger , cook and stir for 3 minutes
3. add all remaining ingredients except macaroni
4. bring to a boil
5. simmer for 10 minutes
6. add macaroni
7. mix well
target.review: This quick and easy to put together. Very filling, I served with a green salad. Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry rhubarb super crumble

the crumble topping for this strawberry rhubarb dessert is simple amazing! this is a very forgiving recipe.  add more or less strawberries or rhubarb, double the crumble topping, or try it with other berries. any way you make it you will be super satisfied! when i bake this, i leave the berries whole and end up with sweet soft chunks of berries in every bite. yum!!

1. pre-heat oven to 375f
2. prepare topping: combine flour , baking powder , sugars and lemon zest and add the melted butter
3. mix until small and large clumps form
4. refrigerate until needed
5. prepare filling: toss rhubarb , strawberries , lemon juice , sugar , cornstarch and a pinch of salt in a deep oven safe dish
6. remove topping from refrigerator and cover fruit thickly and evenly with topping
7. place pie plate on a baking sheet , and bake until crumble topping is golden brown in places and fruit is bubbling beneath , about 40 to 50 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was so easy to put together. This was a bit tart for me so next time i might add a bit more sugar. Loved the lemon zest in the topping. Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s gingersnaps

everyone in my family loves these. dad keeps asking me to make them and send them over. great ginger and molasses flavour.

1. preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. combine dry ingredients and set aside
3. in a large bowl beat butter till soft , gradually add sugar
4. beat in egg and molasses
5. stir in flour mixture
6. roll into balls , then roll in sugar
7. bake 10- 12 minutes
8. cooking time depends on the size of cookie
9. i have small children so i make them quite small and the baking time decreases
10. the yield is not correct- it depends on the size of the cookie- i do not know the amount it will make ?
demonstrations.review: PERFECT!!These were just perfect. Perfect texture and perfect taste. I made two batches of these today. I used a teaspoon full and I somehow got exactly three dozen from both batches. Baked them for 10 minutes and my husband is now in heaven. These are his favorite cookies and I have now gotten rid of all the other Gingersnap cookie recipes. This will be our recipe from now on. Thank you so much for the recipe.:)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandpa s pasta salad

my grandfather created this recipe for my family on thanksgiving. when i tried it i had to make all the time.i'ts great!

1. cook pasta according to package directions
2. in a large mixing bowl , combine pasta , cucumber , tomatoes , onion , and olives
3. in a small bowl combine mayonnaise , olive oil , vinegar , salt and pepper , and sugar stir till not lumpy
4. add to mixture and stir
5. chill and serve
demonstrations.review: Wow, what a good salad. I halved the recipe since I was the only one eating it. The only change I made was wide egg noodles since those are what I had on hand and it still turned out great. I've never used balsamic vinegar before and I was so surprised at the wonderful flavor. Thanks for the recipe! I'm sure I will be using this one alot once my garden gets going.

target.recipe_text:
spinach   cheese casserole

from parade magazine: looks terrible but taste absolutely awesome!! easy to make and quick to get eaten.  (i fixed the directions!!  thanks to everyone who reviewed and expressed confusion - i'm sorry i had left out when to add the rest of the butter and flour!  all corrected now!!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch baking dish
3. drain spinach well
4. saute onion and garlic in 2 tbsp of the melted butter
5. mix spinach with eggs , cottage cheese and cheddar cheese , additonal 6 tbsp butter , and flour
6. add sauteed onions and garlic and mix together
7. season with salt and pepper
8. pour into prepared dish and bake for 1 hour
target.review: My mother used to make this for holidays and we rediscovered a couple Christmas' back.  Just now getting around to writing review. We love this dish!  I like to 'spice' it up a bit with an Indian flair- some tumeric, coriander, cumin, ground chili pepper and some garam masala.  I put them into the onion and garlic mixture for about 3 mins. before adding the spinach.  I also do not use that much butter and like another reviewer have used olive oil for the saute section. My husband said he could eat this every day.  It's wonderful dish.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best ever squash casserole

this is the best squash casserole recipe i've ever made. the corn bread flavor in it makes it just incredible. its time consuming so i don't make it all that often but its worth doing at least once a month!

1. prepare jiffy mix as directed , set aside to cool
2. place zucchini and yellow squash in a large sauce pan and add just enough of water to cover
3. cook on medium low heat just until tender , remove from heat
4. drain squash , reserve one cup of water for casserole
5. on medium low temperature place all of the butter in large sauce pan and saut the onions until the onions turn clear , add salt , pepper , thyme , and parsley
6. add chicken bouillon cubes and garlic to onions , stir
7. add drained squash and diced cheese , stir
8. crumble corn bread in squash and pour the reserved cup of water and mix well
9. place squash mixture in a 13"x11" baking pan that has been sprayed with a none stick spray
10. cover casserole and place in a preheated oven at 350 degrees
11. bake for 50- 60 minutes
12. remove cover the last 20 minutes of baking time
demonstrations.review: Very tasty squash dish!  Was looking for something to use up squash from garden and made for family gathering.  I thought I had enough American and did not, so added some cheddar/jack, also added some cheddar/jack on top.  I also added some medium heat chilies from the garden.  Everyone enjoyed. I will add this to our veggie list.  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pineapple   mandarin orange fluff

it's a light salad that is quick and easy to make.

1. in a large bowl , mix cottage cheese and jell-o mix
2. drain juice from oranges and pineapple , then add to ingredients
3. add in the cool whip a little at a time
4. refrigerate overnight is best
demonstrations.review: This was one of the many Jello salads my family made during holidays.  It is delightful.  You can also add some toasted chopped pecans for a little flair.  It is easy and quick.  Be sure to let it set up for at least 6-8 hrs for best flavor and texture.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
turkish cacik

a refreshing dish that usually takes place of a plate of salad. very refreshing on hot summer days. can be used as an appetizer or as a dip.

1. place yoghurt in a large bowl
2. add all other ingredients , except salt and water , and mix thoroughly
3. add water until required consistency is achieved
4. stir in some salt , taste and add more if required
5. chill in refrigerator for about two hours before serving
demonstrations.review: We had a salad supper at church and I made this for one of my dishes.   We absolutely loved it.  It was well received and everyone commented on how refreshing and soothing it was.  DH ate the leftovers and I have added to our regular lineup.  It is soooo much better than the mayo based cucumber salads normally made.  Thank you for sharing.  Looking forward to having with some Tandoori.

target.recipe_text:
chili s crispy honey chipotle chicken crispers bytodd wilbur

these sweet and spicy chicken tenders can be served as either an appetizer or an entree.  this recipe was created by todd wilbur from top secret recipes - www.topsecretrecipes.com.

1. make honey-chipotle sauce by combining all ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat until boiling
2. reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes
3. remove from heat
4. heat shortening or oil in fryer or dutch oven to 350 degrees f
5. whisk together all ingredients for the batter , excluding flour , in a shallow bowl for at least 30 seconds
6. whisk in the flour
7. make the breading by combining all ingredients in another shallow bowl or pie pan
8. when you are ready to fry the chicken , dip each piece of chicken into the batter
9. lift the chicken out of the batter and let some of the excess drip off
10. toss the chicken into the dry breading and coat completely
11. repeat with 2-3 other pieces
12. carefully drop the breaded chicken into the hot oil and fry for 4 minutes , or until golden brown
13. remove chicken from oil and allow to drain on paper towels
14. repeat steps 8-13 until all the chicken tenders have been cooked
15. when all the chicken tenders are done , drop them into a large glass or metal bowl
16. pour the sauce over the top , and toss gently until all the chicken tenders are coated with sauce
target.review: Made this last night and the sauce didn't thicken at all. Then I tasted it and it didn't Taste anything near chili's Chipotle chicken. It wasn't very good it just tasted like honey I was very disappointed, I just froze the rest of the cooked chicken tenders and I'll reheat them once I make orange chicken sauce for them cuz I threw this recipes away it was nasty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flawless sesame chicken  restaurant style

this is the recipe you've been looking for!  it makes a perfect sesame chicken.  this excellent recipe comes out perfect every time with little fuss and inexpensive ingredients you probably have on hand.  this recipe is truly restaurant quality... try it, you won't be disappointed! (recipe courtesy of "reykjaviky" at all recipes)

1. cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes
2. mix the marinade ingredients and marinate the chicken for 20 minutes
3. to prepare the sauce:
4. mix together all of the sauce ingredients
5. pour them into a small pot and bring to a boil , stirring continuously
6. turn the heat down to low and keep warm while you are deep-frying the chicken
7. to deep-fry the chicken:
8. add the marinated chicken pieces a few at a time , and deep-fry until golden brown
9. drain on paper towels and then place chicken in warm oven while you continue frying
10. repeat with the remainder of the chicken
11. just before you are finished deep-frying , bring the sauce back up to a boil
12. place the chicken on a large platter and pour the sauce over
13. sprinkle with sesame seeds
14. serve the sesame chicken with rice
demonstrations.review: I am eating mine right now. Its very tasty, but was not what i expected for sesame chicken. My sauce didnt thicken much, its very soupy, but all in all everyone ate it. A tip: prepare everything ahead of time, so when its time to make dinner your just have to throw everything in the pan and not measure a million things.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panera broccoli cheese soup

a very good broccoli cheese soup. served with crusty bread.

1. saut onion in butter
2. set aside
3. cook melted butter and flour using a whisk over medium heat for 3-5 minutes or until you see a noticeable golden brown color in your pan
4. slowly add in the chicken stock and whisk again to combine
5. simmer contents covered for 20 minutes on medium heat
6. add the broccoli , carrots and the sauteed onions , into the pot
7. stir , add the milk and half & half
8. cook covered over low heat 20-25 minutes but do not bring to a boil
9. this may cause the milk to curdle
10. add salt , pepper & nutmeg
11. continue to cook the soup on low heat and slowly add the grated cheese a handful at a time and stir to avoid clumps
12. once all the cheese has been added is melted , remove from heat , and serve immediately
13. suggestion: serve with crusty bread or in a breadbowl
14. refrigerate leftovers after they have cooled and store in a airtight container up to 5 days in the refrigerator
demonstrations.review: I am going to write an honest review. I was very excited to make this soup, I followed it exactly how its written.  Overall, I was disappointed with the end results. It was missing a lot of flavor, even after adding a lot of salt & pepper. I had to add paprika, old bay seasoning, onion powder, chicken bouillon, more s&p. Even then, something was missing. I figured out adding more cheese helped it a lot. I would say triple the cheese amount, but that alone wont totally add to the flavor. You will need the seasonings I mentioned above, to make this good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy cajun chicken pasta

n'awlin's style of chicken with an updated alfredo sauce.

1. place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
2. in a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. reduce heat add green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
4. pour over hot linguine and toss with parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: Freaking delicious! Yummy flavor, I added one red pepper and lived it. Only thing was the sauce was real soupy next time I'll simmer it for a while. (:

target.recipe_text:
easy  inexpensive  lentil tacos

pleases even the pickiest eater!  full of flavor, you won't miss the meat!  very inexpensive and delicious.  we're not always the healthiest eaters, but we love this healthy meal!

1. dump everything in a medium pot and bring to a boil
2. turn down the heat to a little lower than medium and cook covered until done
3. i usually stir every 5-6 minutes , but you probably don't need to once the spices are mixed !
4. use just like regular taco filling
target.review: This was absolutely delicious.  Even my two year old ate it.  I had to cut down on the chili a little but other than that we loved it.  My husband loves tacos but hates ground anything so I am very limited as to fillings.  This will be made weekly in our house.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
glen s pecan pie muffins

this muffins is soooo addicting and so easy to make.

1. in a bowl , mix brown sugar , flour and pecans
2. set aside
3. combine melted butter and eggs
4. mix well
5. stir into flour mixture just until moistened
6. fill greased and floured miniature muffin cups two thirds full
7. bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
8. remove immediately to cool
9. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: These are so delicious!  I made a huge batch of these for the neighbours and they raved about them.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lentil spaghetti sauce

a delicious low-fat vegetarian (if not using beef broth) pasta sauce. from the dietitians of canada.

1. in a large saucepan cook onion and garlic in oil for about 5 minutes , or until tender
2. add lentils and water
3. cover and cook on low heat until lentils are tender
4. add tomato paste , 3 / 4 cup water and seasonings
5. cover and cook until lentils are soft and mushy
6. serve over cooked spaghetti
7. if desired , sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: Thank you for a delicious quick supper.  My husband and 2 year old refuse to eat ground beef but me and my 1 year old love spaghetti.  Everyone devoured this.  The only change I made was to use tinned tomatoes and a little puree as I didn't have enough puree.  It must be good because my husband has offered to cook it on his night!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
1 pan fudge cake

this is my favorite chocolate cake. no fuss, no mess and very moist. back in the early days when it was paycheck to paycheck, this simple dessert made it into his lunchbox many a day because it was cheap and simple. no eggs, no milk.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in an ungreased 9 x 13 pan- yes ungreased , sift all dry ingredients
3. add the liquids and stir just until blended
4. bake for 25 minutes
5. frost with your favorite frosting , cake is extremely moist so care must be taken that you don't tear up the top of the cake
demonstrations.review: This is a family favourite.  I make this at least twice a month actually more like once a week!  I replace half the oil with applesauce and use high fibre flour.  We sprinkle chocolate chips on top before baking and don't ice it. My two boys love to help make it.

target.recipe_text:
raspberry   cinnamon sponge dessert

a quick and simple variation on the theme of blueberry muffins, only larger.

i love this, not only because it tastes delicious, but also because it bakes in the same pan for preparation, cutting down on the washing up afterwards.

note:    make sure your skillet is large enough as the ingredients expand by about a third in the baking.

note also:    a moment on the lips, an inch on the hips - you have been warned!

1. preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas 6
2. to make the raspeberry sauce , melt the butter in an oven-proof skillet over a medium heat
3. add the raspberries and cinnamon and cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. meanwhile , in a separate bowl , cream together the butter and sugar until smooth
5. add the flour and eggs and continue to blend until combined to a sticky batter
6. add this batter to the raspberry sauce and stir through to mix completely
7. place the skillet in the oven and bake for 20 minutes
8. to serve , turn out onto a warmed serving platter and drizzle with the cream if desired
9. this dessert is equally good served cold
target.review: This was very quick easy to make and needed only a few ingredients. I didn't use unsalted butter, but Lurpak spreadable as it is softer and easier to cream with the sugar. The result was like a big fairly flat muffin. It was delicious. I think it makes 6 servings, so maybe not so high in calories when served in smaller portions! I'll definitely be making this again. Thanks for sharing this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
penne amatriciana

a classic pasta dish, a rich tomato sauce with pancetta and chili that has its origins in the town of amatrice in central italy.

1. heat a splash of olive oil in a pan and fry the pancetta for 4-5 minutes until crisp
2. add the onions and lightly fry until soft , about 15 minutes
3. stir in the chili and cook for 1-2 more minutes
4. pour in the wine and turn up the heat to high , cooking until the alcohol has evaporated
5. stir , then add the chopped tomatoes and rosemary
6. reduce the heat to low and allow the sauce to simmer for 2 hours 30 minutes , until thick and fairly dry
7. cook the penne in boiling salted water until al dente , about 10 minutes
8. drain and set aside
9. stir in 8 tbs of the parmesan into the sauce and cook for 1 more minute , then mix with the pasta and season with black pepper
10. serve on plates and scatter over the rest of parmesan
demonstrations.review: I made this for dinner the other night and we all loved it! It was easy to make and only a few ingredients required. That's my kind of cooking! This will be a regular in my repertoire from now on. Thank you for sharing the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
linguine pasta w chicken in tomato garlic sauce

my daughter got this off of a tv show a couple of years ago. it's chicken, it's pasta, it's tomato and garlic.. what's not to like? :)

1. marinate chicken in lemon juice , thyme and basil for 1 / 2 hour
2. cook marinated chicken , in a small skillet until done , approx
3. 10 minutes
4. in large skillet , heat oil
5. saute garlic briefly
6. add diced tomatoes and cook over low heat about 10-15 minutes , or until the consitancy you want the sauce
7. add salt and pepper and cooked chicken
8. heat through
9. serve over cooked linguine
10. origionalrecipe called for 1 / 2 cup of brie cheese without the rind , in small chunks , to be added at the end , right before serving
11. i didn't have any brie on hand , as i have never had itlol even without the brie , it's good though
demonstrations.review: I made this for my son who loved it. I used tinned tomatoes, which made quite a lot of sauce, and the taste was great. I didn't add cheese, but will try it with cheese the next time

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic chicken and potatoes

this is for lovers of garlic and comfort food. i don't know where it came from but i just cooked it one day like this and loved it ever since!

1. put small amount of water in bottom of roasting pan
2. cut potatoes in half & put in pan and sprinkle paprika , salt & pepper to taste
3. peel the garlic cloves and scatter them all over the potatoes
4. put chicken that has been seasoned with salt & pepper & paprika on top of potatoes
5. cook in oven on 350 for about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours basting every so often
demonstrations.review:
A super recipe! Delicious and simple with few ingredients. I found the liquid in the roasting pan dried out quickly, but I topped it up a few times when basting the chicken and veg. The liquid left in the roasting pan made a delicious gravy. I just added gravy granules and boiling water.
My husband and son loved it and the smell of this dish cooking in the oven was very appetising.
This will definitely be a regular dish in our house. Thank you for sharing it with us.

target.recipe_text:
soft batch chocolate chip cookies

a soft & chewy cookie. one of my favorites

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. mix butter , sugar , brown sugar , vanilla and eggs together until creamy
3. add the remaining ingredients and blend well
4. bake until lightly browned
5. store in an air tight container
target.review: Just another rave review. This recipe is definitely a winner. I also used the chocolate pudding mix and the optional cup of nuts(walnuts). Thanks for sharing such wonderful recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
copycat borden s sweetened condensed milk

this is an inexpensive way to make this clone, use in all your recipes calling for one 14-ounce can of sweetened condensed milk.

1. combine all ingredients in a blender or processor
2. mix until completey smooth and combined
3. cool to room temperature
4. if not using right away transfer to an airtight container , and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks
5. use as you would in any recipes calling for sweetened condensed milk
demonstrations.review: Definitely 5 stars. This too, saved a Thanksgiving dessert. I thought I had a can but it turned out to be something else and no time to spare. Thanks to you I had one more thing to be thankful for.  I am so glad you stated that this was equal to a 14 oz. can. I looked at several recipes but this was the first that gave that information. Luckily I had all the ingredients. This was very simple to throw together, worked perfectly, and the taste is so close nobody could tell the difference. Thanks, so much, for posting this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
onion patties

these are delicious!

1. combine flour , baking powder , sugar , salt , pepper and cornmeal
2. add milk and mix well
3. stir in onions
4. drop small mounds of batter into shallow hot oil and fry 5 minutes on each side until golden brown
demonstrations.review: These are very good. I will definitely be making them again. I found after frying a few that I didn't need much oil though and I thought about omitting the sugar myself but after reading several of the reviews, I decided to leave it in and am glad I did. This is a definite winner. Thanks, Stinkerbell.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave bread   butter pickles

my mom just gave me this recipe so i haven't tried it but she said the pickles are delicious.  microwave bread & butter pickles

1. mix all in a 2 quart bowl and microwave on high 8 to 9 minutes , stirring twice during cooking time
2. cukes will be crisp , onions translucent
3. my mom has a small microwave that is not very powerful so she had to microwave hers a little longer
demonstrations.review: These are great bread and butter pickles. I used regular and white pickling cucumbers and substituted half the onions for some red bell pepper. They tasted great and they looked good too. Thanks, Cathi for a great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
target.review: My husband loved it.  He thought it was the best banana bread he's ever had.  I thought it was good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
churros  mexican crullers

yummy mexican snack or dessert. add cinnamon to the sugar for a different taste after they are all cooked. children love these.

1. bring water , sugar and salt to boil
2. remove from heat
3. stir in flour all at once and beat until smooth
4. beat in eggs one at a time until mixture is smooth
5. spoon mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a large star point
6. pipe 3 inch strips onto waxed paper or floured surface
7. add lemon peel to fry fat and heat to 375 degrees
8. fry churros a few at a time for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden , turning as necessary
9. drain on paper towels
10. roll in sugar
demonstrations.review: I rated this recipe before by mistake!  I tried it this time in place of the one I thought I had made and although the cooked texture of the pastries was good the dough was too runny.  They turned out like little yummy pancakes but I wont try again due to the consistency.  Maybe I did something wrong.  Sorry.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
frijoles negros  cuban black beans

ay caramba, these are good!

1. fry the onion and pepper in a little oil
2. add the garlic and saute a little
3. introduce a little of the bean liquid until all previous ingredients are soft
4. add the beans with the remaining liquid
5. add spices and simmer about 30 minutes
6. add the vinegar just before serving
7. these are quite good when served over a bed of rice seasoned with just lime
demonstrations.review: In all fairness, I have to say that I have never had cuban black beans in my life so I dont know what they should or should not taste like.  I was a little turned off my the smell of the vinegar but all in all, they are healthy low fat and very easy to make. I had them with a whole wheat tortilla some fat free sour cream and scrambled egg whites with a huge tablespoon of salsa on the side.  I think I might make again but cut down on the vinegar.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
capirotada  bread pudding

nan

1. toast the sliced bread , break into 2" pieces
2. make a syrup of water , sugar , spices and salt
3. bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes
4. butter an oblong baking pan
5. layer bread , cheese , raisins and butter
6. pour syrup over bread mixture and bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until syrup is absorbed
7. may be served warm or cold
8. if served warm , top with whipped cream
demonstrations.review: Its not capirotada if you use sugar!  It MUST be piloncillo or at the very least brown sugar.  I like the simpleness of this recipe though.  I exchange the cheddar for queso fresco and add nuts to mine. Most traditional recipes also add onions and tomatoes (as weird as it sounds).  I usually leave out the onion.

target.recipe_text:
island kielbasa

my mother gave this recipe to me and it's a quick and easy recipe to make. take it along to your next pot luck...it's always a favorite

1. slice kielbasa into 1 / 2 inch slices and place in crockpot
2. add ketchup , brown sugar and the can of pineapples
3. stir until thoroughly blended
4. cook on low in crockpot for approximately 4-5 hours
target.review: This recipe was very good. I made it for lunch today along with green beans, corn on the cob, and a salad. I cut the recipe in half and used Turkey sausage. I also did not have time to make this in the crockpot. I sauteed my sausage in a dash of olive oil and then once it was golden I added the rest of the ingredients to simmer on Low for 15 minutes. This is a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade cough medicine

this is a home remedy for that horrible cough that you just can't get rid of, and best of all: you probably already have all of the ingredients!

1. mix ingredients
2. take by the teaspoon as often as needed for cough
3. do not give to infants under 12 months due to the honey
demonstrations.review: My husband has a HORRIBLE cough right now and I just whipped this up for him a few minutes ago. He took two tbsp. and pucked up, screamed a bit, kicked his leg out a few times about the taste. We'll report back if this helps him.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
original  nilla banana pudding

posted in response to my own request. :) this is said to be the best and only banana pudding you should make! courtesy nabisco.

1. mix 1 / 2 cup of the sugar , flour and salt in top of double boiler
2. blend in 3 egg yolks and milk
3. cook , uncovered , over boiling water 10 to 12 minutes or until thickened , stirring constantly
4. remove from heat
5. stir in vanilla
6. reserve 10 of the wafers for garnish
7. spread small amount of custard on bottom of 1-1 / 2-quart baking dish
8. cover with layers of 1 / 3 each of the remaining wafers and sliced bananas
9. pour about 1 / 3 of the remaining custard over bananas
10. continue to layer wafers , bananas and custard to make a total of 3 layers of each , ending with custard
11. beat egg whites on high speed of electric mixer until soft peaks form
12. gradually add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar , beating until stiff but not dry
13. spoon over custard
14. spread evenly to cover entire surface of custard and sealing well to edge
15. bake at 350f for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned
16. cool slightly or refrigerate several hours until chilled
17. top with reserved wafers just before serving
18. garnish with additional banana slices , if desired
demonstrations.review: The overall dish had a good flavor, very rich. I followed the recipe exactly and had a runny clear liquid under my layer of meringue. This did not hinder the flavor and I believe it was extra juice from the bananas I used.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yes  virginia there is a great meatloaf

absolutely delicious meatloaf and sauce! those who claim they don't believe there can be such a thing as a great meatloaf will love this. based on a meatloaf given to me by a dear friend, virginia strehl, memphis, and leesburg, fla. nita holleman, 2000

1. meatloaf: combine meat loaf ingredients and place into a loaf baking dish
2. smooth out top
3. sauce: combine sauce ingredients and pour on top and sides of meatloaf
4. bake at 350f about 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes or until done
5. enjoy !
6. the addition of 1 or 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet makes this recipe very good
7. recipe should be"plump" from the addition of the milk or half & half
8. it should not be runny
9. a second batch of sauce served hot is good to serve with the meatloaf
10. nita's
11. it is wise to have some fat added to the deer -- especially to ground deer
12. maybe 25 % fat , , otherwise your results will be poor
13. i don't know about some of the other game meat some are using
14. please consult an expert
15. the recipe is delicious as it stands ! enjoy ! nita holleman
demonstrations.review: The Hubby & I loved this recipe. It's quick to put together and has a wonderful aroma while in the oven. I used 4 TBSP of apple cider vinegar and I could smell the vinegar in the sauce with each bite I took. I will reduce this to 2 Tbsp of apple cider vinegar next time. Also, I did not make any extra sauce for putting on the meatloaf after it was done and ready to eat, it was perfect just as it was.

target.recipe_text:
chicken sausage gumbo

this is a low-fat version of chicken gumbo. add some red pepper and hot sausage if you prefer it hot.

1. in pot , put 6 cups water , chicken buillion , tomatoes , okra , spices , chicken meat
2. bring to a boil , then reduce to simmer
3. in pan , put oil , sausage , and fresh vegetables
4. cook unitil sausage is browned and veggies are softening
5. add contents of pan to pot of liquid
6. simmer for 20 minutes
7. serve over rice
target.review: I've lived in Louisiana most of my life, and I say it is gumbo. Roux is made out of oil and flour. It's not an ingredient in this gumbo because this is a lower calorie version. The nutrition information does not accurately reflect the calories because the chicken is meat only, the sausage is low fat. The only oil is the 1-2 tbs you use for the sausage and vegetables.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
plain roasted artichoke hearts

can't believe it, but there's no other recipe like this on recipezaar (unless i somehow missed it).  these babies are so, so good.  i roasted canned artichoke hearts in connection with another recipe i invented, and was so pleased with the way they came out even without the topping, so i'm posting a plain(er) version.  if you want the topped version, go to recipe no. 144997.  i found that roasting them enhanced the taste and texture - made them more tender on the inside:d  one of these "throw it in the oven and ignore while you are fixing other parts of dinner" recipes!

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. drain artichokes in colander and rinse a bit to remove brine
3. mix gently with garlic and olive oil in a bowl
4. pour artichoke mixture in a metal roasting pan and roast for about one hour , tossing a few times if desired
5. sprinkle with salt and pepper , and add lemon juice and butter
demonstrations.review: Very easy and delicious. Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey wheat oatmeal bread

simple to put together and tastes wonderful.

1. put into bread pan in the order suggested by your machine's manufacturer: set the machine for the regular white bread cycle , and if you can adjust the darkness , you don't want this to get too dark
2. if you prefer a softer crust , easier to slice for sandwiches , then as soon as you take it out of the pan , put it right into a large plastic bag , and close tightly
3. the hot bread will steam the crust and make it very soft
demonstrations.review:
I made this recipe with 2 cups whole wheat and one cup white bread flour; I added an extra 1/2 tsp yeast; and used plain vegetable oil instead of olive oil. I used the whole wheat setting on my bread machine, which takes a little longer. I used the 1 1/2 pound setting, as some others have mentioned; and light crust setting (which I always use).

It came out great. It has a mild slightly sweet flavor and a nice texture. I think it'd be fine for sandwiches and is definitely good with butter and dunked into stew.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tish s crock pot corned beef and cabbage

a whole meal...easy to put together and come home to.

1. place onions in slow cooker
2. place corned beef with carrots on top
3. mix together apple juice , brown sugar , orange peel , cloves , garlic , mustard and pour over top
4. add water or additional apple juice if needed to cover the top of the beef
5. cover and cook low 8-10 hours or high for 5-6 hours
6. place cabbage on top the last 3 hours , pushing down to moisten
7. turn on high and cook until cabbage is done
8. serve with horseradish on the side
demonstrations.review: We didn't really like this one.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s onion patties latkes

i have been making these for over 20 years, i usually get about 15 patties but it depends on the size of the batter that you drop in the pan, these are better if fried to very brown and crispy, you can make a double recipe, fry them then freeze them on a tray then pop them into freezer bags, then just warm them in the oven to crisp up, they are very addicting and i can tell you i eat half before they even get to the table lol!  if you plan on doubling the recipe then make two separate recipes in two bowls, i have doubled the recipe into one bowl and for some reason they just are not as good ---  if desired you could add in a slightly beaten large egg and reduce the milk by 1/4 cup --- you will *love* these!  also see my
recipe#186700 *and*
recipe#244592

1. chop the onions finely then place into a bowl
2. in another large bowl mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder , seasoning salt , cayenne , garlic powder and a small amount of black pepper
3. mix to combine well
4. add in the milk and whisk until thoroughly combined
5. add in the chopped onions and green onions and mix with a wooden spoon until combined
6. in a large non-stick frypan , heat a small amount of oil to medium-hot , adding in more oil as needed as the patties will absorb too much oil if you add in a large amount of oil at one time
7. drop the batter from a tablespoon into about 1 / 2-inch of hot oil
8. flatten slightly with the spoon or spatula
9. sprinkle with a little salt
10. fry until crispy and brown on both sides
target.review: UNREAL. Ok, I love onions, but I never would have thought they could be THIS good. This is the kind of recipe that could make me a vegetarian. A vegetarian who only eats onions. Who only eats THESE onions. Slight alterations based on the commandments of my tongue and what I had on hand: I used one large yellow onion and three scallions, just a pinch of cayenne and both the optional ingredients - garlic powder and pepper. I fried them at about 275-300 degrees for roughly 6 minutes on each side until dark brown (the way God intended!), flattening them a bit before flipping. This goes right into my "Encore" cookbook with much appreciation to you, KITTENCAL!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamed mushrooms on multigrain toast

for breakfast, brunch, lunch, or a light dinner.

1. melt the butter in a saute pan over medium heat
2. add in the shallots
3. stir / saute 1-2 minutes or until the shallot begins to soften
4. stir in the mushrooms
5. cook 6-8 minutes or until they are limp and have given up much of their liquid
6. add in the stock , cream , salt , and pepper
7. cook until the liquid reduces by about half
8. arrange toast on 4 plates
9. top each with an equal portion of mushrooms and sauce
10. dust with paprika and serve
