4. put into a crock pot
5. combine sauce ingredients in a sauce pan and heat pour over meatballs
6. cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours
7. put on sub rolls along with provolone cheese and put under the broiler for a few minutes till cheese melts
8. serve hot
demonstrations.review: The past 9 years I live in a small town, this took me back to my city days where I had access to good Italian restaurants and food. Was a perfect meal on a cold Saturday night. Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco cheesecake

this appetizer proves that cheesecake is not just for dessert. very good and the presentation of this is impressive. enjoy! helpful hint: when cutting or seeding hot peppers, use rubber or plastic gloves to protect your hands and avoid touching your face. prep time includes overnight refrigeration.

1. sprinkle bottom of greased 9-inch springform pan with cornmeal
2. set aside
3. in mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
4. add the taco seasoning , sour cream and salsa
5. stir in the eggs , pepper jack cheese and chilies
6. fold in olives
7. pour over cornmeal
8. place pan on a baking sheet
9. bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until center is almost set
10. cool on a wire rack for about 10 minutes
11. carefully run a knife around edge of pan to loosen
12. cool for 1 hour
13. refrigerate overnight
14. remove sides of pan
15. spread sour cream over top and sides of cheesecake
16. arrange olives , onions , tomatoes and jalapeno slices on top in a circular motion
17. i do tomatoes on the outer edge , then green onion , jalapeno , then scatter black olives randomly , within the circle
18. serve with assorted crackers
demonstrations.review: This is a great party pleaser. I did mix it up a little with another recipe I had by crushing 1 cup nacho flavored tortilla chips  and 1/4 C. melted butter, mixed together pressed in springform pan and baked at 350 for 10 min. VERY good either way. Someone at work made and all were asking for this recipe.....

target.recipe_text:
m   m dream bars

these are yummy! the original recipe called for red and green christmas m&ms, but i see no reason to relegate this delicious treat to just the holidays. :)

1. combine oatmeal , brown sugar , flour , coconut , baking soda , and salt
2. add melted butter and stir until moist
3. reserve 1 1 / 2 cups and press remaining crumbs into a greased 13x9-inch baking pan
4. bake 12 minutes at 375f
5. combine milk and peanut butter
6. carefully spread over baked crust
7. sprinkle on m&m's and chocolate chips
8. sprinkle reserved crumbs over chocolate pieces and lightly press crumbs down
9. bake 20 minutes , or until golden brown
10. cool completely before cutting
target.review: These were SO good. I took them to a Superbowl party, froze the leftovers, and served them at another event. They freeze well too! The combination of the sweet, crumbly streusel, M & Ms and thick peanut butter layer is to die for. They're quite easy to make as well!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry cheesecake trifle

awesome! this gives a whole new meaning to strawberry shortcake. great dessert for after any meal and a definite crowd pleaser and easy to prepare. (cooking time is estimated chill time.)

1. in a large bowl , beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until fluffy
2. add sour cream , 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla and the almond extract
3. set aside
4. fold the cool whip into the cream cheese mixture
5. gently stir in cake pieces
6. set aside
7. combine strawberries and sugar , stirring until sugar is dissolved
8. layer in a large glass bowl , starting with 1 / 4 of the strawberries , then adding 1 / 3 of the cake mixture
9. continue layering
10. finish with strawberries
11. cover with plastic wrap
12. and chill several hours
demonstrations.review: Made for an office-wide function, along with several other trifles, and this  was the first to go. It seems simple, but it's a knockout recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gingerbread truffles

these are awesome!! i made these to go in my gingerbread gift bag for all the teachers, along with gingerbread scones (gift bag) recipe #132399,   gingerbread caramel corn recipe #118625, and crockpot apple butter recipe #93886. prep time does not include time needed to chill.

1. in microwave-safe container or on top of stove , melt the white chocolate chips with cream
2. stir in cinnamon , ginger and cloves
3. pour into shallow pan
4. refrigerate 1-2 hours or overnight until firm but pliable
5. roll into 1-inch balls , chill again until firm
6. you can do this my sticking them into the freezer
7. reroll into a nice ball shape
8. dip into melted candy
9. roll in sprinkles
10. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Delicious! I made these to give as Christmas gifts and they were to die for! The combination of the smooth spiced filling and chocolate coating are simply divine. Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach mushroom lasagna roll ups with gorgonzola cream sauce

this is a wonderfully flavored dish that my hubby swears is my best dinner yet! served with asparagus topped with some of the sauce is superb.

1. saut mushrooms , chopped onion and garlic in oil over med heat , until mushrooms give off their juice and onion is tender- 7-8 minutes
2. season with salt and pepper
3. add dry chopped spinach to the pan and heat through
4. add ricotta , adjust salt and pepper and heat through
5. remove from burner , but leave in warm skillet
6. heat broth in small sauce pan
7. add gorgonzola into broth , and bring to a bubble
8. stir in cream and thicken about 2 minutes
9. place cooked noodles on work surface
10. place a dollop of spinach mixture on one end of noodles and roll each one up
11. arrange rolled packages , seam side down , in shallow casserole dish
12. pour warm sauce over and top with mozzarella
13. place casserole under broiler to melt mozzarella and slightly brown
demonstrations.review: Made this for a dinner party...alongside eggplant parmesan...and it was fabulous! Great flavor, and not that difficult to prepare. The sauce took a bit longer than stated, but other than that, prep was fairly easy. I also reduced the fat by using part-skim ricotta and fat-free half and half instead of cream. I WILL be making again!

target.recipe_text:
chickpeas with spinach  greek

nothing fancy about this dish - just good eating. round off with some feta cheese and crusty bread.

1. in a large saucepan , over medium heat , saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until the onions are tender
2. add the chickpeas , tomatoes , pepper flakes , and oregano , and paprika
3. cover and simmer for about 18 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. add spinach and cook about 7 minutes longer , or until spinach is cooked
5. add the lemon juice , salt and pepper
target.review:
This has quickly become a weekday staple in our house. We use fresh silverbeet rather than frozen spinach, and just wilt it.

Very yummy with toasted pita bread, and with crumbled feta on top. 

Thanks for the great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tuscan white bean   spinach soup

this dish was inspired by vote_for_pedro's white bean & spinach soup.  like the original, this is quick, easy and full of flavor. it makes a nice dinner for 4 served with a good salad or it can be a starting course and serve more.  use 3 or 4 cups of broth according to how thick you like your soups or how much liquid your pasta absorbs.

1. in a large sauce pan , sautee the shallots & garlic in the olive oil
2. add broth , tomatoes , beans and rosemary to pot
3. season with black and red pepper
4. bring to boil
5. add pasta and cook 12 minutes
6. if the soup seems too thick for your liking add a bit more broth
7. add spinach and cook until wilted
demonstrations.review:
Very nice.

A definite keeper for those "in a hurry, what can I make out of the pantry" nights. (Why are there so many of those???)

We really enjoyed this simple, tasty soup.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chickpea curry  garbanzos

with a picture! a delicious, easy, stovetop vegetarian indian curry that makes a yummy lunch! based on a recipe i got from mrcurrys.com with a sample of their wonderful curry seasoning powder.

1. saute onions in olive oil for 3 minutes
2. add ginger , garlic and curry powder , stir and cook for another minute or so
3. add chickpeas and salt and a tablespoon or so of water
4. cook and stir about a minute
5. add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes , stirring gently
6. add another spoonful of water if it seems dry or if it's burning or sticking
7. serve with flatbread and rice
demonstrations.review:
I've tried making this twice. The first time, it was not so nice, but I put that down to the fact I only had pretty ordinary curry powder.
The second time, I cut way back on the oil, and used two heaped teaspoons of tandoori curry paste, and added a shake of garum masala right at the end before serving. What a difference! Very yummy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red lentil and carrot soup with coconut for the crock pot

the coconut milk in this recipe creates a nutty and interesting flavor.

1. in a large skillet cook onions in the olive oil until soft
2. add garlic , turmeric , cumin seeds , salt and pepper
3. cook , stirring for 1 minute
4. add tomatoes and bring to a boil , breaking them up as you stir
5. add carrots , lentils , lemon juice and broth
6. spoon mixture into slow cooker
7. cover and cook on high for 4-5 hours , or low for 8-10 hours
8. stir in coconut milk and continue cooking on high for 20 minutes , until heated through
9. serve topped with fresh cilantro and several dashes of your favorite hot sauce
demonstrations.review:
This is a wonderful recipe...my committed carnivore husband chowed down and really enjoyed it too.
Great colour, wonderful flavour.
I only used four cups of stock, for a more stew-like consistency...I cannot stop raving about this dish!

target.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
target.review: Like it needs one more review- but very good, loved by all, used a total of 8 banana's though!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gooey bars

very rich, easy dessert bars that kids and adults will love. don't plan on taking any home if you bring them to a potluck!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. grease a 9 x 13 inch baking pan , bottom and sides
3. combine yellow cake mix , eggs and margarine in a large mixing bowl
4. mix well
5. using your hands , press mixture into the bottom of the greased pan
6. in another bowl , combine confectioners' sugar , cream cheese and vanilla
7. beat until creamy and smooth
8. spread over top of cake mixture
9. bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
10. cut into squares
demonstrations.review: I must have done something wrong, although reading it over, it seems like I followed it all.  These turned out overly sweet with no other flavor.  Sorry.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tipsy brisket

passed on to me by a co-worker, after a discussion about how to cook beef brisket. a different presentation than the brisket slathered with bbq sauce.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. line a 13x9 inch baking pan with foil and leave enough overlap , so once you place brisket in pan , you can cover brisket with foil
3. place trimmed brisket in pan with foil , cover with onions , and season with salt and pepper
4. set aside 1 / 3 cup beer
5. combine remaining beer , brown sugar , bouillon , 1 / 4 tsp
6. pepper , garlic , and thyme
7. pour mixture over meat and cover with foil
8. bake at 350 degrees for 3-3 1 / 2 hours
9. reserve drippings from pan@ 1 / 2 cup , and combine with 1 / 3 cup beer , and flour in a medium sauce pan
10. season with salt and pepper
11. heat until mixture is bubbley and serve with meat
demonstrations.review: Very good- though I think I missed the Barbque ones- Would be great for using brisket in something else.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
warm artichoke dip

nan

1. preheat oven to 325
2. drain and chop artichoke hearts
3. combine mayo , sour cream , and parmesan cheese
4. mix together artichoke hearts with mayo mixture in an oven safe glass pie dish add garlic to taste
5. bake for 25 minutes
6. serve with crackers or pita bread
demonstrations.review: This is wonderful and I had to double the batch!  Added some oregano for a little green- but truly wonderful-thanks!!

target.recipe_text:
the banana raisin oatmeal cookies that tops them all

i've had this recipe so long, i don't remember where it came from - either a magazine,or newspaper, but it is my daughter's favorite cookie to take to school for a birthday treat. they're really tasty,especially for banana lovers.

1. in a large mixing bowl , cream the shortening or margarine with 1 cup of sugar
2. beat in egg
3. blend in banana and remaining ingredients: mix well
4. drop by teaspoonfuls , 2" apart on lightly greased cookie sheet
5. bake at 400 for 10 to 12 minutes
target.review: These were good. I also added chocolate chips. I thought they came out more of a muffin-texture though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tomato and roasted red pepper soup

this is my favorite soup.  it's a nice balance of sweet and savory, and it freezed beautifully.  i like it with grilled cheese.
(i hate to specify a brand name / hard to find ingredient, but i haven't found a good substitute for thai kitchen's roasted red chili paste.)  
[this is adapted from the naked chef (jamie oliver).]

1. broil the red peppers , turning them so they blacken on all sides
2. once theyre black , put them in a bowl , cover tightly with plastic wrap , and leave them until theyre cool enough to handle
3. peel , seed , and roughly chop them
4. warm the olive oil in a thick-bottomed pot over medium heat
5. add the peppers , chili paste , and a pinch of salt , stir to combine , and cook for 5 minutes
6. finely chop the garlic , add to the pot , and cook for 2 minutes
7. drain the tomatoes , and add to the pot with the red wine vinegar and a pinch of salt
8. cook for 10 minutes
9. add the chicken stock
10. puree with a stick blender until smooth , and simmer for 15 more minutes
demonstrations.review:
this was really good. we followed the directions pretty closely, minus the paste....we couldn't find it and we added a little more garlic.

It was really good. We also ate them with diner grilled cheese. We will make this again, but probably with canned peppers, and we will try and find the paste.

One of chefs at our grocery store asked us to tell him how this turned out, because he is getting bored with the same recipes over, we will DEFINITLY pass this along.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mini pepperoni pizza

these pizzas are really easy and taste great.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. seperate biscuits and place on cookie sheet
3. flatten biscuit until it is about 5" in diameter
4. pinch the sides to make a crust
5. for a tastier pizza , brush on a little olive oil and add a pinch of cumin and oregano
6. put 2 tablespoons of pizza sauce on each biscuit and spread around
7. add pepperoni and then sprinkle about 2-3 tablespoons of cheese on top
8. do not add too much or the pizza will overflow when it is baking
9. bake in oven for 8-11 minutes
10. cool for about 3-4 minutes
demonstrations.review: I learned to make these in Home Ec.... what was that... 8th grade?! They are really yummy. :D

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy honey orange chicken

if you like general tzo's chicken, you will probably like this flavorful dish.  it is both sweet and spicy and is very easy to make.  it can be served with rice, or you can leave the chicken breasts whole, glazed with the spicy honey-orange sauce.  it is very easy to adjust the ingredients to fit your family's taste.  this recipe was adapted from a recipe that was given to me by a friend.

1. in small bowl , combine honey with juice concentrate , orange zest , garlic , and the red pepper flakes
2. set aside
3. pound chicken to approximately 1 / 4 " thickness
4. cut into bite size pieces
5. in a plastic bag mix together the flour , garlic powder , salt and pepper
6. toss chicken pieces to lightly coat with flour mixture
7. in a large non-stick skillet , heat butter and oil over medium-high heat
8. add chicken and stirfry until just cooked through
9. pour honey mixture over chicken and cook , stirring to coat all chicken pieces with spicy honey-orange glaze
10. sprinkle with parsley and green onion
11. pour the glaze over chicken that has been cooked through , turning chicken to coat as sauce begins to thicken , about 2 minutes
12. serve chicken breasts with honey-orange glaze spooned over the top
13. garnish with parsley and green onions
demonstrations.review: We really liked this but we won't make it, as is, again. I had to double the red pepper and it was still too sweet from all the honey. I'll make it with adjustments in the future.

target.recipe_text:
meatloaf barbecue style

this is our favorite meatloaf recipe. it's easy to make, moist and delicious!

1. mix together beef , crumbs , onion , egg , salt , pepper and 1 / 2 can tomato sauce
2. form into loaf and put into loaf pan
3. combine rest of tomato sauce , water , brown sugar , prepared mustard and worcestershire sauce
4. pour over loaf
5. bake in 350f oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes
6. makes 4-6 servings
target.review:
Very tasty and easy to make! 
For the topping sauce, I only put mustard to taste (probably much less than 2tbps). I forgot to add the water, but there was still enough sauce to cover the entire loaf.  I added another few dashes of worcestershire and a tsp or so of thyme to the meatloaf. And I sauteed a minced clove of garlic along with the onions before mixing that in. It turned out very very good, moist, and filling. I only had 1 lb of ground beef, but the recipe still worked out perfectly.

Thank you for a great easy recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cumin scented chicken

the warm distinctive flavor of cumin will make your kitchen a fragrant haven as this cooks. the flavor of cumin is just delicate enough not to be too assertive or pungent in this dish. this is another in the collection of chicken recipes i have acquired to make for my husband (i don't eat chicken), and has won much favor from him.

1. heat pan and dry-roast 1 tablespoons of the cumin seeds until they turn fragrant - set aside
2. heat the oil in a pan and fry the remaining cumin seeds , peppercorns and cardamoms , till aromatic
3. add the chillies , garlic and ginger
4. add the ground coriander and cumin , and salt , and cook for another 2-3 minutes
5. add the chicken pieces , stir and mix thoroughly with the spices
6. cover pan and simmer for 20 minutes approximately
7. add the garam masala and the reserved cumin seeds , and allow to cook an additional 5 minutes
8. garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with a raita on the side if desired
demonstrations.review: Smelled WONDERFUL. I used chili powder instead of fresh chilies and I think next time I need to use a lot more than I did (about 1tsp). Also next time I'll add the garam masala at the beginning of cooking instead of at the end so the flavor has a chance to stick.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
monterey chicken rolls

butter...garlic...cheese? chicken rolled in all? how can this recipe not be a keeper?!! my sister-in-law gave me this recipe some 25 years ago. it's just as good today as it was then - maybe even better since my garlic tastes have increased over the years as well as my "eye-balling" measurements (meaning more garlic!). just be sure not to overcook as the chicken will be dry - follow these directions and the chicken will be moist. this is a great prepare ahead meal that will impress.

1. pound chicken breasts flat
2. slice monterey jack cheese about 1 / 4" thick , roll chicken around cheese
3. dip chicken in butter sauce , then in breadcrumb combination
4. place seam side down in 9x13 baking dish
5. bake covered for 30 minutes at 350 degrees in preheated oven
6. uncover and bake for 15 minutes more or until browned
demonstrations.review: This was delicious, super easy, and made the kitchen smell wonderful. I accidentally got "pepper jack", with jalapenos, at the store, but I think that made this recipe even better.  Served with garlic dinner rolls, and green beans.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
aloo palak  indian potatoes   spinach

i got this aloo palak recipe from daawat.com, but have adjusted it slightly to my liking. it will serve two as a main course when served with naan bread or rice, or four as a side dish. if you like it a little milder deseed the chilies.

1. in a pan cook the spinach with garlic , ginger , onions and the green chilies for about 5-10 minutes
2. remove from the pan and blend to a fine puree and keep aside
3. in the meantime boil the potatoes with salt and turmeric until done , apprximately 10 minutes and set aside when done
4. heat ghee in a pan , fry cumin seeds along with spinach-onion paste and simmer for a few minutes
5. add the cooked potatoes , garam masala , coriander and cumin powder and a little water if needed
6. simmer for few minutes till the potatoes absorb the flavor
7. add fresh cream if desired
demonstrations.review: Very simple and easy to make. Great flavor - the spices really come through. The perfect amount for dinner for two along with some rice.

target.recipe_text:
balti seitan madras

i adapted this recipe from a chicken recipe in an indian cookbook.  it's very flavorful and just the right amount of spice for my taste- but you can always make it spicier. it's my new favorite way to get protein!

1. mix the tomato paste , fennel seeds , ginger , coriander , garlic , chilli powder , curry powder , turmeric , lemon juice , salt , and water in a bowl
2. heat the vegetable oil in a pan and cook the onions until they are softened
3. pour the spice mixture into the pan and let simmer
4. break the seitan into pieces and add to the pan
5. let the seitan simmer for about 10 minutes , until much of the liquid has been absorbed by the seitan or has evaporated
6. remove the pan from the heat , stir in the chopped chiles , and serve
target.review: Good recipe!  I like my curry spicy but I cut back a bit on the chilies (I used jalapeno).  I think if I make it again I will also toss in a handful of chipped cilantro.  I put this one in my cookbook and It'll definitely be hitting the table again in the near future.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
absolute best ever lasagna

my family's favorite. this is a very meaty lasagna. we prefer it with cottage cheese, but you can easily substitute ricotta.

1. brown ground meat , onion and garlic
2. add salt , pepper , parsley , oregano , basil , chopped tomatoes with juice
3. stirring until well mixed
4. cover and simmer 1 hour
5. cook lasagna noodles according to package directions
6. drain and set aside
7. spray a 13 x 9" baking pan with cooking spray
8. combine riccota cheese , eggs , pepper , 2 tablespoons parsley , parmesan cheese and 1 / 2 1lb of mozzarella cheese
9. in a lasagna pan , layer noodles , meat sauce , and cheese mixture
10. repeat
11. top off with layer of noodles
12. sprinkle evenly with remaining mozzarella cheese
13. make sure to cover noodles completely
14. bake at 375f for 40-60 minutes , or until cheese mixture is thoroughly melted
15. (i cover w / foil for about 40 minutes , then uncover for 15-20 minutes
16. let sit for 15-20 minutes before cutting and serving
demonstrations.review: I made two huge pans of this for our Neighborhood Center's Mother's Day celebration and while I didn't actually attend the event, my executive director told me it was "exceptional" and the best lasagna he had ever had.  The residents from the neighborhood mowed down on it  and there's hardly any left.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
couscous for people who hate couscous

my dad used to absolutely hate couscous - until i made it for him.
highly recommended for broadening the horizons of picky eaters - also makes a great stuffing if you add cheese.

1. once you have chopped your vegetables and ground your spices , place the couscous in a large bowl , and add all of the ground spices
2. using a vegetable peeler , shave some butter off the block and place in the bowl
3. bring the chicken stock to a boil , and pour it over the couscous
4. don't stir it
5. place a plate over the bowl to cover it , and set aside
6. melt some butter in a frypan with the garlic , and add the celery and onions
7. fry until the onion starts to become soft
8. add a little more butter to the frypan , and add the mushrooms
9. fry for about 2 minutes over medium heat until the mushroom is soft
10. remove the cover from the bowl of couscous , and stir it gently with a fork , being careful not to mash it
11. add the contents of the frypan , and stir it through gently
12. season with salt and pepper , if desired , and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this one for my wife and we both really liked it.  More than anything the recipe is a good example for how experimental you can get with couscous spices!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mixed vegetable kootu

from vegetariantimes.com

1. pure cilantro leaves , coconut , coconut milk , garlic , serrano chile , coriander , and cayenne pepper in food processor until mixture forms a smooth paste
2. set aside
3. place carrots and sweet potato in large skillet , and cover with 1 cup water
4. bring to a simmer over medium heat , and cook 2 minutes
5. add cauliflower , cover skillet , and simmer 2 minutes
6. add green beans , cover , and cook 2 minutes more , or until vegetables are just tender
7. stir in cilantro-and-coconut paste , and season with salt and pepper , if desired
8. cover , and keep warm
9. meanwhile , heat oil in small skillet over medium-high heat
10. add mustard seeds , and cover
11. cook 30 seconds , or until sizzling subsides , then stir in curry leaves , if using
12. stir mustard seeds and curry leaves into vegetables
13. serve hot or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: Very fresh and pleasant taste.  It turns out more like a Southeast Asian dish than Tamil one.

target.recipe_text:
angus barn s chocolate chess pie

this recipe is courtesy of angus barn in raleigh nc

thad eure jr. and charles m. winston opened the angus barn in 1960 when this part of raleigh was a pastoral, country setting. today, the angus barn is in the midst of the action between the rdu airport, raleigh and durham. it is consistently ranked as one of the top 100 restaurants in the u.s.. when you pay your bill, this recipe is given to you on a beautifully decorated card.  it is a most requested recipe from their restaurant.

i have had the pleasure in indulging in this sinfully delicious dessert on several occasions, ok i'll be honest, every time i go to angus barn lol...  it is incredibly delicious with the richness only chocolate can bring and let me tell you, your chocolate craving will be gone with the indulgence of this pie!  the time is not including making your own  pie crust, if that is what you use.  ************************************************for those of you wondering what the pie looks like and to see the original recipe go to:  http://abclocal.go.com/wtvd/story?section=resources/lifestyle_community/food/recipes&id=5985711.  it shows the recipe and the cooks who make it and how their pie comes out using this exact recipe!  click on recipes where it says check it out, down on the left hand side of the column... then type in angus barn and it will pull it up, then click on the picture of the pie to bring it up...

1. melt butter and chocolate
2. mix with other ingredients which have been blended together
3. pour into pie crust ,
4. bake 35 minutes , at 350
5. top with whipped cream
target.review: Oh Linda!  You saved my life!  Tonight I was just DYING for AB chocolate chess pie.  I went to my recipe book and the little scrap of paper that held this magical recipe was nowhere to be found.  AH!!!  Luckily, you have posted it here for us all!!!!  Now if we could just fast forward baking time.... :-)  Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jean s canned brunswick stew

this recipe comes from jean, a friend of mine at work. this is the absolute best brunswick stew i have ever had, she had a hard time convincing me this was made from all canned ingredients. this is a must try recipe!!!

1. open all the cans
2. empty them , including the juice , into a large stock pot
3. cook over medium heat for at least one hour
4. hint: some of my other co-workers add 1 extra can of the barbecue pork and / or 1 sauteed onion
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I'm a North Carolina girl and I still can not believe I bought CANNED bbq.  Ewww!!!  In fact, I was nervous to eat this for dinner tonight.  However... I decided to be brave.  And... I'M SO GLAD!!!  This stuff is awesome!!!  I followed Greatdin-din's review and added lima beans (you know it!) and the cans of various corn.  It's a good thing the pot is still on the stove because I'm going to need another bowl.  YUM!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
polenta pizza crust  gluten free  yeast free

i have been scouring the net to try and find a cornmeal crust that imitates the one from capital creations pizza in raleigh, nc. this one doesn't follow the ingredients in their pizza, but definitely sounds interesting anyway. recipe from www.melborponsti.com

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. lightly oil a large baking sheet
3. in a large bowl , mix polenta with the cold water
4. add the boiling water in a slow stream , blending with a whisk
5. add the eggs and mozzarella and mix well
6. press mixture evenly onto greased baking sheet or pizza pan
7. bake a few minutes to set slightly , top and bake 5-10 minutes more until lightly browned and crisp
demonstrations.review: Capital Creations is the best!  I'm excited to see RALEIGH mentioned on 'zaar... especially from someone who lives across the country!  Hopefully I'll have time to play with this recipe sometime soon.  Thanks for posting, Roosie!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best snickerdoodles i have ever eaten

"this must be one of the best cookies i have ever eaten." yep, that's what my mother said the first time i ever made this cookie. it is a great cookie recipe, and not difficult to make at all. i tripled the recipe and took it to school to sell... i sold all of them with in an 80 minute time span to only 4 people. they are good cookies, i can't resist them whenever i make them. and they turn out so nice whenever you bake them, it's hard to make an ugly snickerdoodle. lol. enjoy. (prep time is estimated)

1. in a large bowl , cream butter and sugars at high speed
2. add egg , vanilla , and beat until smooth
3. in another bowl , combine flour , salt , baking soda , and cream of tartar
4. pour dry ingredients into the wet ingredients , mix well
5. preheat oven to 300 while you let dough rest 30-60 minutes in fridge
6. in a small bowl combine topping
7. take about 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of dough and roll it into a ball
8. roll this dough in the cinnamon / sugar mixture and press onto greased cookie sheet
9. bake cookies 10-12 minutes , no more
10. cookies may seem undercooked but will develop
11. don't roll your dough into too big of a ball
12. they may not turn out in that much time if you do that
13. it happened to me
14. lol
15. if the cookies don't turn out , please try again
16. it's a very good cookie , it's just all a matter of getting the cooking time right
demonstrations.review: I'm babysitting, it's snowing outside, and the kids are bored but don't want chocolate... PERFECT recipe!  We've had the most fun and are now sick to our stomachs.  They're a little soft in the center, but any longer in the oven and they'd be too crispy elsewhere.  Delicious!

target.recipe_text:
zucchini chocolate cake

don't you just love it when you can get your daily vegetable requirements from the dessert you eat? and a chocolate dessert at that!

1. cream butter then add oil and sugar
2. mix
3. add next 8 ingredients
4. mix well
5. fold in the chips and nuts by hand
6. put in a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
7. bake at 325 for 1 hour or until done
target.review: Very moist and very delicious.  Thanks for filling that chocolate craving along with a serving of veggies!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy crock pot macaroni and cheese

from company's coming slow cooker recipes. i love to make this when my kids have skating lessons. i can throw it into the crockpot after school and when lessons are over, dinner is waiting. if you are lucky enough to have two crock pots, you can have a glazed ham going in the other one and your dinner is ready to go!

1. spray crockpot with non-stick spray for easy cleaning
2. in a saucepan , combine first 5 ingredients
3. pour in milk and stir with a whisk until no lumps remain
4. heat and continue stirring until mixture boils and is thickened
5. add cheese and then macaroni
6. stir until well mixed
7. pour into 3 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
8. cover and cook on low for 2-2 1 / 2 hours or on high for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: I thought the taste was pretty good coming fresh out of the crockpot. My fiance heated up in the microwave when he got home and did not care for it. It was probably because it is not your traditional style mac and cheese so prepare your taste buds ahead of time. Next time, I will omit the onions and add it bit more cheese to see if he likes it better that way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
3 packet roast

a wonderful roast with a very tasty gravy

1. place roast in crock
2. mix mixes , and sprinkle over roast
3. pour water in around sides
4. cook 6-8 hours on low
demonstrations.review:
The finished product was very good in flavor, though a little on the salty side.  This might have been because I forgot to "mix the mixes" before adding them to the crockpot.  I just put them in one on top of the other.  Next time (and there will be a next time as my BF really enjoyed this recipe) I will mix the mixes first and see if this changes the salty taste.  I might also add some potatoes to the crockpot as well.
When I took the meat out, I had plenty of juices to make gravy with.  Yummmmmy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot bbq pork

i made this recipe up one afternoon when i didn't have all the ingredients to make what i wanted. my friend carrie loved it and requested the recipe to make for herself. it's an easy recipe and a unique flavor.

1. put the pork loin in a large crock pot
2. add beer and italian dressing
3. cook on low for 6 hours or until it starts to fall apart , turning occasionally
4. when finished cooking , drain off juices
5. shred pork with a fork
6. add bbq & teriyaki sauce
7. stir well
8. continue to cook on low for another hour or until completed heated
9. add more bbq or teriyaki to taste
10. serve on buns with pepper jack cheese
demonstrations.review: I am the Carrie that she speaks of...and of course I have made this and love it.  Various times, I have left out the beer, and it tastes just as wonderful!!  My soon-to-be DH loves this recipe as well.  Thanks Jen!

target.recipe_text:
caramelized butternut squash

this is a delicious butternut squash recipe from ina garten / the barefoot contessa. we really enjoy this during the holidays. it is best when the squash is cut in medium to large chunks so that the outside gets a maple-flavored crust, and the inside stays soft and delicious.

1. preheat the oven to 400f
2. cut off the ends of each butternut squash and discard
3. peel the squash and cut in half lengthwise
4. using a spoon , remove the seeds
5. cut the squash into 1 1 / 4" to 1 1 / 2" cubes , and place them on a baking sheet
6. add the melted butter , brown sugar , salt and pepper
7. with clean hands , toss all of the ingredients together and spread out in a single layer on the baking sheet
8. roast for 45 minutes to 55 minutes , until the squash is tender and the glaze begins to caramelize
9. turn the squash while roasting a few times with a spatula to be sure it browns evenly
10. adjust seasonings if needed
11. serve hot
12. enjoy !
target.review: 10 Stars... This was our first time eating Butternut Squash.  To make this easier, I bought the ready to use butternut squash from Costco.  I melted the butter and added sea salt, pepper and brown sugar in a small pot.  I then added squash cubes into the warm melted mixture, coated each piece, then placed into a baking pan.  Everyone including the 3 yr old asked for seconds.  Great Recipe!! Also, good for 1st time butternut squash eaters.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
killer  lasagna

this was originally my mom's recipe and used to be a favorite when we were kids. i always requested it for my birthday dinner.

1. brown the sausage and ground meat and drain all the fat
2. add all the other ingredients for the meat filling and simmer on the stove , uncovered , for about 1 / 2 hour
3. i usually add a bay leaf or two
4. mix up the cheese filling and set aside in fridge until ready to use
5. put the noodles in salted water and cook until soft when poked with a fork
6. when the noodles are done , drain the noodles and rinse off with cold water so they can be handled easily
7. spray the baking pan with a non-stick spray and put a layer of noodles down on the bottom of the pan
8. it is ok to cut some of the noodles to fit into the pan if they do not fit whole
9. spread half the cheese filling over the noodels , then half of the mozarella cheese on top of that , then half of the meat sauce over the grated mozarella cheese
10. repeat layers and then top with more mozarella cheese
11. bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
12. let stand for 10 minutes before cutting into it
13. leftovers can be easily stored in the freezer
demonstrations.review: Yum, Yum, Yum!  This was terrific. We added extra garlic, used turkey sausage and ground beef, total of 1 tsp salt, added extra sauce (1 jar of Organic spaghetti sauce) This also freezes well. Great recipe-Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cold macaroni tuna salad

this is the answer for me on a hot summer day. i could eat the whole bowl. usually serve on lettuce with a tall glass of lemonade.

1. cook macaroni according to package directions , drain in colander and rinse with cold water
2. in a large bowl , place the macaroni and peas
3. add the eggs and tuna
4. mix well
5. mix together mayo , salt , and pepper
6. add to tuna mixture a little at a time
7. mix well
8. cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight
demonstrations.review: This was wonderful.  My husband does not like tuna and he ate this without a complaint.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the ultimate killer cookies of all time

i got these through one of those internet recipe chain letter thingies, and you know what? these are really good!

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. in a large mixing bowl , combine oats , corn flakes , sugars , raisins and coconut
3. add eggs , vanilla and melted butter
4. mix till well blended
5. mix in chocolate chips
6. in a separate bowl , mix flour salt , baking powder and baking soda
7. add flour mixture and stir until it is all incorporated into the dough
8. drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a greased cookie sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes or until nicely browned
9. cool on a wire rack
demonstrations.review: WOW!!! My husbands exact words were "This is the only cookie that I ever want to eat". He ate them so fast that I had to make a second batch-and he helped. smiles. Instead of corn flakes we used rice krispies. Yum!! Great Cookie. Thanks!!

target.recipe_text:
master brine recipe for meats

soak for 48 hours before using-it will help produce the juicyyyyyy-est meat you have ever made!

1. bring all ingredients to a boil in a large saucepan , reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
2. allow to cool completely before using
3. large heavy duty sealable plastic bags work the best
target.review: Perfect for pork chops!! It worked so well I soaked the boneless chops for 24 hours. They were amazing!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot bbq ribs

this is my own finger licking good recipe that is a hit every time and you don't even have to fire up the barbie!

1. combine rub ingredients mixing well
2. rub on all sides of ribs
3. place ribs meaty side up in crock pot
4. cover
5. cook on low for 6 hours
6. drain the grease from the crock
7. place the ribs back in and cover with bbq sauce
8. cook for another hour
demonstrations.review: This is a great recipe! I used boneless Texas Style Beef Ribs. My ribs were done in 3 hours on low. I was shocked by that. I would cut the cayenne down to 1/4t for us it was a little too hot.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
awesome pan fried potatoes

i made this up tonight in search of something different from baked(boiled)potatoes.  my oven was not working yet so i decided to pan fry them and they were a hit.   ***updated on 9/16 to add that potatoes should be browned and to add more oil as needed.

1. microwave potatoes for 5-6 minutes to soften
2. cut potatoes into bite size pieces
3. dice onion
4. spray large frying pan with olive oil and add potatoes , onions , paprika and garlic adding more oil as needed to brown the potatoes
5. cook on medium heat until tender and browned
6. when done , add white wine and salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: These are soooo good and sooo simple. I could never get my potatoes to cook through until I found this recipe and found the out the trick! I am making them for the second time this week!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tsr version of red lobster cheddar bay biscuits by todd wilbur

from www.topsecretrecipes.com. the cold butter is the secret. it's not included in other copy cat recipes.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. combine bisquick and cold butter
3. don't combine too thoroughly
4. there should be small chunks of butter about the size of peas
5. add cheddar , milk and 1 / 4 tsp garlic
6. mix by hand until combined , but don't over mix
7. drop 9 equal portions onto greased cookie sheet
8. bake for 15-17 minutes or until tops are light brown
9. melt 2 tbsp butter in a bowl
10. stir in 1 / 2 tsp garlic powder and parsley flakes
11. use a pastry brush to spread garlic butter over tops of biscuits
demonstrations.review: Excellent!! The only thing I would change is I would add more garlic powder next time

target.recipe_text:
panera s cream cheese potato soup

this is my favorite recipe for potato soup.  it's a copycat of the one they use to serve at the st. louis bread company (panera).  the recipe originally called for shredding your potatoes, but i never could get them to cook that way. i know they should cook faster, but i never could get it to work.

1. combine broth , potatoes , and spices
2. boil on medium heat until potatoes are tender
3. smash a few of the potatoes to release their starch for thickening
4. reduce to low heat
5. add cream cheese
6. heat , stirring frequently , until cheese melts
target.review: This is my staple when I'm feeling sick and need some comfort soup!  My husband is allergic to onions, so I add onion powder instead.  I also add carrots and celery while boiling the potatos - just to have a bit more color.  I also added celery seed and salt the last time I made this, and I thought it really enhanced the flavor.  Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
highland chicken

this is our favorite chicken dish! there is something about the cream sherry marinade that makes this chicken absolutely fabulous. the chicken develops a very complex flavor and the sauce is wonderfully tasty. the sauce is lovely made with either the cream or the low fat milk/water option. since we don't usually have heavy cream onhand, the lowfat option was born and i am very happy with the result. hope you enjoy this dish as much as we do.

1. in a shallow pan combine the following ingredients to make the marinade: sherry , garlic , oil , salt , pepper and thyme
2. add the chicken to the marinade , cover and refridgerate for 30 minutes or more
3. when chicken has marinated for at least 30 minutes , melt butter in a frying pan over medium high heat
4. quickly brown the chicken breasts , then lower the heat , cover and cook for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink in the middle
5. transfer chicken to plates
6. add water to pan to deglaze it
7. add remaining marinade to pan , bring to a boil and simmer until reduced by half
8. add cream or low-fat milk and water alternative and heat through
9. pour sauce over chicken
10. serve with noodles or rice and roasted seasonal vegetables for a wonderful meal
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe and serve it over rice. It's very easy and even my husband can make it! I changed a few things with the recipe. I used cooking sherry instead of cream sherry and skim milk instead of the heavy cream. I've never made this the original way, but I'm very pleased with the adapted recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
big batch spaghetti sauce

great way to make up a large batch of tomato sauce from your garden to freeze or can for later use.

1. heat oil in large pan
2. saute onions and garlic until tender
3. add rest of ingredients
4. heat to boiling
5. reduce heat
6. simmer , partially covered , for 2 hours
7. stir occasionally
8. after it has simmered , cool completely and store in freezer bags or containers in increments that you find best for your family
9. or process in a boiling covered canner for 35 minutes
10. favorite ingredients can be added like sliced mushrooms , cooked / drained sausage , hamburger , etc
11. this sauce is great for any italian dish
12. great as a sauce for pasta and as a pizza sauce
demonstrations.review: This sauce is delicious!  I've never made my own spaghetti sauce, so I was a bit worried.  I did not peel my tomatoes (mainly because I didn't know I was suppose to until right now!) and the sauce still turned out fine.  I put the tomatoes in the food processor, so it must have taken care of the skin!  I canned my sauce, so I'm very excited to enjoy this throughout the winter!  Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flawless sesame chicken  restaurant style

this is the recipe you've been looking for!  it makes a perfect sesame chicken.  this excellent recipe comes out perfect every time with little fuss and inexpensive ingredients you probably have on hand.  this recipe is truly restaurant quality... try it, you won't be disappointed! (recipe courtesy of "reykjaviky" at all recipes)

1. cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes
2. mix the marinade ingredients and marinate the chicken for 20 minutes
3. to prepare the sauce:
4. mix together all of the sauce ingredients
5. pour them into a small pot and bring to a boil , stirring continuously
6. turn the heat down to low and keep warm while you are deep-frying the chicken
7. to deep-fry the chicken:
8. add the marinated chicken pieces a few at a time , and deep-fry until golden brown
9. drain on paper towels and then place chicken in warm oven while you continue frying
10. repeat with the remainder of the chicken
11. just before you are finished deep-frying , bring the sauce back up to a boil
12. place the chicken on a large platter and pour the sauce over
13. sprinkle with sesame seeds
14. serve the sesame chicken with rice
demonstrations.review: I used 1/4 c rice wine vinegar in the sauce -- WAY too much.  I could only taste the vinegar, so it really ruined the dish.  I think if you add only 1/8 c, it might not taste as bad, but I won't be making it again.

target.recipe_text:
easy stir fry sauce

a basic stir fry sauce that i've been using for years. i got the recipe from my mother, but i don't know where she got it from. i make no claim to authenticity.

1. combine all ingredients in a large glass jar with a lid
2. screw lid on
3. shake well
4. can store in fridge up to 2 weeks
5. shake well before using
6. to use sauce: stir fry your vegetables and meat as desired , add appropriate amount of sauce , bring to a boil , boil for 1 minute or until slightly thickened
7. serve
target.review: My guys loved this recipe - I made a massive amount of stir fry and used half of the recipe, it fed three adults and we had some left overs.  Since it keeps in the fridge well, I can use the other half next week - since we eat a lot of stir fry!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot beef stew

a delicious beef stew recipe. great for cold winter evenings!

1. place meat in crock pot
2. combine flour , salt , and pepper
3. pour flour mixture over meat and stir to coat well
4. add remaining ingredients and stir
5. cover and cook on low 10-12 hours or high 4-6 hours
6. stir before serving
demonstrations.review: I intended to make this in the crock pot but ran out of time, so I did it on the stove top with a little more heat to cook everything faster.  My husband loved it and after nerly doubling the recipe we ended up with only a small container of left-overs.  Great stew!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
erna s apple pie muffins

when our first daughter was born, a friend brought us a pail of these delicious muffins. it was such a thoughful gesture and perfect to snack on during that first couple days at home. whenever i make these now i can still 

1. topping-mix all together , until mixture forms crumbs
2. batter- whisk together egg , buttermilk , butter , and vanilla
3. stir in sugar
4. without mixing , add flour , baking soda , salt and apples
5. stir just until combined
6. do not over mix
7. spoon into muffin cups
8. sprinkle with the topping
9. bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until firm to the touch
demonstrations.review: Oh my goodness gracious - these are amazing. Wonderful recipe, followed it to a "T" and have passed it on to so many people. Thanks for the great treat!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hamburger   fries dinner

this recipe is quick to fix and any sort of ground meat can be used.  my family usually eats ground turkey.

1. preheat oven 375f
2. cook meat , onion
3. add corn and soup
4. put fries in greased 9-in
5. square baking dish
6. cover with cheese , then meat mixture
7. bake at 375f for 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Had to tweak it a bit since it was a last minute dinner - didn't have the corn so I used a small package of frozen mixed veggies.  I also shredded too much cheese so I put some on top for the last couple minutes of cooking.  VERY EASY to prepare and a great recipe!  Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
whole wheat sour cream coffee cake

healthier version of the classic sour cream coffee cake. delicious!

1. mix all filling ingredients
2. set aside
3. heat oven to 350f
4. grease 12-cup fluted tube cake pan
5. in a medium bowl , mix flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. set aside
7. in a large bowl , beat sugar , eggs , butter and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed for about 3 minutes
8. beat in sour cream and flour mixture alternately on low speed
9. spread half of the batter in greased pan
10. sprinkle the filling and top with the remaining batter
11. bake for about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
12. cool before remove from the pan
target.review: Not very good, dry and the taste was just blah.  No one would eat it although I did have a piece with coffee but threw the rest away.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marzipan bars

dense chewy texture, good holiday bar.

1. butter a 13x9 inch metal cake pan , line with parchment paper
2. set aside
3. in a small saucepan , bring rum to boil , stir in cranberries
4. let cool
5. meanwhile , in bowl , beat butter with sugar until fluffy
6. beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition , beat in vanilla and almond extract
7. in separate bowl , whisk flour ground almonds , baking powder and salt , stir into butter mixture just until combined
8. stir in sliced almonds , cranberry mixture and marzipan
9. scrape into prepared pan
10. bake in centre of 350 oven until golden and cake tester inserted in centre comes out clean , 45 minutes
11. let cool completely in pan on rack
12. dust with icing sugar
13. cut into bars
14. make ahead- layer between waxed paper in airtight container , store for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 1 month
demonstrations.review: My daughter made these a couple of years ago and they were so darn good now I make them, too.  I use brandy and they are delicious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
raspberry almond coffee cake

this is a recipe from my mom and i've had to be a detective to figure out where she got it from.  i think this one is from cooking light because it seems to be somewhat 'lightened'.  the original recipe called for 2 t. of margarine but we don't use margarine in my house so i've replaced it with butter.  use the margarine if you wish (margarine has trans fats but i won't do the lecture).

1. preheat oven to 350
2. combine raspberries and brown sugar in a bowl , set aside
3. combine flour and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl
4. combine yogurt , butter , 1 teaspoons vanilla and egg in a small bowl
5. stir well
6. add to flour mixture , stirring just until moist
7. spoon two-thirds of batter into an 8-inch round cake pan coated with cooking spray
8. spread evenly
9. top with raspberry mixture
10. spoon remaining batter over raspberry mixture
11. top with almonds
12. bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
13. let cool 10 minutes on a wire rack
14. combine powdered sugar , milk , and 1 / 4 tsp vanilla
15. stir well
16. drizzle over cake
17. serve warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: I thought this would be great because of the good reviews but it was way too sweet and I didn't even use the glaze.  Might try this again but use less sugar and maybe double the dough recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta with mushroom garlic sauce

this recipe is for garlic lovers.it is a quick easy meal when you are rushed and want some comfort food

1. in a skillet melt 2 tbsp butter
2. add garlic , allow to brown , then add mushrooms , basil , salt& pepper
3. cook until the mushrooms are just tender
4. add remaining butter and olive oil
5. stir and remove from heat
6. when pasta is cooked reheat the sauce add parsley
7. mix with pasta and enjoy
demonstrations.review: It was very bland even though I added more basil at others suggestion.  Didn't use all the butter that was called for but it was too greasy.  It was eatable after adding a lot more seasonings at the table but everyone said they wouldn't want it again

target.recipe_text:
kim s italian meatballs

i had never written my recipe down before, so i estimated the measurements. these meatballs taste very similar to my aunt frances! unfortunately we never got her "exact" recipe, as she didn't follow written recipes.  she was an awesome cook and i always thought her spaghetti and meatballs were the best!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. soak 2 slices of bread in 1 / 4 cup milk for 10 minutes
3. don't squeeze out the milk , as adding the milk and bread to the meat mixture will make the meatballs very tender
4. add all other ingredients to the wet bread and milk and mix well with hands
5. roll meat into balls and place on a cookie sheet
6. bake in preheated oven for about 35-40 minutes or until meat is done
7. add to spaghetti sauce and let simmer in sauce for at leat 30 minutes before serving
target.review: These are great meatballs!  I was craving meatball subs and didn't want to buy those fatty ones in the grocery freezer.  I used ground turkey for the beef and Italian sausage for the pork and they turned out wonderful. They make great meatball subs!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian chicken  or shrimp  w tomato cream sauce

this dish is great and easy for an everyday family dinner and great, easy and fancy enough for company. you can mix and match with chicken or seafood or both combined. serve with a salad and your choice of warm bread. i've gotton many compliments on this one! if you want some leftovers, double this recipe for dinner serving of 4.

1. cook pasta
2. cook chicken , onion& garlic in hot oil until no longer pink
3. drain and return to pan
4. stir in undrained tomatoes , sauce& seasonings
5. bring to a boil , simmer uncovered until thickened slowly add cream and stir constantly
6. serve over pasta
7. you can garnish with black pepper and green onions
8. to help thicken sauce , dredge chicken or seafood in flour prior to cooking it
demonstrations.review: I made it with chicken and served it over angel hair pasta.  It was very quick and easy to make.  It really needs some salt.  Next time I'm going to see what adding white cooking wine will do for it.  My husband and I decided that it needs a little tweeking.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
decadent triple layer mud pie

it's really amazing what those cool whip people can come up with!

1. mix chocolate and sweetened condensed milk until well blended
2. pour into crust
3. sprinkle with pecans
4. press pecans lightly into chocolate mixture
5. refrigerate 10 minutes
6. pour milk into large bowl
7. add pudding mixes
8. beat with wire whisk 1 minute
9. spoon 1-1 / 2 cups of the pudding over chocolate in crust
10. gently stir 1 / 2 of the whipped topping into remaining pudding
11. spread over pudding in crust
12. top with remaining whipped topping
13. refrigerate 3 hours
14. store leftover pie in refrigerator
demonstrations.review: YUM! A must try for choclate lovers.  This pie was fast and easy to make.  Not too rich (I thought it sounded like it would be).  Be sure to toast the pecans if you are going to have any left over.  I didn't toasted them and they got soft over night.  I look forward to serving this to my next dinner guests.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken wellington  puff pastry wrapped chicken

this is not at all hard to put together, it's an amazing dish to serve to dinner guests and i have done so many times over the years and have always receive rave reviews from everyone at my table and you will too! --- to save time saute the onion, garlic and mushrooms up to a day ahead,  the cream cheese and dijon mustard mixture may be increased slightly -- i always serve this with recipe#149547 drizzled over or on the side of the plate, you will *love* this!

1. season the chicken breast with seasoning salt and pepper on all sides
2. heat butter and oil in a skillet
3. brown the breasts on all sides until almost completely cooked through
4. transfer to a plate
5. to the same skillet add in onions , garlic and sliced mushrooms
6. saute until the mushrooms lose their moisture and the onions are tender
7. stir in parsley
8. on a floured surface , roll out each puff pastry sheet to a 14-inch square
9. cut into four even 7-inch squares
10. place each breast over each puff pastry square
11. set oven to 375 degrees
12. in a small bowl combine the softened cream cheese with mustard , then spread over each breast
13. then top with about 2-3 tablespoons mushroom / onion mixture
14. brush the edges of each pastry square with water
15. wrap pastry around the chicken breast , pressing edges to seal tightly
16. place seam-side down on greased baking sheets
17. brush the tops with egg wash
18. bake for about 20 minutes , or until puffed and golden brown
19. serve with mushroom sauce over the wellington or on the side of the plate
20. delicious !
demonstrations.review: Cook to impress!  This was delicious with a presentation to wow whomever you serve it to.  I don't know what made this recipe so wonderfull the ease or the taste.  I'm so glad I was looking for a recipe to use some left over pasrty sheets and found this gem.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s broccoli chicken divan casserole

i strongly recommend not to omit the wine and lemon juice as it really brings out the flavor, the complete casserole may be assembled and refrigerated until ready to bake -- reduce the fat by using low fat sour cream and mayonnaise (do not use fat free, i suggest not to add in any extra salt

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. using paper towels pat dry the steamed broccoli florets to remove as much moisture as possible
4. in a large bowl combine both condensed soups with the next 7 ingredients until smooth and well combined
5. mix in the chopped chicken , broccoli florets , cheddar cheese , celery and chopped onion
6. transfer to prepared baking dish , then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. in a small bowl combine the crushed crackers with melted butter , then sprinkle over the top
8. bake uncovered in a preheated oven for 35-40 minutes or until hot and bubbly
target.review: We loved this - So very good!  Be careful you don't overcook the broccoli which I have done many times on other recipes.  This was perfect and goes into my favorites.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brown rice and mushrooms

this is a very simple, healthy recipe to use as a side dish.  much softer, more flavorful, and tastier than traditional rice.  the rice vinegar gives it a nice flavor

1. combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. mix well
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and cover
5. simmer for 45-50 minutes or until rice is tender
6. stir , remove from heat , covered and allow to stand for 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: This has gone into my favorites.  So flavorful and easy to make. Also tried it with beef broth & added 2 tsp of minced garlic.  Very good!! (It needed a lot more water. I have to use 2 and 3/4 cups of water in the rice cooker-I'm at 5,000 ft)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
snow peas with fresh mushrooms

nan

1. heat oil in preheated wok
2. stir fry snow peas 1 minutes
3. add mushrooms and stir fry another minute
4. combine stock , sugar , five spice powder and soy sauce
5. pour into mushroom pea mixture
6. stir fry for 2 more minutes
demonstrations.review: Very good & simple to make.  Didn't know about the 5 spice seasoning - added minced garlic instead.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shelly s cauliflower and sausage bake

i have not tried this recipe. i got this recipe from the world according to eggface.

1. brown sausage
2. drain any liquid , set aside
3. parboil the cauliflower , dredge it in beaten egg and lightly toss in italian style dried bread crumbs and pan fry in a tiny bit of oil
4. turn till golden on all sides
5. you can skip this and just parboil the cauliflower if you are concerned about added fat / carbs
6. mix the browned sausage and seasonings into the sauce and spoon 1 / 2 into a pyrex casserole dish
7. place cauliflower over sauce in an even layer
8. pour remaining sauce over top
9. cover with grated parmesan and mozzarella slices
10. sprinkle with a dash more italian seasoning
11. bake at 350 for 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is very good!   I added it to my favorites.

target.recipe_text:
lisa s swirled chocolate chip cookies

this is a chocolate chip cookie recipe that my friend delynn's best friend gave to us. this is the recipe i use for normal chocolate chip cookies, but i've recently been making them with nestlé's new white & milk chocolate swirled chips. this is a yummy soft and delicious cookie!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. mix butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar , vanilla and eggs in a large bowl
3. stir in the flour , baking soda and salt
4. stir in 2 cups of swirled chocolate chips
5. drop dough by rounded measuring tablespoons , about 2-inches apart , onto ungreased cookie sheet
6. place the several of the reserved swirled chocolate chips on top of each cookie
7. bake 9 to 12 minutes or until light brown
8. cool slightly
9. remove from cookie sheet
10. cool on wire rack
target.review: FABULOUS!!!!  I love chocolate chip cookies and have been searching for the perfect recipe for years.  I found it! Soft, chewy, plenty of chocolate chips.  Thank you!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
finger lickin good bbq sauce

this is sooo delicious makes me lick my fingers!

1. put olive oil in a sauce pan on medium heat and cook onion and garlic until they are soft
2. then add the white vinegar , ketchup , brown sugar , worcestershire sauce , chili powder , and cayenne pepper
3. let this simmer for 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Absolutely amazing! Quick, easy, and very delicious. Used to make barbecued beef and now using for barbecued chicken!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red wine crock pot roast

yes, another roast recipe, but so very good!!! try it!

1. place roast in crock pot and season with pepper
2. mix rest of ingredients together and pour over roast
3. cover and cook on low 6-7 hours
4. remove roast to rest on platter
5. turn crock pot to high
6. whisk cornstarch into juices to thicken
7. this makes a wonderfully tasty au jus , or over mashed potatoes
8. enjoy !
9. you can easily make additions to this: garlic , pearl onions , mushrooms etc
demonstrations.review: Excellent!!  I do not care for steak or roast, but finally a way that I enjoy it and can actually eat it in front of the kids without making funny faces!!  Everyone enjoyed it.  I did not have any rosemary so I left that out.  The first time I made this I just used the red wine and it was very good.  This time I only had 1 cup of red wine left so I also added 1 cup of marsala also and it was EXCELLENT!!!  Thank you for a great dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
failproof french bread  bread machine

this makes two loaves of long baguette type french bread that has wonderful flavor and is so easy to make!

1. place ingredients in bread machine according to manufacturers directions
2. start machine on dough setting
3. when dough cycle is complete , remove dough with floured hands and cut in half on floured surface
4. take each half of dough and roll to make a loaf about 12 inches long in the shape of french bread
5. place on greased baking sheet and cover with a towel
6. let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
7. preheat oven to 450
8. bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown , turning pan around once halfway during baking
9. remove baked loaves to wire racks to cool
demonstrations.review: Fabulous!!  This is simple, but by far the best French Bread I have ever made. After the dough was done in the bread machine I divided it into two long loaves, cut slits in the top, let it double in size, brush with egg whites, bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, and it was PERFECT!!  Will make again tomorrow!!

target.recipe_text:
doctored up vanilla pudding casserole

this pudding is so good, it has a very good texture and the taste is to die for.

1. line the bottom of a 13 by 9 by 2-inch dish with 1 bag of cookies and layer bananas on top
2. in a bowl , combine the milk and pudding mix and blend well using a hand held electric mixer
3. using another bowl , combine the cream cheese and condensed milk together and mix until smooth
4. fold the whipped topping into the cream cheese mixture
5. add the cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture and stir until well blended
6. pour the mixture over the cookies and bananas and cover with the remaining cookies
7. refrigerate until ready to serve
target.review: Woo Hoo! This was a great dessert. I halved the recipe, as we are a small family and it still turned out great. It was easy to make and two days later it still tastes good. Thank you for the great recipe Tams67. UPDATE:  Tams67, someone at work offered to PAY me to make this.  It's that good!  Sue

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic taco casserole

i originally found this taco casserole recipe in a taste of home magazine.  since then, i have made this recipe at least 50 times.  i love it because the ingredients list isn't complicated and, based on the layers, i can readily remember all ingredients when i am at the store without my recipe card.  i have served this for myself and had wonderful leftovers or many times i have made it for company with a nice green salad to accompany it.  i hope you enjoy it as much as i do.

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add taco seasoning and cook according to package directions , adding proper amount of water
3. put corn chips on bottom of 8x8" dish
4. cook refried beans on stove until hot
5. add 1 cup cheese and 1 cup salsa
6. stir until combined
7. pour beans over corn chips in dish
8. add beef to top of beans
9. sprinkle remaining cheese over top
10. sprinkle green onions and black olives over cheese
11. bake in a 375 degree oven until the cheese is sufficiently melted
12. take out of oven and sprinkle chopped tomatoes on top
13. wait 1-2 minutes and then serve
demonstrations.review: This was terrific!  My DH ate half.  Unfortunately my picky grandson said it was "too spicy."  He is only 6, and he doesn't like tex mex food yet.  I used a taco seasoning recipe from zaar, #25449 and omitted the black olives (personal preferance).  It went together in about 20 minutes, I ended up baking it about 30 minutes.  Will make this again.  Thanks for a great recipe, leilani.  Sue

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chili tater tot casserole

i looked at tater tot casseroles on recipezaar to see if there was one like this, and i didn't find a recipe. a friend of mine told me how she makes the casserole and the other recipe's are similar to hers. but what do you do when you want potatoes and chili? use what brands you like, this is what i picked up in the grocery. big casserole for a big crowd or left overs.

1. in a 10 inch cast iron skillet , brown the ground beef and ground turkey together
2. season as you like
3. i used a 13 x 9 oval pyrex casserole dish
4. put the meats in the casserole dish
5. pour the can of chili over the meats and blend together , pat down into the dish
6. sprinkle the grated cheese liberally over the meat-chili mix , create a nice layer of cheese
7. pour the tater tots out of the bag onto the top off the cheese and even them out so they heat evenly , sprinkle a little seasoning over the top if you like
8. bake at 350 degrees for about 35 to 40 minute , until tater tot are heated and cheese is melted
9. scoop onto platters and serve
demonstrations.review: I absolutely loved this recipe.  It was easy peasy!  Since there are only 3 of us, I halved the recipe (and still had a serving leftover)!  I used 1 pound of ground beef, a 20 ounce can of chili (with  beans) and tater tots that covered the top.  Since we like our tots really crispy, I baked for 1 full hour.  It was great!  I am reheating the leftovers for my dinner tonight!  Thanks for posting the great recipe.  Best Dishes, Sue

demonstrations.recipe_text:
erna s apple pie muffins

when our first daughter was born, a friend brought us a pail of these delicious muffins. it was such a thoughful gesture and perfect to snack on during that first couple days at home. whenever i make these now i can still 

1. topping-mix all together , until mixture forms crumbs
2. batter- whisk together egg , buttermilk , butter , and vanilla
3. stir in sugar
4. without mixing , add flour , baking soda , salt and apples
5. stir just until combined
6. do not over mix
7. spoon into muffin cups
8. sprinkle with the topping
9. bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until firm to the touch
demonstrations.review: There were excellent!  I doubled the recipe and got 36 muffins (i put 1/4 cup of batter into each tin).  The 20 minute baking time was perfect for my oven.  I took them to a breakfast meeting at work and everyone loved them.  Thanks, Pam, for posting a great recipe.  Sue

target.recipe_text:
best ever banana cake with cream cheese frosting

this is one of (if not) the best banana cake i have ever tasted! i thought the oven temp of 275° sounded a little low, but this cake baked up (and rose) beautifully in my oven at this temp after pretty much exactly one hour. i do not know if the little "freezer trick" to this recipe is what ensured its moistness or not, but i did it, and it was exceptionally moist & delicious. would be interesting to see if it still came out as great if this step was skipped. all i know is that i followed this recipe exactly as stated (except that i had no buttermilk, so i subbed with a mix of lemon juice & milk) and i got exceptional results. so moist and yummy...a dense cake, similar in texture to a carrot cake... i personally would not call this frosted banana bread :o)  depending on the amount of frosting you like you can decide whether to half the recipe or not. i used the full recipe and had some leftover. i sprinkled on the chopped walnuts and threw this baby in the fridge and cut it the next day...to die for! i really liked it slightly chilled, but great at room temp too! it got better each day it sat, i always make this cake at least the day before i need or want it.  i was extremely pleased with this cake and will be making it over & over again!! so glad i came across this one!! (on another website).


(* * just to update the recipe, (based on some of the reviews), the baking time may vary based on individual ovens. it was right on for my oven, but some others have stated it has taken 1 hour 10 minutes, 1 hour 20 minutes, and my sister just informed me that it took 1 hour 30 minutes in her oven!!!!!)

1. preheat oven to 275f
2. grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan
3. in a small bowl , mix mashed banana with the lemon juice
4. set aside
5. in a medium bowl , mix flour , baking soda and salt
6. set aside
7. in a large bowl , cream 3 / 4 cup butter and 2 1 / 8 cups sugar until light and fluffy
8. beat in eggs , one at a time , then stir in 2 tsp vanilla
9. beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk
10. stir in banana mixture
11. pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for one hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. remove from oven and place directly into the freezer for 45 minutes
13. this will make the cake very moist
14. for the frosting , cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
15. beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. add icing sugar and beat on low speed until combined , then on high speed until frosting is smooth
17. spread on cooled cake
18. sprinkle chopped walnuts over top of the frosting , if desired
target.review: Very, very good....I baked mine on 300 degrees for one hour and it was perfect..I did not have time to freeze it, but I cannot imagine a cake more moist than this one....I made the cream cheese frosting but only added 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar to a block of cream cheese plus 2 TBL butter....Thanks for posting the recipe! It is a keeper and I will make again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy bisquick chicken pot pie

this is so good and easy to make.  the recipe came from the back of the bisquick mix package.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. bottom crust:
3. cut 2 tablespoons butter into 1 cup bisquick baking mix until mixture resembles fine crumbs
4. stir in 2 tablespoons milk until mixture begins to form a ball and cleans side of bowl
5. pat dough on bottom and up to rim of an ungreased pie plate
6. bake for 5 minutes
7. heat remaining butter in 2 quart saucepan until melted
8. stir in 1 / 4 cup bisquick baking mix , onion and pepper
9. cook , stirring constantly until mixture is bubbly , remove from heat
10. stir in chicken broth
11. add vegetables
12. heat to boiling , stirring constantly
13. boil and stir 1 minute
14. stir in chicken
15. heat through
16. pour chicken mixture into bottom crust
17. mix remaining ingredients until smooth
18. pour evenly over chicken mixture , spread gently to edge
19. bake 25 minutes or until golden brown
20. let stand 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: Excellent dish and so easy to make......thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Delicious and so easy!!  I sprinkled a pack of taco seasoning over the chicken before cooking for added flavor....I served with yellow rice and taco chips....delicious.....this is one of my favorite recipes....Thank you for sharing!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tomatoes and macaroni

my grandmother used to can the tomatoes that my grandfather grew.  this was my lunch time favorite when i would spend the summers with her in alabama.  i am sure you could use fresh tomatoes, but remember to keep the juice.

1. begin boiling the macaroni noodles
2. in another saucepan , add onion and butter or margarine
3. cook on medium high heat until the onions are soft
4. add the tomatoes , garlic , salt , pepper , parsley , and basil to the onions
5. reduce heat to medium
6. cook the macaroni noodles until they are 2 or 3 minutes away from being done
7. drain the water from the noodles
8. add the noodles to the sauce and continue cooking on medium heat until the noodles are done
9. enjoy
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe..Growing up (in Alabama)my Mom cooked this and usually made a pan of corn bread and dryed butter beans to go along with it...Yum!!!

target.recipe_text:
quick honey mustard pork stir fry

a really easy pork stir fry that goes well with either rice & stir fried veggies or with potatoes & salad.
*note: i sometimes add 1 tsp minced garlic and/or 1 tsp minced ginger to the marinade to kick it up a notch!!

1. slice pork thinly
2. mix together the honey & mustard
3. marinate the pork in honey mustard mixture for at least 15-20 minutes
4. heat oil in nonstick wok or pan
5. add meat & stirfry with high heat until cooked , stirring & tossing all the time
6. serve with stir fried veggies & rice or potatoes & salad
target.review: My review echos Wildcook's: this recipe is tasty and easy to prepare.  I marinated the meat for more than an hour and also doubled the honey & mustard mix for extra sauce.  I added minced red chillies on top for some zing.  I bought mixed Asian vegetables for the side dish.  Delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ham and egg pies

great for breakfast, picnics or just a snack.

1. preheat oven to 180c
2. lightly oil a 12 hole muffin pan
3. line moulds with a slice of ham so the ends stick out over the top
4. break an egg into each hollow , top with tomato and scatter with chives , parmesan , salt and pepper
5. bake for 18 minutes or until egg is set
6. remove from oven and leave to cool for 5 minutes
7. run a knife around each mould to loosen ham
8. cool on rack
demonstrations.review: From the sheer number of reviews of this recipe and number of stars it gets, I think it's pretty obvious that Ham and Egg Pies delivers the goods.  I love this recipe because its easy, quick and makes a great presentation.  I had thin sliced deli ham and eggs that I wanted to use up and by surprise came across this recipe.
