these are a hit at my house for even those that aren't fans of baked beans.  i think it's the bacon that adds the x-tra somethin somethin.  or maybe the french fried onions.  this can also be done in the oven and so reduce the baking time to 1 1/2 hrs.

1. fry bacon until it's almost done
2. mix all ingredients together using only 3 / 4 of the can of french fried onions
3. cut up the bacon into bite size pieces
4. add bacon
5. place crock pot on low for 6 hours
6. 1 / 2 hours before it's done place remaining onions on top
demonstrations.review: These are now our family baked beans! We made these for Fathers Day Cook Out. These are the best beans I have ever ate. These are 5***** plus 5 more stars! I baked my bacon in the oven and this was quick and easy. My mom who is 73 years old could not believe how good this recipe is! Thanks for Posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheesy hash browns and kielbasa soup  crock pot

when my mom first gave me this recipe, i was pretty skeptical - but it became an instant favorite in our house!! i like it because it is fast and simple to make, inexpensive, and reheats very well. i'll post the ingredients for the original version and offer the healthier alternatives at the end of the recipe.

1. in crock pot , combine hash browns , kielbasa , broth and onions
2. stir well and cook on low 6-8 hours
3. 30 minutes before serving , cut cheese into cubes and stir into soup
4. cover and cook on high 30 minutes or until cheese is melted
5. we like this soup pretty thick , but if you prefer a thinner soup now is a good time to add some extra broth or milk
6. wait until after the cheese has melted to add extra liquid so you can be sure of the consistency
7. serve hot with crusty bread !
8. to make this recipe a lot healthier , use turkey kielbasa , fat free / low sodium chicken broth , and light velveeta
9. i routinely use these substitutions and the soup still turns out fantastic ! if i have the time , i do like to remove the casings from the turkey kielbasa as i think they tend to get a little chewy when cooked all day
10. just split them carefully with a knife and peel away the casings before chopping
11. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I crocked this while at work. Wonderful flavor with the Kielbasa. Easy preparation. I added more chickenbroth for our taste. Very addictive! Could not have just 1 bowl. Yum Yum!! This is a keeper and I will be taking this to work for a pitch in where I know it will be well received. Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mini shrimp cocktail appetizers

from kraftfoods(dot)com website.  i made these for a party and i've had so many people request the recipe.  kraft calls for using finely chopped onions but i skipped that just to make it an even faster appetizer to get on the table.

1. spread each cracker with 1 tsp of the cream cheese spread
2. top evenly with the cocktail sauce and one shrimp
3. sprinkle some of the finely chopped onions on top
demonstrations.review: Great Presentation and Great Taste. I made these for  a St. Francis University,  Fort Wayne, Indiana) tail gate party. I used the Ritz Club Crackers. Making these again for office pitch in. Thank you for posting this recipe. I used the cream cheese with chives. This is a Keeper. Happy Holidays!

target.recipe_text:
holy crap these are amazing cookies

i did not make up this name.  this came from a website called divine caroline.
she says if you make these people will be worshipping your feet.

1. preparation:
2. combine sugar and corn syrup in a medium saucepan
3. place over medium-high heat and stir until the mixture comes to a full boil
4. remove from heat and stir in the whole jar of peanut butter
5. mix well
6. add corn flakes to a large bowl
7. pour peanut butter mixture over corn flakes and mix well , taking care to coat all of the corn flakes
8. with a tablespoon or cookie scoop , scoop out and form into 12 inch balls , depending on your preference , and place them on a cookie sheet lined with parchment or wax paper
9. put the chocolate in a small bowl and melt in the microwave for about thirty seconds
10. stir until smooth
11. drizzle the melted chocolate over the cookies
target.review: Yep these are amazing. Teen-agers loved them - ok not a tough crowd, but they told me they were awesome and usually they just eat and eat without comment. I used Frosted Flakes because that's what I had. I knew we had no corn flakes but thought we had Honey Bunches of Oats which would probably be good too. 18 oz of peanut butter is about 2 cups if you buy it in bulk like I do. I used 1/2 cup Nestle chocolate chips with a little vegetable oil so it would drizzle. Dipping in candy melts would be good too.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
carrot cake oatmeal

this was served for breakfast on our last trip to chicago.

1. combine the rolled oats , milk , water , and carrot in a saucepan
2. turn heat to medium and stir occasionally until mixture comes almost to a boil and most of the liquid is absorbed , which takes about 5-7 minutes
3. when oats are done , stir in vanilla and splenda brown sugar blend
4. while oats are cooking make topping by blending 2 tbsp of non-fat plain yogurt with 1 tsp maple syrup
5. pour oats into a bowl and top with yogurt topping , walnuts , and coconut or raisins
demonstrations.review: This was yummy! I made with carrots, raisins, coconut, and walnuts. I think a little crushed pineapple would have been really good too. I prepared by soaking in hot water (put everything in a covered container, add 'enough' boiling water, cover and let sit until you get around to it) and couldn't top with yogurt since that didn't fit into my eating at work plans. I bet the yogurt is super good too. Made for 2013 Spring Safari PAC.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chai coffee mix

add a spicy twist to your coffee.

1. mix sugar , cocoa powder , cinnamon , salt , ginger , pepper , cloves , and cardamom together in an airtight container
2. seal and shake
3. to serve: put 2 tablespoons mix into a mug
4. fill mug halfway with fresh brewed coffee , stir , and add milk or creamer
demonstrations.review: I love chocolate and I love chai tea. Perfect combination. I scaled this back to 1/4 recipe and left the sugar out of the mix. Used about 1/2 tsp of mix, and a keurig for the coffee, then added sugar to taste.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick   easy bean burrito casserole

i got these from razzle dazzle recipes and they are delicious and fairly low fat. i modified a few ingredients to suit our tastes and you can serve them with whatever garnish you like.

1. to make the filling:
2. in a large heavy skillet cook the onion and the garlic in the oil over moderately low heat , stirring , until the onion is softened , add the beans , and mash about half of them coarse with a potato masher
3. add the tomato sauce , the cumin , the chilies , chili powder , and salt and black pepper to taste , simmer the mixture , stirring , for 5-7 minutes , or until it is slightly thickened
4. working with 1 warmed tortilla at a time spread about 3 tablespoons of the filling down the center of each tortilla
5. working from the sides fold in the ends and then roll the tortillas enclosing the filling
6. arrange the burritos , seam sides down , in one layer in a baking dish , sprinkle them with the monterey jack , and bake them , covered with foil , in the middle of a preheated 350f oven for 10-12 minutes
7. sprinkle with green onions and serve with sour cream and salsa
demonstrations.review: These were really good. I used 1 can low fat refried beans and 1 can kidney beans. I didn't have any tomato sauce so used 1 cup salsa. Cut the cumin down to 1/2 tsp for wimpy DH. Used taco cheese, the kind with spices, on top and served with green onions, diced fresh tomatoes and sour cream. And rooster sauce for those of us who aren't wimpy. DH thought they should have had taco meat instead of the whole beans but I made this recipe because it was meatless (and so was I).

target.recipe_text:
easy cabbage and noodles

i came up with this one because it's fast---no chopping cabbage.  and it's colorful because of the carrots in the cole slaw mix.  cook time is for noodle boiling.

1. cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. drain
3. in a large skillet , melt butter and saute cole slaw mix , onion and garlic until tender
4. mix in salt and pepper
5. gently stir in cooked and drained noodles
6. toss together
target.review: This took all of...... 10 minutes to cook!  Gotta love it for a healthy quick mid-week meal.  One for the working mums!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
moroccan spiced pork chops and fruity couscous

when i first found this recipe on the weight watchers website, i was amused by the idea of a moroccan dish featuring pork as most of the natives i know from this country are muslim.  though i will never serve this dish to them, i love the flavors of the marinade and have made some changes that make this truly delicious.

1. combine harissa , cumin , coriander and 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon in a resealable plastic bag
2. add chops to bag , seal and shake until well-coated
3. marinate the meat for 30 minutes in the fridge
4. heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. cook chops until cooked through , about eight minutes per side
6. bring broth to boil in a medium saucepan
7. add 1 / 4 teaspoon of cinnamon , turmeric and couscous
8. turn heat down to lowest possible setting , cover and simmer for 5-7 minutes
9. fluff couscous and mix in the apricots and cilantro
10. serve chops on top of the couscous
11. cooking time includes the time to marinade the meat
demonstrations.review: I'm a big fan of cous cous so this one was easy.  The spices really complimented the pork chops and the cous cous was not dry.  Very delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
down under salmon with citrus saffron sauce over greens

according to the black swan winery, in australian cuisine, seafood is a constant. here, the saffron adds a bit of drama to this delicately sweet salmon, while the crunch of chopped nuts contrasts marvelously with the soft-cooked greens.

1. for the salmon:
2. preheat the oven to 375f
3. saut spring onions , garlic and ginger in olive oil on medium-high heat until soft
4. add saffron and fruit juices , then cook for 2 minutes on medium heat
5. add sugar and stir until the crystals dissolve
6. place the salmon fillets in a shallow baking dish , skin side down
7. pour the fruit juice mixture over the salmon
8. sprinkle the australian mountain pepper on top , with a pinch of salt
9. bake for 12 minutes
10. for the greens:
11. saut the garlic for one minute on high heat
12. add the greens by handfuls
13. saut the greens for 8 minutes or until tender
14. serve the salmon on a plate next to the cooked greens , and garnish the greens with chopped bunya or macadamia nuts
demonstrations.review: Very easy to cook with fresh ingredients.... the juice was quite rich but after a few mouthfuls I was used to it and thoroughly enjoyed it!  Great idea to put the crushed macadamia nuts on the greens.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jivin  california turkey roller

"a juicy turkey burger with a hint of red bell peppers, garlic and onions, topped with with fresh spinach, ripe red tomatoes and alfalfa sprouts and drizzled with a special avocado-artichoke dressing. served on two slices of toasted sourdough bread, it's a burger any californian could groove on. and that ain't no jive!"  (submitted for the zwt3 "build-a-burger" challenge by the jivin' jelly rollers.)

1. make dressing: combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor and process until smooth , but not too smooth
2. make burgers: combine all ingredients and form 4-8 patties
3. grill patties on outdoor grill , or pan-fry them if you don't have a grill
4. serve on toasted sourdough bread with liberal helpings of avocado / artichoke dressing
5. serve with baby spinach , sliced red onion and / or tomato , and alfalfa sprouts
demonstrations.review: This was very easy to make and delicious!  The dressing complimented the burgers perfectly.  I even think that I will make the dressing on its own as a dip.  Well done Jivin' Jelly Rollers!

target.recipe_text:
beet salad with goat cheese and walnuts

combine the strong flavors of beets and goat cheese for a delicious and different salad. boost the rich flavor of the nuts by toasting them in the oven until golden.

1. drain and cut up beets
2. in a medium bowl , combine cut-up beets , basil , and pepper
3. drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the salad dressing
4. toss to coat
5. arrange greens on 2 salad plates
6. sprinkle with remaining dressing
7. top with beet mixture , walnuts , and goat cheese
target.review: Loved the idea of this salad and with a few minor changes, due to available supplies, it was awesome! Thank you for the new dish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
michele s  asparagus  bacon  or salmon  crustless quiche

this is the best and creamiest crust-less quiche i've ever eaten and i eat a lot of quiche! i asked my friend, michele, to share her recipe with zaar and she was kind enough to oblige.  thanks, girlfriend!  top this yummy quiche with tinned asparagus, chopped bacon, or tinned salmon.  it makes it's own "crust" as it cooks.  very nice with a green salad on the side.

1. preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. beat eggs and milk
3. add melted butter and flour
4. beat to combine
5. add cheese and onion , stir
6. pour into greased pie dish
7. arrange asparagus spears , salmon , or bacon on top
8. bake in center of oven for 45 minutes
9. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I can't believe I haven't already reviewed this recipe! I have used it so many times. Don't even look at other quiche recipes. As is, or doctored up with whatever is on hand this recipe is a WINNER! Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bisquick cinnamon buns

the easiest way to make cinnamon buns when you want something sweet in a hurry. as a college student it's a quick way to make something that tastes like home, my boyfriend loves them. i got this recipe from cdkitchen.

1. for rolls: heat oven to 375f grease bottom and sides of rectangular pan , 13x9x2 inches
2. stir together 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon
3. reserve
4. stir bisquick , milk and 2 tablespoons sugar until dough forms
5. if dough is too sticky , gradually mix in enough bisquick to make dough easy to handle
6. turn dough onto surface well dusted with bisquick
7. gently roll in bisquick to coat
8. shape into ball
9. knead 10 times
10. roll into rectangle , 15x9 inches
11. spread with butter
12. sprinkle evenly with sugar mixture
13. sprinkle evenly with raisins
14. roll up tightly , beginning at 15-inch side
15. seal well by pinching edge of dough into roll
16. cut into 1 1 / 4-inch slices
17. place cut sides down in pan
18. bake 23 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
19. cool 5 minutes
20. remove from pan
21. spread glaze over warm rolls
22. for glaze: stir together powdered sugar and milk until smooth
demonstrations.review: Excellent!  Satisfied my sweet tooth in record time!  Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
unbelievable apple pie

i've been making this wonderful pie for years. it's so easy and tasty. everyone wonders what's in it. this pie can bake while you eat dinner and then, voila...hot apple pie for dessert. yum!
update: i've been asked if instant pudding mix is ok--yes! when the recipe was published there was no instant; tried the instant in it--works fine! lol

1. in mixing bowl , combine apples and pie / pudding mix
2. toss to coat well
3. place apple mixture in unbaked pie crust
4. in small bowl , mix all topping ingredients until crumbly
5. sprinkle topping over apples
6. bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 35 to 40 minutes until topping is golden brown and pie is bubbly
7. i serve it with a scoop of butter pecan or rum raisin ice cream
demonstrations.review: Super easy and very good. Made with apples, butterscotch (sugar-free) pudding mix. Made with no pie crust! like a very tasty apple crisp. Replaced the white sugar with Splenda but kept the brown sugar for flavor.

target.recipe_text:
cinnamon swirl quick bread

this rich quick bread is a favorite with my family. i often give my husband a few slices to take with him on his commute to work, along with a tall travel mug of coffee.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. in a large mixing bowl , beat together butter , 1 cup sugar , and egg
3. combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. add the flour mixture to the egg mixture alternately with the buttermilk
5. in a small bowl , combine the cinnamon and remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar
6. pour a third of the batter into a greased 8x4x2-inch loaf pan
7. sprinkle a third of the cinnamon sugar on top of batter
8. repeat layers twice
9. bake for 45-50 minutes , until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
10. cool in pan for 10 minutes
11. remove from pan to a wire rack to cool completely
target.review: Absolutely scrumptious and so easy to make!  We used Saigon cinnamon (much stronger cinnamon flavor), 1/2 tsp. vanilla extract, and 1/4 tsp almond extract. Wow!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yummy crunchy apple pie

great pie!

1. use foil on bottom of oven rather than a cookie sheet under pie pan
2. prepare pastry for single-crust pie
3. place in pie plate and trim and crimp the edge
4. refrigerate 30 minute loosely covered with plastic wrap
5. in a large mixing bowl , stir together the sugar , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice , and salt
6. add apple slices and gently toss until they are coated well
7. transfer mixture to pie
8. for crumb topping: stir together brown sugar , flour , and oats
9. using a pastry blender , cut in the butter until topping resembles coarse crumbs
10. sprinkle over apple mixture in pie
11. to prevent over-browning while baking , cover edge of pie with foil
12. bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes
13. remove foil and bake 25 to 30 minutes more , or until top is golden
14. remove from oven
15. cool on wire rack about an hour and serve !
demonstrations.review: Best apple pie in the world!  Make it and you won't be disappointed.  It's like an apple pie and pecan pie combo, yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate brownie cupcakes

from 125 best cupcakes recipes.

1. preheat oven to 325f and use muffin pan lined with paper liners
2. in a small bowl , mix together flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and salt
3. in a large bowl , whisk together granulated and brown sugars and butter until smooth
4. whisk in vanilla and almond extract
5. add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. add flour mixture , beating until combined
7. stir in chocolate chips
8. scoop batter into prepared pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 28 minutes or until a tester inserted into center comes out with a few crumbs attached and a little melted chocolate
10. the tops of cupcakes will not spring back when touched
11. let cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes
12. remove from pan and let cool completely on rack
13. top cooled cupcakes with favorite frosting
demonstrations.review: I made these cupcakes for my fiance's birthday, and we loved them!  Since so little icing is needed, I simply wrote a happy birthday message in icing on top of the cupcakes which was the perfect amount.  If you love almond extra and chocolate, you'll love these cupcakes!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chip apple cookies

delicious moist and flavourful cookies. because the apple is grated, it is not obvious there is apple in these cookies.

1. in a large bowl , cream together margarine and sugar
2. beat in egg
3. in seperate bowl , mix flour , baking soda and cinnamon
4. stir flour mixture into creamed mixture
5. stir in apples , chocolate chips and oats
6. drop mixture by rounded teaspoons onto cookie sheets
7. bake at 350f for 12-15 minutes
8. makes 2 1 / 2 dozen
demonstrations.review: Excellent! These are great to make during apple season when you have a lot of apples to go through. I really enjoyed the cinnamon and chocolate combo.

target.recipe_text:
almost apple pie

while this recipe is good any time it is the first one requested when the fall apples ripen. it was passed to me by a family member. the recipe calls for an 8x8 deep baking pan. family member uses a corning ware casserole dish for the baking which makes for a lovely dessert. i often bake it in a pie plate and when cool slice and serve as you would pie. using white sugar in the crumb crust has it so tasting like pastry. quick and easy to make. note - recently found this recipe from an old family cookbook is called  aunties 'old fashioned crumb cake'  and calls for baking in a 425 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until brown and crisp. just made it and found baked at the higher temperature it very like an apple crisp - an absolutely delicious version of almost apple pie and another great apple dessert to serve family and friends.  ovens vary - i used a slightly lower oven temp.

1. whisk the crumb mixture together and pat half the crumb mix into an 8x8 baking pan
2. slice apples into a large bowl , add the dry ingredients , mix gently and place filling over the crumb base
3. put the remaining crumbs over the apples and pat in place
4. bake in a 350 oven 40 to 50 minutes or till nicely colored , times vary from oven to oven
target.review: This was very good!  I love baking with apples, but for some reason, I haven't had much luck with it in the past, but this was by far my best attempt yet.  Everyone loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crumb topped banana muffins

these are so good. we love the topping.

1. in a large bowl , mix the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
2. mix bananas , sugar , egg and melted butter
3. stir into dry mixture until thoroughly combined , then stop mixing
4. fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. combine brown sugar , flour , and cinnamon topping ingredients
6. cut in cold butter until crumbly
7. sprinkle over muffins
8. bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes , until muffins test done
9. cool in pan for 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: The topping on these was incredible, I only made these about two weeks ago and have since used the topping on at least two other breads I have made.  It was just what I was looking for: a crummy, cinnamonny, sweet topping.  The actual banana muffins, though, were not that special. I thought they were good, my I've made better banana breads in the past.  Thanks for the topping recipe, though!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
poverty meal

when i was a child, my family used to eat this at least once a week due to the fact that it is inexpensive and a little goes a long way. we also added fresh herbs or sometimes whole kernel corn. its even better the next day and it freezes well.

1. saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent
2. brown ground beef and drain
3. add ground beef , tomatoes , water , raw macaroni , salt and pepper to the onion and garlic mixture
4. cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. if desired , top with parmesan cheese
6. serve with crusty bread and a salad
demonstrations.review: This is impossibly delicious for how easy it is! Unbelievable!<br/><br/>I added a little basil, some mushrooms and eggplant. I had leftover veggies I wanted to use up and they turned out wonderfully in this. I also melted in some shredded mozzarella and cheddar cheese toward the end (because everything is better with cheese!). So good. I have a feeling I will be making this very often :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramel chocolate bars

found my old recipe box and this one was in it. can't even remember who the mcp was that gave me the recipe any more, but it sounds wonderful and she says that is is very easy.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. cream brown sugar and margarine
3. add dry ingredients reserving 3 tbsp of flour and stir in the oatmeal
4. press 1 / 2 of the mixture in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13 pan and bake for 10 minutes
5. sprinkle chocolate chips over crust
6. mix caramel topping with the reserved flour
7. drizzle this over the chips
8. sprinkle the top with the remaining crumb mixture
9. bake for an additional 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: These were reeeeeeeeeeeeally good! I used less chocolate than the recipe called for (probably only about 10 oz), which was just enough to cover the pan in a layer of chocolate. I also used more caramel (nearly a whole 12 oz jar), so that it would almost cover the pan. They turned out wonderfully.  The cookie dough is very oatmeal-y, but it's a nice balance for the chocolate and caramel.

target.recipe_text:
just like lambert s  throwed  rolls   copycat

there is a fantastic restaurant in sikeston, mo where they throw the most delicious rolls at you before, during and after your meal. this is a copy cat recipe of those exact rolls. if you get the chance, visit the restaurant. if not, try these rolls anyway. they are so very good!

(the lambert's restaurant is in sikeston, mo.) they have subsequently opened one in ozark, mo and foley, al)

1. combine sugar and yeast in tepid water
2. let stand 5-10 minutes until yeast begins to foam
3. thoroughly mix milk , butter , sugar , egg and salt in large bowl
4. stir in the yeast mixture and 3 1 / 2 cups of flour , adding a bit more if necessary to make a soft , pliable dough
5. turn dough out on floured board and let rest while you clean and butter bowl
6. knead dough gently 4-5 minutes , adding flour if necessary , until dough is smooth and silky
7. return to bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and let rise in warm place until doubled in size
8. butter a 12 cup muffin tin
9. punch down dough
10. pinch off pieces that are about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter , , and roll into smooth spheres
11. place two such pieces in each prepared muffin cup- it will be a tight fit
12. cover dough loosely with plastic wrap for 45 minutes
13. bake rolls in preheated 350 degree oven for 20-25 minutes , or until light brown
14. serve as soon as they are cool enough to throw
target.review: Very nice rolls.  Thanks for the wonderul recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
denison house pancake

very light and tasty. serve with butter and your favorite syrup (heated for best flavor!) another second penny inn bed and breakfast stonington, connecticut

1. in a bowl , combine the dry ingredients
2. in a separate bowl , combine eggs , milk , and vanilla and beat with a hand whisk until color is uniform
3. add flour mixture and whisk until smooth
4. more milk may be necessary to thin the batter , especially if it sits for more than a few minutes
5. heat a nonstick fry pan or griddle over medium heat and drop batter by 1 / 4-cupfuls onto pan
6. turn when bubbles cover the surface and bottom is golden brown
7. remove from pan when golden on both sides
demonstrations.review: I'm a new cooker, these were very tasty.  They were a little thin for my taste, but they were really tasty.  I will make these again.  Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian dressing whole chicken crock pot recipe

it's super easy! the chicken is falling of the bone, juicy and very tender. i save the juices for gravy and stock. i serve with mashed red potatos and corn on the cob. the leftovers are great too! make sure your crockpot (5-7 quart) is large enough to handle a whole chicken

1. remove giblets , raise with cold water and pat the chicken dry
2. rub chicken with italian dressing mix
3. place in plastic freezer bag and place in refrigerater overnight
4. chop onions and carrots , place on the bottom of crockpot with no liquid
5. saving some onion and a couple of carrots
6. put remaining onion and carrots in the cavity of chicken
7. place chicken in crockpot
8. cover
9. cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 4-6 hours
10. if you don't have a crockpot
11. cook at 250f for 4-6 hours in oven
12. make sure to cover with foil if using your oven
13. depending on the size of your chicken and your crockpot the time will vary
14. using a meat thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken
15. when the temperature has reached 165f the chicken is done
demonstrations.review: I made this and this is WONDERFUL!! I Easy and very tasty!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my favorite chocolate chip cookies

get a glass of cold milk ready! this has been my favorite chocolate chip cookie recipe of all time, found in a betty crocker cookbook years ago. once i made it for my hs latin class and it became a class tradition and a family favorite...thank you, betty!

1. cream shortening , butter , and sugars in large mixing bowl
2. blend in eggs and vanilla
3. combine dry ingredients and add to butter mixture
4. mix until well blended
5. stir in chocolate chips
6. drop by rounded teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheets
7. bake at 375 for 7-10 minutes until golden brown
8. i like chewy cookies and if you do too , adjust the baking time accordingly)
demonstrations.review: These cookies were really good, but like StacyMD187373 said, they didn't spread out like other cookies do.  The taste was pretty good.  Thanks for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
target.review: This was just ok.  I thought it would be more "wow" due to the high rating.  The ease of it gets five stars, but I don't think I would make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic taco casserole

i originally found this taco casserole recipe in a taste of home magazine.  since then, i have made this recipe at least 50 times.  i love it because the ingredients list isn't complicated and, based on the layers, i can readily remember all ingredients when i am at the store without my recipe card.  i have served this for myself and had wonderful leftovers or many times i have made it for company with a nice green salad to accompany it.  i hope you enjoy it as much as i do.

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add taco seasoning and cook according to package directions , adding proper amount of water
3. put corn chips on bottom of 8x8" dish
4. cook refried beans on stove until hot
5. add 1 cup cheese and 1 cup salsa
6. stir until combined
7. pour beans over corn chips in dish
8. add beef to top of beans
9. sprinkle remaining cheese over top
10. sprinkle green onions and black olives over cheese
11. bake in a 375 degree oven until the cheese is sufficiently melted
12. take out of oven and sprinkle chopped tomatoes on top
13. wait 1-2 minutes and then serve
demonstrations.review: Love Taste of Home.  Loved this casserole.  My husband says it is his new favorite dinner.  My kids devoured it.  I thought it rocked too.  Will make again very soon.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast casserole

we make this the night before and breakfast for christmas is ready in a snap. served with hash browns, juice and coffee and your not spending all morning in the kitchen.

1. trim crusts from bread , cut into cubes , cover bottom of a 12x7" casserole and sprinkle with cheese
2. beat eggs , add milk and mix well
3. stir salt , pepper and dry mustard into the egg mixture , add bacon and sausage , stirring until well blended
4. pour over cheese , cover with foil and refrigerate overnight
5. in the morning put in a 350f oven and bake for 50-55 minutes
demonstrations.review: I honestly didn't care for this.  I followed the recipe exactly and it was bland.  I am going to try a different recipe next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bavarian pancakes

my grandma's recipe.  these come out plate size and thin.  you put any choice of toppings on and roll up and eat.  this is a german heritage recipe.

1. mix all ingredients
2. don't over beat
3. mix may have some lumps
4. heat skillet and melt butter
5. pour about 1 / 2 cup mix in circle into skillet and fry until bubbly
6. turn over and fry until light brown
7. top with syrup , powdered sugar , apple sauce , nuts , chocolate chips , whipped cream or any such ingredient and roll up
8. eat in a roll
demonstrations.review: This is also a recipe that my Czech grandmother made for her many grandchildren. We called them "egg pancakes" as kids.  My grandfather was a beekeeper and we always had fresh honey and butter on top.  I also added 1tsp vanilla. Made these for my kids this morning. Delicious!

target.recipe_text:
edna s apple crumble  aka  apple crisp

a simple and easy to make but oh so yummy recipe. known as apple crumble in the uk and apple crisp in the us

1. put apples in an 8 or 9 inch square baking dish
2. combine the rest of the ingredients in a separate bowl and mix
3. spread crumble mixture over apples and bake for 35 minutes in a 375f degree oven
4. for an added treat top off with a little english custard
target.review: Doubled everything put it in a 13x9x2....it was very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yummy greek spinach pie  spanakopita

this is my take on my mother's and grandmother's spanakopita. since they never measured anything (and i have also adopted this wacky cooking style) these are my best approximation on measurements. enjoy!

1. saute onion , green onions and garlic , salt and pepper to taste , until soft in 3 or 4 tablespoons of olive oil
2. stir in spinach and parsley , until spinach is limp
3. remove from heat and set aside to cool
4. in a bowl mix together eggs , ricotta , and feta
5. stir in spinach mixture
6. lay 1 sheet of phyllo dough in a 9x9 in baking dish and brush lightly with melted butter
7. lay another sheet of phyllo dough on top , brush with butter , and repeat with four more sheets of phyllo
8. spread spinach and cheese mixture into pan and place another 6 sheets of phyllo in the same process as before
9. place in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 to 40 minutes
10. serve while hot
demonstrations.review: Served this at a party we had and everyone LOVED it!  Thanks so much for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Very yummy and easy! I shredded the chicken after it was all finished cooking and served it over rice.  The leftovers lasted a few days! It was delicious over salad!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lentil salad

this is out of the 2005 edition kcts chefs cookbook. it was sent in by owner and executive chef alison hero from the silverwater cafe in port townsend , washington. cooking time does not include refrigerated time.

1. place lentils and water in a small pot and cover
2. bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
3. drain and rinse with cool water
4. in a large mixing bowl , combine remaining ingredients
5. add lentils when completely cool and mix
6. let sit , refrigerated , for 2 hours or more
demonstrations.review: My whole family LOVED this recipe!  I followed the directions exactly!

target.recipe_text:
hummus  topped with everything i love  appetizer

need a quick and easy appetizer? this is an incredibly tasty dish to serve at your next dinner party, game night or gno.  my fabulous neighbor brought this layered dip to our block party yesterday.... it was gone in the blink of an eye once everyone heard the mmmmmmms! use more or less of any of the toppings. enjoy!

1. on an decorative serving dish w / sides or pie plate spread the hummus
2. drain the giardienera , scatter the mix over the hummus
3. top with the sliced kalamata olives and feta cheese
4. serve with crunchy pita chips or pita bread triangles
target.review: This was fantastic!  Super simple and yummy.  We ate it on pita chips.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panera bread  black bean soup

this is my own version of panera bread's black bean soup. it tastes a lot like it, and i love it! use vegetable stock to make it vegetarian.

1. in a pot , combine the first six ingredients
2. simmer for 10 minutes
3. add half a can of beans , salt and cumin
4. cook for 5 minutes
5. puree soup
6. add the rest of the beans to the soup
7. combine the cornstarch with 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of water
8. add the lemon and the cornstarch to the soup
9. cook until thickened
demonstrations.review: I can't compare it to panera because I've never had it but this was a great soup!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork chops ole

i make this for my family on a regular basis. it has a wonderful flavor and the pork chops are always tender! i found the recipe in a taste of home magazine .

1. in a large skillet , brown pork chops in oil
2. sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper
3. meanwhile , in a greased 13x9x2-inch baking dish , combine rice , water , tomato sauce and taco seasoning
4. mix well
5. arrange chops over rice
6. top with green pepper
7. cover and bake at 350f for 1- hours
8. uncover and sprinkle with cheese
9. return to the oven , until cheese is melted
demonstrations.review: This was a hit at my house.  I made a few small changes:  I chopped and sauted the peppers for a few minutes in oil then added the rice and cooked for few minutes more to toast.  Then I added the water, seasoning, and tomoto sauce, covered and partial cooked the rice.  I did this because it seems when ever I make recipes like this the rice never gets quite done.  It turned out great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot asian chicken thighs

this is a sweet, rich dish that is delicious over rice. it is very popular in my online mother's group ... you can chop and change the veggies if you like.

1. place all ingredients , except green onions and cashews , in a crock pot
2. cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours , or 4 hours on high
3. remove chicken to a serving platter and top with green onions and cashews
demonstrations.review: Delicious!  Great orange ginger flavor and the chicken thighs were very tender.

target.recipe_text:
chocolate  chocolate  chocolate  bundt cake with chocolate glaze

need i say more...chocolate! decadently rich and moist. add a scoop of vanilla ice cream and you're in heaven.

1. cake: preheat oven to 350
2. grease and flour bundt pan , set aside
3. in large mixing bowl , combine cake mix , pudding mix and chocolate chips
4. in another bowl , combine water , eggs , and vanilla mixing well
5. add egg mixture to dry mixture and mix with spoon until just blended
6. pour into prepared pan
7. bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done when wooden pick in center comes out clean
8. cool 15 to 20 minutes before removing cake from pan
9. when completely cool , drizzle cake with chocolate glaze
10. chocolate glaze: combine all ingredients in bowl
11. mix with spoon until smooth
target.review:
Made this to satisfy a chocolate craving and it certainly did the trick.
The only thing is that it is much better the next day so be sure to save some- if you can.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled cornell chicken

this recipe is a variation of one from "bbq usa," and is a great grilled chicken recipe from a fair booth in new york called baker's chicken coop, which became famous in the late 40s. serve it with potato salad and a read leaf lettuce salad with tomatoes, cucumbers and granny's red french dressing (#116968).

1. in a food processor , mix the egg with the oil and other ingredients
2. marinate the chicken in one half of the marinade for 4-6 hours in the refrigerator
3. place a drip pan half full of water in the bottom of half of the grill
4. fire up the grill
5. oil the grate
6. cook the chicken indirectly for 40 to 60 minutes on the side of the grill where the drip pan is , basting and turning the chicken occasionally
7. move the chicken to grill it directly for extra browning
8. the internal temperature of the chicken should be 180 degrees before serving
demonstrations.review: i have been using this recipe for almost 50 years.  it's the only way to bbq chicken as far as my family is concerned and all 3 of my children use it.  i usually marinate the chicken for 2-3 days in a big tupperware container.  the longer it sits the more flavor. i use the original recipe but will try this one some time this summer.  sounds yummy. thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the deen brothers  baked hush puppies

from the food network magazine, november 2009. the deen brothers.

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. lightly grease a 24-cup mini muffin pan or spray with nonstick cooking spray
3. in a medium bowl , combine the cornmeal , flour , baking powder , salt and pepper
4. in a separate bowl , mix together the onion , milk , eggs and butter
5. fold the egg mixture into the flour mixture until the flour mixture is just moistened
6. spoon 1 t of the batter into each of the prepared mini muffin pan cups
7. bake for 10 minutes , or until the hush puppies are firm to the touch and golden brown around the edges
demonstrations.review: I made these after watching the show.  they were very easy and quite good, however, i thought they had too much onion flavor.  will make them again - adding a little honey or sugar and omiting the onion.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
world s best alfredo sauce

i made this after having an obsession with the olive garden's sauce. and all i can say is this is truly better then there. my family and everyone i have made it for is amazing. i am constantly handing this out. serve with chicken or seafood, pasta and veggies and garlic bread...you will not be disappointed!

1. pour cream into a sauce pan
2. add butter , garlic , parmesan cheese and pepper
3. bring to a slight boil for 1 minute
4. turn on minimum and simmer for 1 / 2 hour , stirring occasionally to let the flavors mix
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: this is a terrific recipe. made it last night for dinner-added shrimp and scallops to sauce for the last 5 minutes and chopped veggies to the boiling pasta water for the last 5 min.(sauted the mushrooms).  used broccoli, green beans and carrots for the veggies.  we will have this as often as our diets allow - sure is yummy.

target.recipe_text:
finger lickin  oven barbecue chicken

this recipe makes a very flavorful sauce that is perfect on chicken or used to jazz up plain rice. it is great to fix when you want to grill but the weather just won't cooperate! even people who don't like barbecue love this sauce. i typically like to double it and set some aside for extra dipping

1. pour canola oil into a large frying pan and heat over medium heat
2. add chicken pieces and brown well
3. remove chicken and place in a 9x13-inch baking pan
4. preheat oven to 350f
5. add onion to the frying pan and stir well
6. scraping up and brown bits from the chicken
7. saut about 2 minutes
8. meanwhile , in a mixing bowl combine remaining sauce ingredients and stir to mix well
9. pour sauce mixture into frying pan with onion and stir to combine
10. simmer sauce for 15-20 minutes to allow the flavors to blend
11. pour over chicken , then flip pieces so that both sides of the chicken get coated with sauce
12. bake chicken for 30 minutes or until juices run clear
13. the remainder of the sauce can simmer gently while the chicken bakes
target.review: Tasty! I used the sauce in this recipe for barbecue chicken in the crock pot. Let a couple chicken breasts cook in the sauce on low for about 6 hours and then shredded the meat to put on deli rolls. Turned out great! I added a little bit of liquid smoke to give it more of that bbq flavor. Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven fried zucchini chips

these are so tasty.
points 1.

1. cut zucchini into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
2. set aside
3. combine egg substitute and italian dressing in a small bowl , stir well
4. combine bread crumbs ,
5. parmesan cheese and pepper in a small bowl
6. stir well
7. dip zucchini in egg mixture , dredge in bread crumb mixture
8. place zucchini on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
9. bake at 475 degrees for 5 minutes , turn and bake an additional 5 minutes or until golden
10. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: We love these! I've made them several times and they always turn out great and they're so easy! I only made a couple of changes. I let the sliced zucchini soak in a mixture of one egg, a splash of mile, salt and pepper for about 20 minutes. Then, instead of using the italian dressing I mix italian seasoning, panko, and parmesan cheese for the breading. I place them on a greased baking sheet after breading and spray the tops with a light dusting of the cooking spray, and flip half way through. Thanks for the wonderful, easy, and healthy side dish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheddar corn muffins

i found this recipe in a cookbook called. quick vegetarian pleasures. makes 12 muffins.
"these are light and moist, with a mild but irresistible cheese accent. they are equally good served for breakfast or with chili. if you want a more traditional corn muffin, just leave out the cheese."

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. butter the insides and the top of a regular muffin pan
3. in large bowl thoroughly combine the flour , cornmeal , baking powder , salt and sugar
4. in medium bowl , beat the egg
5. beat in the milk and the melted butter
6. combine with the dry ingredients until just evenly moistened
7. do not overmix
8. stir in 1 cup of cheese
9. immediately spoon the batter into the muffin pan
10. evenly sprinkle the remaining cheese on top of the muffins
11. bake 17 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center of the muffin comes out clean
12. best served warm
demonstrations.review: I made these for Fall PAC 2011. They had good flavor, but mine came out really dry so I'm only giving them four stars. Probably my fault, I'm really not a baker. I did follow the recipe and let them cook for 17 minutes but they came out a little dark. Next time I'll try pulling them out a little sooner. Thanks AustinMama!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yes  virginia there is a great meatloaf

absolutely delicious meatloaf and sauce! those who claim they don't believe there can be such a thing as a great meatloaf will love this. based on a meatloaf given to me by a dear friend, virginia strehl, memphis, and leesburg, fla. nita holleman, 2000

1. meatloaf: combine meat loaf ingredients and place into a loaf baking dish
2. smooth out top
3. sauce: combine sauce ingredients and pour on top and sides of meatloaf
4. bake at 350f about 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes or until done
5. enjoy !
6. the addition of 1 or 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet makes this recipe very good
7. recipe should be"plump" from the addition of the milk or half & half
8. it should not be runny
9. a second batch of sauce served hot is good to serve with the meatloaf
10. nita's
11. it is wise to have some fat added to the deer -- especially to ground deer
12. maybe 25 % fat , , otherwise your results will be poor
13. i don't know about some of the other game meat some are using
14. please consult an expert
15. the recipe is delicious as it stands ! enjoy ! nita holleman
demonstrations.review: Absolutely delicious every time. I used just regular milk because it's what I had on hand. The consistancy wasn't quite right, it was falling apart but the next time I added more bread crumbs and it held together much better. I have even started using the leftovers to make a delicious pasta dish. (Recipe #402701)

target.recipe_text:
cheesecake covered strawberries

what a great twist on strawberry topped cheesecake! i found this to be quite a romantic dessert, so i made it with big, long-stemmed strawberries. as for the 

1. beat the cream cheese until smooth
2. add the sour cream , sugar , milk , and vanilla
3. blend until smooth
4. transfer to a serving bowl
5. place the strawberries and and crumbs in separate serving bowls
6. dip the strawberries in the cheesecake mixture , then coat with the crumbs
7. for romantic or chic plated dessert idea , serve 2 or 3 dipped berries along side a slim piece of flourless chocolate cake and glasses of champagne
target.review: This was a yummy treat! I felt the sour cream overpowered the cream cheese just a bit so on the second batch I only used 1/4 cup and it came out perfect! This was so much easier and less time consuming than a traditional cheesecake and my little ones love the dipping.  Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shrimp and angel hair pasta

easy, healthy, and fast.  this is a great weeknight dinner adapted from woman's day magazine, although its elegant enough for a dinner party.  just make sure to do your prep work ahead of time, since this comes together quickly.  great served with peas/onions side dish.

1. cook pasta according to package instructions and drain
2. while pasta cooks , heat one tablespoon of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. add the garlic , shrimp , and 1 / 2 tsp each of salt and pepper
4. saute two minutes or until shrimp are barely pink and / or garlic is soft
5. add broth and crushed red pepper
6. increase heat to high
7. add cooked shrimp
8. cook on high heat for 2-3 minutes , until shrimp are warmed through
9. stir in lemon peel and juice
10. put the pasta in a serving bowl , add the remaining tablespoon olive oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon each salt and pepper
11. toss to coat
12. add the shrimp mixture , parsley , and cheese
13. toss to mix and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This was so YUMMY!  It seemed a little soupy but that didn't harm the flavor one bit.  The family gave it two thumbs and said it was a "for sure do over"!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy cajun chicken pasta

n'awlin's style of chicken with an updated alfredo sauce.

1. place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
2. in a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. reduce heat add green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
4. pour over hot linguine and toss with parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: This was WONDERFUL! I was looking for a way to use some left over whipping cream when I came across this easy and delicious recipe. I didn't change a thing other than doubling it which I'm glad it did because even then there was just one serving left which the hubby ate later that evening. The only thing I would change next time is to maybe grill the chicken and cut into bite size pieces before adding to the pasta mixture.  Thanks for sharing Lorac!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy chicken chow mein

this is fresh-tasting and easy to make. i enjoy it much better than take-out.

1. in a large pot , saute celery in oil for apx 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
2. add bean sprouts , mushrooms , water chestnuts , and chicken
3. in a large bowl , blend cornstarch with water
4. when smooth , add chicken broth and soy sauce to bowl
5. mix well and pour over meat and vegetables
6. bring to a boil , stirring until sauce thickens
7. reduce heat to low
8. cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes
9. serve over hot , cooked rice and chow mein noodles
demonstrations.review: This recipe is so good I couldn't finish eating it without saying, "Thank you!"  Takeout can get pricey for a family of 5 but who needs it when you have this recipe?!  The only thing I'll do different next time is to double the sauce.  Excellent!!!

target.recipe_text:
homestyle macaroni and cheese

it's not a lowfat casserole, but it's so delicious you won't care. add leftover ham for an even heartier meal.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. cook macaroni until just al dente
3. you can use elbows for a traditional look , but try scoobi-doo-- it works well in this recipe
4. drain pasta well
5. while the mac is boiling , melt the 1 / 4-cup butter in a large pot
6. whisk in the flour
7. over med heat , whisk until smooth and bubbly
8. stir in milk , cream cheese , salt , pepper& mustard
9. keep cooking and stirring until sauce is thickened-- about three or four minutes
10. cut the block of cheddar into half-inch cubes
11. add drained macaroni and cubed cheddar& combine well
12. pour into a casserole sprayed with pam
13. in a small bowl , combine the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top
14. dust with paprika if desired
15. bake for 15-20 minutes , or until top is golden brown and casserole is heated through
target.review:
Absolutely amazing. My daughter in law wanted macaroni and cheese pizza. I've made many different pizzas but never that one. So looked for what sounded like a great Mac & Cheese recipe to do this, and boy did I find one.

I didn't use the mustard and didn't technically bake it accoring to the directions. I made as stated and then put it on my crust that had been brushed with some melted butter and minced garlic. Top with bacon and just a few ounces of mozerella. Fantastic. I'll certainly be doing this again.

Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
onion roll appetizers

these are really easy appetizers that you can make a few days in advance, and bake them the day they are needed. i am not a fan of onions, but these are delicious.

1. chop onions
2. place in frying pan with butter
3. fry for 20 minutes or until onions are limp
4. stir in cream cheese and grated swiss cheese
5. stir until melts
6. spread on tortillas
7. roll and refrigerate overnight
8. to cook: grease baking sheet
9. cut into 1" pieces
10. bake , upright , at 375 degrees for 10 minutes or until lightly brown
demonstrations.review: Thank you for posting. It is a very differnt appetizer, which is nice. I love onions, cheese and pretty much everything wrapped in tortillas. I used a Cabot sharp cheddar (which I love) instead of the swiss. My 17 year old son raved and loved them.  Round two grew on me and I'll do it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cucusebzaminee   iranian potatoes

doesn't sound like much but these are very tasty. kids like it because they can eat it with their fingers. my maid, in iran, taught me to make this.

1. heat oil but do not burn
2. mix all ingredients well
3. drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil
4. fry until golden
5. drain well
demonstrations.review: These were good. I fried a couple to taste it, and thought they could use a bit more flavor. I added some garlic powder, salt and poultry seasoning and they were great. I'll certainly do them again. Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yummy caramel frosting

this is an excellent frosting for most any cake! but my granddaughter always wants it on a chocolate cake!! very easy to make.

1. in med saucepan , mix brown sugar , butter , and milk
2. cook and stir on med-hi until boiling
3. boil for 3 minutes
4. remove from heat and cool
5. add powdered sugar and maple flavoring
6. beat until creamy
demonstrations.review: Thanks for the posting. I too used it to drizzle over the Sour Crewam Banana Bundt Cake (Chef 109553 Lvs2Cook). Fantastic together. I also did not have any maple flavoring but it still had a light maple taste that was delicious.

target.recipe_text:
quick soft breadsticks

our family likes these breadsticks because they are soft and chewy. i like to make them when i am in a hurry because they rise quickly.

1. make dough using your favorite method- bread machine , mixer or by hand
2. roll out into a 10x12 inch rectangle
3. cut into strips about 3 / 4 inch wide
4. give each strip a twist and place on a greased cookie sheet
5. let rise for at least 20 minutes or more if you have time
6. bake at 375 for 10-15 minutes
7. brush with butter and sprinkle with garlic salt and parmesan cheese
target.review: Soo good and fluffy! Didn't rise much, and I mixed the water and yeast first then added the rest with flour last. Lots of cheese and garlic warm is perfect

demonstrations.recipe_text:
reeses squares   5 ingredients   no bake  reese s

these bars are extremely rich and not for people with a fear of chocolate and peanut butter (if those people actually exist)!!! very easy no bake 5 ingredient recipe!

1. combine graham crumbs , sugar and peanut butter and mix well
2. blend in melted butter until well combined
3. press mixture evenly into a 9 x 13 inch pan
4. melt chocolate chips in microwave or in double boiler
5. spread over peanut butter mixture
6. chill until just set and cut into bars (these are very hard to cut if the chocolate gets "rock hard"
demonstrations.review: These were super tasty, with a few adjustments. I used half as much sugar, melted marshmellows and swirled them into the peanut butter mixture, and then put the chocolate on. I froze it for a few minutes and then cut the bars to separate the chocolate, then froze for ten to harden it. Very tasty, and the marshmellow adds another layer of gooey, stringy sweetness!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best peanut butter cookies in the world

i got this recipe from a wife of a co-worker. the recipe is called 

1. in larger bowl , beat butter , brown sugar , and peanut butter until well blended
2. add egg and vanilla , beat well
3. stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. gradually add to peanut butter mixture , beat until well blended
5. heat oven to 350 f
6. shape dough into 1-1 / 4 inch balls , roll balls in granulated sugar
7. place on ungreased cookie sheet
8. with the tines of a fork , flatten ball
9. flatten again in opposite direction , forming crisscross marks
10. bake 9 to 10 minutes until light brown and cookie is set
11. cool slightly , remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
12. cool completely
13. don't overcook
14. use air cookie sheets for baking
demonstrations.review: Very good! Worked with natural jif peanut butter. Always dip the fork in water and sugar before crisscrossing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the only chocolate cake recipe you ll ever need   devil s food

this chocolate cake is absolutely thee best we have ever had. it is so moist and rich, i never make anything else (unless i am short on time :) the frosting recipe included goes perfectly with this cake, but you can use any frosting you like. try this once and you'll see why i call it "the only chocolate cake recipe you'll ever need"!!  adding 2/18/06: i want to note that i recently used sweetened whipped heavy cream with vanilla and it was just as fabulous as the frosting recipe listed, plus much easier.  i also used hazelnut coffee in the cake and it added even more of a little extra something!

1. preheat oven to 325f
2. in a large mixing bowl , sift together dry ingredients
3. add oil , coffee and milk and mix at medium speed for 2 minutes
4. add eggs and vanilla and beat 2 more minutes
5. expect batter to be thin
6. pour into a 9" x 13" greased and floured pan or 2- 9" round pans
7. bake 9 x 13 pan for about 45 minutes or 9" pans for about 30 minutes
8. cool in pans for about 15 minutes and then cool completely on racks
9. while cake is cooling make the icing: combine the milk and flour in a saucepan and cook over low heat until thick , whisking constantly
10. cover and refrigerate until chilled
11. in a medium bowl , beat butter , shortening , sugar and vanilla until creamy
12. add chilled milk and flour mixture and beat for 10 minutes
13. frost cooled cake and enjoy ! the frosting sounds intimidating , but it is worth it ! by the way , for some reason , we prefer this cake chilled , right out of the refrigerator
14. the rich chocolate and cool frosting just seem to taste best this way
demonstrations.review: Delicious!! Made as cupcakes and they are rather delicate but soo moist.

target.recipe_text:
turkey scallopini with lemon and capers

this is so delightful and really quite easy for such a deluxe taste.  the cook time should be taken with a grain of salt as it will differ greatly depending on just how thick your cutlets actually are and whether you are browning and cooking the turkey cutlets on an electric or a gas stove [more time for electric, less for gas].  the amounts for the herbs and capers do not have to be precise; an approximation according to your likes works fine!

1. pat turkey dry and season with salt and pepper
2. coat the slices in flour and shake off any excess
3. over high heat in a large heavy skillet , heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoon oil and brown half of the turkey cutlets , cooking until just cooked through
4. remove to a covered platter and keep warm
5. add and heat another 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil and brown and cook the rest of the turkey in the same way , also removing to the covered platter to be kept warm when finished
6. turn down heat a bit and add remaining tablespoon of oil to skillet
7. cook the garlic in the oil until fragrant , careful not to burn , about 30 seconds
8. then , over moderately high heat , deglaze pan with the broth
9. be sure to get all the beautiful browned bits loose & into the broth !
10. boil broth until reduced to about 3 / 4 cup
11. stir in lemon juice , capers , parsley , salt and pepper to taste , and butter
12. whisk sauce until smooth
13. return turkey cutlets and any juices to the saucepan and simmer until heated through , about 1-2 minutes
target.review: This dish was easy to prepare and had a wonderful taste! Definitely going on my list of favorites!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wine and cheese muffins

easy gourmet flavored muffins - perfect for dinner parties or holiday buffets. for family meals, you can substitute apple juice with cheddar cheese. this recipe is from my envelope of newspaper clippings.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. in a medium bowl , combine baking mix , wine , oil and egg
3. using a fork , beat the mixture for 30 strokes
4. stir in the cheeses and chives
5. divide the mixture between 12
6. muffin cups , greased or lined with paper cups
7. bake 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: I've been making these for decades now and it's a good basic recipe to play with. Right now I have them in the oven only I'm making a port wine and cheddar version. A good way to use of leftover wine! I've used a nice cranberry chardonay as well as other wines and it's always a delicious success! I'm glad this recipe was posted because I didn't feel like digging through my recipe box right now!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
claussen like refrigerator pickles

found this online and i wanted to save it so i can make yummy pickles!

1. combine the water , vinegar and salt and bring it to a boil
2. put the spices and cucumbers in quart jars
3. pour the brine mixture over the cucumbers and spices in the jars and seal
4. put them in the refrigerator: ready in 7-10 days
5. keeps 8 - 19 weeks
6. brine can be re used
7. this recipe can be mul
demonstrations.review:
I'm a Claussen pickle addict. I tried recipe # 249520 Claussen kosher pickle copycat and found them to be way too salty. Inedibly so. I just made a batch of this recipe with high hopes. I will rate it in a few days.

*** Update ***
After sitting for 5 days these pickles are on their way to pickle greatness! They still have a slight cucumber flavor but I think that makes them taste really fresh. I actually like these better than Claussen!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
very quick homemade dinner rolls

i have been making these for quite a long time. i found the recipe in an old church cookbook my mother had. no kneading or shaping required! they are homemade, with yeast and all. baked in muffin tins. so easy and a fanatstic addition to any dinner, or serve with a steaming bowl of my soup!
recipe #332873

1. dissolve yeast , water and sugar together
2. let sit for a few minutes until yeast bubbles a bit
3. add beaten egg , oil , flour and salt
4. mix with mixer on low speed
5. let rise 15 minutes
6. spoon ino greased muffin tins , let rise again , about 15-20 minutes
7. bake at 400 degrees for 15-20 minutes , or until browned
8. makes 12 rolls
9. serve with butter and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: These were very, very good ! We ate them buttered with soup for dinner and with jelly for breakfast the next morning! Next time I make them I may replace some of the flour with cornmeal and serve them with honey butter. Just a thought! This recipe is very versatile and you could use it as a base for many different flavor types of rolls.

target.recipe_text:
poverty meal

when i was a child, my family used to eat this at least once a week due to the fact that it is inexpensive and a little goes a long way. we also added fresh herbs or sometimes whole kernel corn. its even better the next day and it freezes well.

1. saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent
2. brown ground beef and drain
3. add ground beef , tomatoes , water , raw macaroni , salt and pepper to the onion and garlic mixture
4. cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. if desired , top with parmesan cheese
6. serve with crusty bread and a salad
target.review: This was a little bland for my taste.  I will try it again and add some extra ingredient to boost the flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
foolproof standing prime rib roast  paula deen

this is from paula deen of food tv and is what i fixed for christmas dinner 2005.  i was tempted to open the oven to check how things were going, but i resisted...waiting until it had cooked 40 minutes at the final stage of cooking.  i had a 9+ pound roast and the final temperature at that point was 129°f.  it was wonderful!  i'd definitely cook it the same way again.  see recipe #57340 for seasoning.

1. allow roast to stand at room temperature for at least 1 hour
2. preheat the oven to 375f
3. rub roast with house seasoning
4. place roast on a rack in the pan with the rib side down and the fatty side up
5. roast for 1 hour
6. turn off oven
7. leave roast in oven but do not open oven door for 2-3 hours
8. about 30 to 40 minutes before serving time , turn oven to 375f and reheat the roast
9. important: do not remove roast or re-open the oven door from time roast is put in until ready to serve
10. cover with foil and let stand for 15 minutes before cutting
11. cook it rare
12. if anyone wants it done medium , dip their slice in a pot of simmering au jus for 1 minute
demonstrations.review: This was so moist, delicious and flavorful.  Next time I think I would do two smaller ones so that we could have 4 end pieces. YUM!! Very easy to cook if you have two ovens.  If not make sure you dont have anything else that needs to go in the oven that day.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
famous barr s french onion soup

one of st. louis's favorite soup recipes was recently printed in the  post-dispatch.  i remember going to st. louis when i was young and my family  going into the department store's restaurant for this famous soup.  enjoy!  famous-barr's french onion soup

1. peel onions and slice 1 / 8 inch thick , preferably in a food processor
2. melt butter in a 6-quart stockpot
3. add onions
4. cook , uncovered , over low heat for 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. stir in pepper , paprika and bay leaf
6. saute over low heat 10 minutes more , stirring frequently
7. pour in 6 cans broth and wine
8. increase heat and bring to a boil
9. dissolve flour in remaining 1 can broth
10. stir into boiling soup
11. reduce heat and simmer slowly for 2 hours
12. adjust color to a rich brown with caramel coloring , season with salt
13. refrigerate overnight
14. to serve , heat soup in microwave or on stove top
15. if desired , pour into ovenproof crocks or bowls
16. top with a slice of bread and a sprinkling of grated cheese
17. heat under the broiler until cheese melts and bubbles , about 5 minutes
18. leftover soup can be frozen
demonstrations.review: We didnt care for this that much, it seemed like it was missing something.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vanilla  buttercream frosting  from sprinkles cupcakes

my sister got this buttercream frosting off the box of a sprinkles cupcake mix, made famous by oprah.  my sister said this was amazing.  update:  i have finally gotten around to making this myself.  i will say, that i don't like my desserts overly sweet and. though this was very good, i think i would probably decrease the amount of sugar for my personal taste.  i'm glad everyone else has liked it as-is, though.  :)

1. in a bowl add sugar then add butter
2. beat till blended
3. next add salt
4. then add the milk and vanilla and beat for an additional 3 to 5 minutes or until smooth and creamy
demonstrations.review: This frosting was absolutley wonderful.  I made it for a baby shower and piped it on as shown in the picture and everybody thought they were from a bakery.  Everybody kept commenting on how they didnt like buttercream frosting but how much they loved this.  It is my new go to frosting recipe.  Thanks for posting.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot ravioli

this is a recipe that i adopted from a sweet chef by the name of cbw. a real doll. "i always plan a crock pot meal for sunday afternoon so that it's all ready after church, and i wanted something different than the chicken we usually end up with. this was a big hit!"

1. pour about half of the pasta sauce in the bottom of crock pot
2. add frozen ravioli
3. pour additional pasta sauce , tomato sauce , water , and red pepper over ravioli
4. sprinkle italian seasonings over sauces
5. sprinkle cheese on top
6. turn crock pot on low and cook for 4-5 hours
target.review: Really easy and tasty.  Used 2 teaspoons of red pepper flakes and will cut back or omit the next time around.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick   easy chicken parmigiana

this is very easy to make and it tastes great! originally from southern living. you may need to add another egg if your chicken breasts are large.

1. place chicken between two sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap and flatten using a meat mallet or rolling pin
2. combine bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
3. dip chicken in beaten egg
4. dredge in breadcrumb mixture
5. melt butter in a large skillet
6. add chicken and brown on each side over medium-high heat
7. arrange chicken in a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish
8. pour spaghetti sauce over chicken and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
9. cover and bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated and chicken is no longer pink
demonstrations.review: Really easy and tasty dish!  Used a full 24 ounce jar of spaghetti sauce and the only white cheese I had on hand was sliced Swiss and it worked great.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sticky sesame chicken tenders

quick alternative to sesame chicken cooked in the oven!  from relish!relish!

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. line a large shallow baking pan with foil and spray with cooking spray
3. in a medium bowl , add the garlic , salt , soy sauce , hoisin , honey , oil and a pinch of cayenne
4. add the chicken tenders to the sauce and turn to coat
5. arrange the tenders in a single layer on the baking pan , turning over once , until cooked through , about 20 minutes
6. sprinkle the chicken with the toasted sesame seeds and onions and serve
demonstrations.review: We enjoyed this very much! Made as directed.  It wasn't really what I would call sticky but good, none the less.  Had with steamed rice and veggies on the side.  Served with a little soy sauce on top of all.  It was a tasty meal.  I think I might try it as an appetizer with wings and little drumsticks for our next football party.  Thanks Beth!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
egg white french toast

nan

1. in medium bowl beat egg whites well
2. add milk , vanilla and cinnamon to egg whites and continue to beat
3. dip bread slices into batter and coat on both sides
4. cook one of the following ways: place dipped bread in greased and heated skillet
5. cook by turning a few times to brown
6. or , place dipped bread on greased or oiled baking sheet
7. then broil in the oven , turning only once
demonstrations.review: Healthy and delicious breakfast! Due to what I had on hand I used whole grain wheat bread and fat free half and half instead of milk. From other's suggestions I added a teaspoon of brown sugar to the milk mixture. After done, I sprinkle toast with powdered sugar and serve with sugar free syrup.  So tasty!

target.recipe_text:
best herb marinade for grilled steak

for best results marinate the steaks for one hour!

1. blend together all ingredients
2. place in a heavy zip-lock type plastic bag
3. add your favorite cut of meat
4. place in the refrigerator on a plate
5. turn often
target.review:
what can I say...fantastic  marinade
thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate cinnamon rolls

a delicious, different cinnamon roll recipe.

1. in medium bowl , dissolve yeast in water
2. stir in shortening , salt , sugar , egg , cocoa , and 1 cup flour
3. beat 2 minutes on medium speed of mixer , or 300 vigorous strokes by hand
4. scrape side of bowl , stir in remaining flour
5. blend well
6. cover and let rise in warm place until double
7. stir dough down by beating 25 strokes
8. turn soft dough into well floured surface
9. roll into 8x12-inch rectangle
10. spread with softened butter and sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar mixture
11. roll up beginning with wide edge
12. pinch edges together
13. cut into 12 pieces
14. place in greased 9x13-inch pan
15. let rise until doubled bake at 375f for 25 minutes
16. combine icing ingredients , adding enough cream for good spreading consistency
17. spread on rolls immediately and then sprinkle with nuts if desired
18. serve warm
19. can also use favorite cream cheese icing to frost
demonstrations.review:
I made these rolls this morning. Very easy and pretty quick 
( except for the rising:)
They were delicious! they took a little longer to rise..but I think it was because of the cold!!
Will be a regular in my house!
Thank you Divinemom5 ! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super rich chocolate pound cake

a relatively quick and easy cake, with a dynamite taste! during the school year (my husband and i are both teachers), things get a little hectic with grading exams, papers, and projects...plus my son jake is starting pre-school in a few weeks...so i'm glad to have some fast, reliable goodies on hand that don't take too much time to make or require a lot of fuss. try it once--you'll see;)

1. preheat oven to 325f
2. grease and flour a 10" fluted tube pan
3. in a large bowl , whisk together the flour , cocoa powder , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. set aside
5. in another large bowl , using an electric mixer on high speed , cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy
6. add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. blend in the vanilla
8. in 3 additions each , beat in the flour mixture and sour cream just until combined
9. do not overmix
10. pour batter into the prepared pan
11. bake for 60-70 minutes , or until the center tests done
12. cool 10 minutes in pan
13. invert onto a wire rack and cool completely
demonstrations.review: 5 stars !! This was so delicious, My husband had 3 pieces in one day! The only thing I did different was I substituted the sour cream with yoghurt and also added another tsp of vanilla. This is a keeper for sure!! :)thanks so much for this recipe JamesDean'sGirl !

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy chicken stir fry    3

a lively, tongue-tingling dish!

1. combine all ingredients for marinade
2. reserve about 1 / 4 of mixture in separate container
3. add chicken and let sit for at least an hour
4. put pan or wok over medium-high heat
5. add fire oil / olive oil combo until sizzling
6. add green onions and garlic
7. add chicken mixture and simmer until chicken is no longer pink
8. add eggplant , zucchini and onion
9. add reserved marinade as necessary
10. simmer for about 10 minutes , until vegetables are crisp-tender
11. cook soba noodles in boiling water 2- 3 minutes
12. remove and drain
13. add noodles to vegetable-chicken mixture and cook 2 minutes longer
demonstrations.review: I love spicy food , and this was good.I made the chicken a let it marinate overnight.I served it with noodles and had a green salad on the side to cool down the heat :) thanks for a great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
kim s sweet potato casserole

this thanksgiving my boyfriend's step mom's daughter-in-law, kim, brought this sweet potato casserole for our feast. not being a huge fan of sweet potatoes, i was reluctant to try it. boy am i glad i did! it isn't as sweet as most sweet potato casseroles and doesn't have tons the marshmallow goop on it. i begged her for the recipe so that i could have it every holiday and decided to post it on *zaar so that i don't lose it. she stated on the recipe card that she always doubles the recipe and that when it does, it fills a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.

1. mix all of the casserole ingredients together until well blended
2. spread into a buttered casserole dish
3. mix topping ingredients together and sprinkle over the casserole
4. bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 35 minutes
5. remove from oven
6. if topping with marshmallows , place them on the casserole and bake for an addition 5-7 minutes or until marshmallows have melted
7. serve
target.review: Amazing!  I hate sweet potatoes and I loved this.  I served it at Thanksgiving and my grandma (hates sweet potatoes) demanded the recipe! Thank You!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
coffee house coffee cake

a delicious coffee cake from the famed espresso chain. you'll earn brownie points with your co-workers if you bring this in to work with you!

1. preheat oven to 325
2. make topping by combining 1 cup flour with brown sugar , 1 / 2 cup softened butter and 1 teaspoon cinnamon in a bowl
3. mixture should have the consistency of moist sand
4. add 1 / 2 cup chopped pecans
5. in a large bowl , cream together 1 cup butter , 3 / 4 cup light brown sugar and 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar with an electric mixer until smooth and fluffy
6. add eggs and vanilla and mix well
7. in a separate bowl combine flour , baking powder and salt
8. add this dry mixture to the moist ingredients a little at a time
9. add milk and mix well
10. pour the batter into a 9 x 13 baking pan that has been buttered and dusted with a light coating of flour
11. sprinkle the crumb topping over the batter
12. be sure the topping completely covers the batter
13. bake 50 minutes or until the edges just begin to brown
14. cool
demonstrations.review: This tasted sooo good even though I forgot the milk all together.  It tasted like butter and sugar! Yumm

demonstrations.recipe_text:
opal s pumpkin pie
